title: Sr. Partner Success Manager, Strategic Accounts, eero
descriptionHtml:
At eero, we pride ourselves on dedication to customers. We are growing eero's B2B partnerships — bringing our networking solutions to strategic accounts at scale — and we need a Senior Partner Success Manager to help us define and scale how we serve these customers.

In this role, you'll be a founding member of a team that is charting new territory for eero's B2B partnerships. You'll manage the full partner lifecycle for strategic accounts — from initial onboarding through ongoing optimization — while simultaneously helping us build the frameworks, processes, and playbooks that will scale our partner success function as the business grows. Along the way, you'll review partner requests, ensure eero teams are aligned on requirements, and coordinate cross-functional efforts to meet external commitments. Once new partners have completed their initial deployment, you'll continue partnering with them exploring expansion opportunities, offering support and insights to ensure they're making the most of their eero experience. This is a highly hands-on role: you'll work directly with B2B customers in the field, roll up your sleeves to solve complex deployment challenges, gather voice-of-customer insights, and drive measurable outcomes.

You'll thrive here if you're energized by ambiguity, comfortable building the plane while flying it, and excited to shape something new rather than maintain the status quo.


Key job responsibilities
Partner Development & Strategic Account Management: Own all facets of the partner success process for large, complex strategic accounts within new business initiatives. Acquire deep knowledge of customers' vision, products, and objectives. Manage deal registration, partner onboarding certification, and joint business planning to accelerate pipeline and deployment velocity. Anticipate partner needs and resolve pain points before they escalate. Identify and execute on revenue-maximizing opportunities for both the partner and eero.

Strategic Guidance: Earn partners' trust and influence their customer-facing technology strategy. Help partners optimize their eero programs to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Build & Scale New Initiatives: Help define and operationalize new partner engagement models. Craft scalable workflows, onboarding processes, and success frameworks. Balance customer needs with competing business priorities. Identify opportunities to “invent and simplify” and automate repetitive work, including with AI tools. Support partner readiness across international geographies.

Hands-On Customer Engagement: Be in the field with B2B customers — conducting on-site visits, supporting deployments, leading product demonstrations, and coordinating product training for new and existing partners. Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, translating technical requirements into actionable plans.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Support, and Manufacturing to advance partner initiatives. Facilitate cross-functional meetings to resolve partner escalations, align on requirements, and drive external commitments to completion.

Quantitative Analysis & Demand Planning: Create and utilize reporting and analytics, data modeling, and business case analysis to identify opportunities for partners and ensure their objectives are achieved through quantitative insights. Analyze partner purchasing behavior and demand signals to develop accurate internal forecasts. Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, and finance teams to ensure appropriate inventory lead times, hardware availability, and order fulfillment for partner deployments across multiple geographies.


A day in the life
As a Senior Partner Success Manager on the Strategic Accounts team within eero, no two days look the same — and that's by design. You might start the morning reviewing deployment data for a strategic account, then hop on a call to troubleshoot an onboarding challenge with a new B2B partner. By midday, you're collaborating with Product and Engineering on a feature request that emerged from customer feedback. In the afternoon, you may be preparing a business case for a new partnership model or traveling to a customer site to support a critical deployment milestone. Throughout it all, you're balancing proactive outreach with creative problem-solving, building relationships with partners, and contributing to the foundational processes that will define how eero serves strategic B2B customers for years to come.

About the team
This role sits within the Operations team at eero and is part of a newly formed initiative focused on growing eero's B2B partnerships with strategic accounts across new customer segments. We are a small, high-impact team that operates with a startup mentality inside a world-class organization. We value ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession with the highest standards. If you're passionate about building something from scratch, partnering deeply with B2B customers, and driving measurable business outcomes in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — you'll thrive here.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
- Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Travel up to 30% of the time
- Experience with business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business
- Comfort with ambiguity and a proven ability to deliver results in undefined or rapidly evolving environments
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using sales CRM tools such as Salesforce
- Experience operating in early-stage or high-growth environments where processes are being built from the ground up
- Experience working with channel partners (MSPs, ISPs, VARs, or distributors)
- Familiarity with networking, WiFi, or infrastructure technology

title: Program Manager II,IN Relay Ops, APEX IN Relay Operations
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.

Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Responsibilities of Manager I under Relay Ops/NOC
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.

A Manager I is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. He should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, he will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.

The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. He/she will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. He/she will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.

What are we really looking for?
• You should be very analytical and be able to justify your decisions and approaches with data

title: Software Dev Engineer, SIEGE
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, security and privacy are central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security and customer privacy across all of Amazon’s products and services.

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team. Our mission is to make encryption simple, scalable, and invisible for software builders across the company. We build the core services, libraries, and developer tools that enable thousands of engineering teams to securely encrypt and decrypt their data with minimal effort, allowing them to focus on building great products while meeting the highest security standards.

The work you do will have company-wide impact. You’ll work on challenging technical problems at scale, collaborate with experienced engineers, and help define the future of secure software development.

Every day, our platform protects billions of data fields in transit and at rest. As an engineer on our team, you’ll solve complex distributed systems challenges, design highly available services, and build developer experiences that make secure software the default.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build highly scalable, low latency key security services used by engineering teams across the company
- Contribute to the architecture and evolution of our encryption platform
- Improve the developer experience through intuitive tooling, self-service capabilities, and clear interfaces
- Maintaining and promoting a high operational excellence bar

About the team
The Secure Ingress and Egress Team (SIEGE) owns and operates the first line of defense for Amazon's confidential customer data. We build the tools and applications that allow Earth's most customer-centric company to protect our most valuable asset - Customer Trust.

We build and maintain real time encryption services at Amazon scale working with security systems that bridge proxy layers, rendering applications and back-end service chains; our products impacts company-wide architectures and are used by thousands of services for protecting billions of fields per day in transit and at rest.

- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

- Experience building and operating a cloud-based architecture

descriptionHtml:
The companies defining the future of AI are a small number of startups training, tuning, and operating models at scale. title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
descriptionHtml:
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

Key job responsibilities
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.

You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.

Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.

In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.

Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.

descriptionHtml:

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in electric motor design—including brushless DC (BLDC), permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PMSM), and vast experience with motor-manufacturing techniques, and a proven ability to manage external motor equipment vendors and contract design partners. title: Sr. Infrastructure Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure equipment (Example: Electrical and Mechanical Control and communication systems, Network equipment, Power and Cooling controls, MV Transformers, LV SWGR, Breakers, UPS, Chillers etc.). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics.
At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel within US and internationally.

or crawl.

Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Mobile Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with deep Rust expertise to help lead development of safety-rated sensor processing firmware for one of the world's largest autonomous robot fleets. You will set technical direction for major subsystems of the Safety Perception stack (real-time safety applications, sensor processing pipelines, and system interfaces on heterogeneous multi-core MCU/CPU/GPU platforms) that let robots in Amazon facilities worldwide detect and respond to obstacles safely and reliably. You will own the team's hardest end-to-end problems, framing solutions where the business need is clear but the technical strategy is not, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.

We are looking for a technical leader who is deeply proficient in Rust (or strong in C/C++ and eager to work in Rust), is fluent across the boundary between RTOS and Linux on the same chip, has substantial experience with sensor data acquisition or signal processing, and can architect systems that meet the rigor of IEC 61508 functional safety certification. You will influence beyond your immediate team, shaping designs, resolving escalations, mitigating long-term one-way-door risks, and mentoring engineers, all while collaborating closely with hardware, functional safety, and navigation teams to deliver firmware where correctness is not optional.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate is a force multiplier who sets technical direction across teams and raises the bar for associate safety. They will:

- Lead the design and architecture of major safety-rated and non-safety-rated firmware subsystems in Rust on heterogeneous multi-core platforms, where real-time safety code and Linux services coexist on the same chip.
- Set technical direction across the full sensor processing pipeline (driver integration, frame acquisition, point cloud generation, collision detection) and influence peer hardware, safety, and navigation teams.
- Own the team's hardest end-to-end problems, framing solutions where the business problem is known but the technical strategy is not.
- Drive perception features that let robots detect and respond to obstacles under IEC 61508 certification, ensuring data integrity through black-channel diagnostics.
- Raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers so the team is more reliable because of your presence but does not require it.
- Produce direction-setting design documents and safety analysis artifacts that meet the rigor of third-party certification and witness testing.
- Lead debugging and root-cause analysis end-to-end, from raw sensor data to safety responses, on real robots at test facilities and in production.
- Leverage AI coding assistants as a force multiplier and lead the team to do the same.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might spend the morning aligning peer teams around a subsystem architecture in a design review, then head to the test floor after lunch to lead a cross-functional debug with electrical and QA engineers, determining whether an issue is firmware, hardware, or a faulty sensor. That afternoon you profile a pipeline to close a latency budget, then pair with another engineer to unblock their design. Our engineers take complete ownership (from interrupt handlers to CI/CD pipelines to on-site data collection) and frequently enter new areas to meet our customers' needs. As a senior engineer, you help chart where the team goes next.

About the team
The Safety Perception team is a group of passionate embedded software engineers who apply advances in robotics and sensor processing to real-world safety challenges. We write embedded Rust on platforms where correctness is not optional, and we own the full stack: from low-level driver integration to system APIs to the test infrastructure that proves our firmware works. We take our responsibility for safety seriously while challenging ourselves to ship the right product at the performance we need. We pay attention to the details so others do not have to, making systems intuitive enough that safety does not need a second thought.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 6+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 6+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Proficiency in embedded development in Rust; alternatively, strong modern C/C++ embedded experience with demonstrated willingness and ability to work in Rust

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience developing RTOS applications or bare-metal real-time systems
- Experience with heterogeneous multi-core platforms (e.g., ARM Cortex-A + Cortex-R/M + GPUs)
- Experience with general troubleshooting and debugging of hardware
- Experience writing low-level drivers (V4L2, I2C, SPI, DMA)
- Experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, or similar RPC/serialization frameworks
- Familiarity developing embedded software in a safety-standards-controlled environment such as IEC 61508 or ISO 26262
- Working knowledge of 3D geometry, coordinate transforms, or point cloud processing
- Experience with robotics middleware (ROS/ROS2) or visualization tools (Foxglove, RViz)

title: Applied Scientist II, Alexa International Tech
descriptionHtml:
Alexa International is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Applied Scientist to help build industry-leading technology with Large Language Models (LLMs), ASR, TTS, and Speech to Speech models, requiring strong deep learning and generative models knowledge. You will contribute to developing novel solutions and deliver high-quality results that impact Alexa's international products and services.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist with the Alexa International team, you will work with talented peers to develop novel algorithms and modeling techniques to advance the state of the art with Large Language Models (LLMs), ASR, TTS, and Speech to Speech model. Your work will directly impact our international customers in the form of products and services that make use of digital assistant technology. You will leverage Amazon's heterogeneous data sources, unique and diverse international customer nuances and large-scale computing resources to accelerate advances in text, voice, and vision domains in a multimodal setup. The ideal candidate possesses a solid understanding of machine learning, natural language understanding, modern LLM architectures, LLM evaluation & tooling, and a passion for pushing boundaries in this vast and quickly evolving field. They thrive in fast-paced environments to tackle complex challenges, excel at swiftly delivering impactful solutions while iterating based on user feedback, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

A day in the life
* Analyze, understand, and model customer behavior and the customer experience based on large-scale data.
* Build novel online & offline evaluation metrics and methodologies for multimodal personal digital assistants.
* Drive research in ASR, TTS, and Speech-to-Speech (S2S) model training and fine-tuning
* Advance multilingual speech recognition and synthesis using LLM-based architectures
* Fine-tune/post-train LLMs using techniques like SFT, DPO, RLHF, and RLAIF.
* Collaborate with partner teams on evaluation frameworks and post-training methodologies.
* Communicate solutions clearly to partners and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications and community engagement.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Deep expertise in ASR/TTS architectures, end-to-end speech models, and LLM integration with speech systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Deep expertise in state-of-the-art LLM architectures, training, evaluation, and post-training techniques (SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF)

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Werne - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2026 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Alexa
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to organize, drive, and deliver Amazon-wide programs spanning multiple departments with visibility at the VP+ level. You should be passionate about Alexa+ – Amazon's most ambitious AI assistant – and energized by driving cross-department, cross-functional programs across distributed systems, LLMs, and critical infrastructure. This role requires perseverance, strong technical acumen, and exceptional collaboration skills to lead complex initiatives at scale across thousands of engineers.

Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for setting up, driving, championing, and successfully delivering large initiatives spanning Alexa, AWS, and AGI – across both device and cloud domains. You will:

- Work directly with VP and key Alexa executives
- Drive the program strategy for large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives spanning Alexa, AWS, and AGI
- Own end-to-end delivery of programs that directly impact Alexa+'s core experience across distributed systems, LLMs, and critical infrastructure
- Establish program frameworks, governance models, and operating mechanisms that scale across thousands of engineers in multiple organizations
- Identify and resolve systemic cross-organizational dependencies, driving alignment across VP-level leadership when priorities conflict
- Define success metrics and accountability mechanisms focused on availability, latency, accuracy, cost-effectiveness, and operational excellence
- Influence technical architecture decisions to ensure programs are set up for long-term scalability and maintainability
- Communicate program status, risks, and strategic trade-offs to VP+ leadership; shape narratives for L10+ reviews
- Build and maintain program roadmaps that connect tactical execution to long-term organizational strategy
- Partner with engineering, science, and QA leadership to ensure technical solutions meet quality and performance bars at scale

A day in the life
You operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, spending your day navigating across organizational boundaries to drive Alexa+'s most critical programs forward. You bring the technical curiosity and learning agility to ramp up on any domain – LLMs, distributed systems, device firmware, cloud infrastructure – deeply enough to arbitrate technical disagreements and unblock teams when they can't resolve it themselves.

Strategic Leadership & VP Partnership

- Start the day syncing with your VP on program priorities, escalations, and strategic trade-offs – you are their trusted partner in navigating cross-org complexity
- Shape the agenda for L10+ leadership reviews, framing technical programs in terms of customer impact and business outcomes
- Make judgment calls on where to invest your time: which escalations to own personally, which to delegate, and which to let teams resolve independently
Cross-Organizational Influence

- Drive alignment across Directors and VPs in Alexa, AWS, and AGI when organizations have competing priorities or conflicting technical approaches
- Facilitate high-stakes technical and strategic discussions – not just driving consensus, but making recommendations and influencing decisions
- Operate as the connective tissue between device, cloud, and AI/ML organizations – translating constraints and priorities across domains
Technical Depth & Execution

- Learn technical domains quickly and deeply enough to arbitrate disagreements between engineering teams and unblock stalled decisions
- Deep-dive into technical designs, architecture reviews, and engineering plans – understanding trade-offs well enough to broker the right path forward
- Identify systemic risks and dependencies that no single team can see, then drive mitigation strategies across organizations
- Review program metrics (availability, latency, quality) and take action when trajectories diverge from targets
Driving Outcomes at Scale

- Unblock programs that are stuck – whether the issue is technical, organizational, or political
- Hold teams accountable to commitments while maintaining the relationships that make cross-org collaboration work
- Continuously refine operating mechanisms – knowing when a process is helping and when it's become overhead

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience managing programs spanning engineering department with complex cross-dependencies, concurrent workstreams, and VP/Director-level stakeholder management
- Experience actively participating in and driving architecture and design decisions (design patterns, reliability, scaling) — with the technical depth and engagement to challenge, contribute, and unblock rather than simply reviewing from the sidelines
- Demonstrated ability to decompose ambiguous, large-scale platform initiatives into executable program plans with clear milestones and dependency chains
- Knowledge about Cloud operations and Architecture at scale
- Strong understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, and agentic systems — with a track record of applying these technologies to improve team productivity at the program, process, or development level
- Strong written communication skills with experience authoring narratives, program strategies, and technical documents for senior leadership audiences
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with device-side technologies: operating systems, device operations, OTA updates, firmware delivery pipelines
- Knowledge of capacity planning, forecasting, and infrastructure scaling
- Experience with language-side server architectures (NLU, ASR, TTS, or LLM inference serving)

title: Amazon Tour Leader, Amazon Tours
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking enthusiastic and engaging Tour Leaders to lead immersive 90-minute in-person tours of our state-of-the-art Robotics Fulfillment Centers. As a Tour Leader, you will play a crucial role in showcasing Amazon's technology, innovative processes, and dedicated workforce to a diverse audience. This position offers a unique opportunity to highlight Amazon's rich history, our commitment to being Earth's Best Employer, and our ambitious Climate Pledge goals. We are seeking an enthusiastic individual with good communication skills and attention to detail in providing informative and engaging tours of their fulfillment center. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating exceptional customer experiences.
At the end of each day, you'll review feedback from tour participants and contribute to continuous improvement efforts for the tour program.


Key job responsibilities
- Conduct multiple 90-minute tours per day, providing an engaging and informative experience for visitors.
- Set a high-bar as an indirect regional leader of Tour Leaders in other Amazon Operations sites. You are seen as a mentor to your peers and provide support as needed.
- Responsible for managing Zendesk ques by responding and problem-solving customer inquiries
- Develop a deep understanding of Amazon's fulfillment processes, robotics technology, and company history.
- Maintain positive site relationships and participate in site & community engagement activities
- Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.
- Highlight Amazon's commitment to employee development, safety, and well-being.
- Educate visitors about Amazon's sustainability initiatives and the Climate Pledge.
- Ensure tour groups adhere to all safety protocols and facility regulations.
- Respond to questions from tour participants accurately and professionally.
- Lead and support high level/VIP tours that require additional planning and coordination
- Collaborate and Earn Trust with fulfillment center teams to stay updated on the latest developments and processes and gain support with site stakeholders.
- Maintain and update tour content to reflect new technologies and company initiatives.
- Collect and report feedback from tour participants to improve the overall experience.


A day in the life
As a Tour Guide at an Amazon Robotics Fulfillment Center, your day will be dynamic and engaging. You'll start by reviewing the day's tour schedule and preparing any necessary materials. Before each tour, you'll greet visitors, provide safety briefings, and distribute required protective equipment.
During the tours, you'll guide groups through various sections of the fulfillment center, explaining the intricate dance between human associates and robotic systems. You'll showcase how customer orders are processed, picked, packed, and shipped with incredible efficiency. Throughout the tour, you'll weave in stories about Amazon's history, our commitment to employee growth, and our sustainability efforts.
Between tours, you'll have time to refresh your knowledge, update tour content, and collaborate with colleagues on our global team. You may also participate in training sessions to enhance your skills and stay current on Amazon's latest innovations.


About the team
You'll be joining a passionate team of Tour Leaders and program managers around the world that are dedicated to showcasing Amazon's innovation and commitment to customer obsession. Our team works closely with various departments within the fulfillment center, including operations, robotics, human resources, and sustainability teams. We're a collaborative group that values creativity, continuous learning, and the ability to inspire others. As part of this team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the development of tour content and help shape the public's perception of Amazon's advanced fulfillment operations.
This role offers an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Amazon's technological advancements while developing valuable public speaking and customer engagement skills. Join us in sharing Amazon's story and inspiring the next generation of innovators!

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German

- Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Communications, PR, Tourism, or a related field OR equivalent experience
- Ability to conduct multiple tours per day (5 days per week) onsite in a Fufillment Center. This includes frequently walking around the building and going up and down stairs while ensuring groups are adhering to all safety procedures.

- An entrepreneurial spirit, including the ability to work independently and autonomously

title: Principal Pgm Mgr - Amazon Shipping, Amazon Shipping
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?
Ready to build Amazon's next $100B business? We're not just entering shipping—we're transforming how billions of packages move around the globe. By evolving Amazon's legendary fulfillment engine into an agile, intelligent shipping network, we're creating a resilient system that continuously optimizes to deliver on time, every time, for every business and every customer. Every shipment is more than just a box—it spins the flywheel faster, continuously enhancing our logistics network through scale, speed, and intelligence. As we increase density and reach, we're revolutionizing shipping for ALL businesses while simultaneously strengthening Amazon's own delivery capabilities—reducing costs and accelerating deliveries across our entire ecosystem.

The NODE (network operations and delivery experience) team owns the final mile—the last, most visible, and most operationally complex leg of the delivery journey. This is where the promise we make to customers is kept: the package on the doorstep, on time, at the lowest possible cost. We build and optimize the systems, routing intelligence, and delivery operations that move packages from the last delivery station to the customer's hands across a rapidly scaling global network.

What will you do?
We're hiring a Principal Program Manager for our NODE team to drive cross-organizational initiatives, influence VP-level roadmaps, and unlock hundreds of millions in cost savings and delivery performance through transformational improvements to our final mile network and delivery experience.

You'll operate with complete autonomy to identify and remediate endemic problems in our last-mile operations, drive architectural and operational decisions across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Operations organizations, and establish the strategic mechanisms that enable Amazon Shipping to scale final mile delivery at the pace our business demands.

Working at the unique intersection where program leadership directly impacts delivery cost, speed, and reliability, you'll define multi-year operational and technical roadmaps, influence resource allocation across VP organizations, and solve significantly complex problems where both business and operational strategies are undefined.

You'll collaborate closely with:

Product Management teams defining final mile capabilities and roadmaps
Commercial teams driving enterprise shipper adoption and delivery SLAs
Engineering organizations building routing, dispatch, and delivery platforms
Operations teams running delivery stations and last-mile networks globally
Principal Engineers and Architects on routing, capacity, and network design decisions
VP-level leadership across multiple organizations
Who are you?
You're a seasoned program management leader with deep operational fluency in last-mile logistics and delivery networks, combined with exceptional strategic judgment and a proven ability to build consensus across diverse executive stakeholders. You have a track record of managing programs that span multiple VP organizations, operating independently in highly ambiguous environments where both the problem and the solution are undefined.

Key attributes:

Strategic thinker who connects operational and technical improvements to delivery cost and customer experience outcomes
Depth in final mile operations, route optimization, capacity planning, and distributed logistics systems
Executive presence with the ability to influence VP-level audiences
Data-driven decision maker who defines meaningful success metrics (cost per package, on-time delivery, delivery defects)
Strong owner who takes accountability for business impact beyond project delivery
Exceptional communicator who translates complex operational and technical concepts clearly
Proven ability to identify and remediate endemic problems at scale
You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where operational decisions directly impact delivery cost and the customer experience for millions of packages a day. You're passionate about solving endemic problems that affect global last-mile operations while creating the playbook that scales Amazon Shipping's final mile worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Program Leadership & Roadmap Ownership

Own the end-to-end strategy and execution for Amazon Shipping's final mile network, working across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Operations VP organizations to drive operational and architectural decisions and organizational alignment
Define multi-year operational and technical roadmaps for final mile improvements that directly impact delivery speed, cost per package, on-time delivery rates, and delivery defect reduction
Influence resource allocation and technology investments across multiple organizations to ensure alignment with final mile strategy
Identify and remediate endemic problems that create delivery bottlenecks, limit network scalability, or cause recurring delivery defects, decomposing significantly complex challenges into straightforward solutions
Cross-Organizational Influence & Executive Engagement

Build consensus across VP organizations through effective narratives and presentations, representing complex operational and technical trade-offs clearly
Manage executive-level escalations with excellent judgment, balancing operational constraints with business priorities
Drive alignment between final mile goals and organizational objectives across global stakeholders
Partner with Principal Engineers and SDMs to ensure routing, dispatch, and capacity decisions scale to match business growth projections
Operational & Technical Excellence

Drive large-scale programs that solve complex problems in route optimization, capacity planning, dispatch, delivery tracking, exception handling, and driver/delivery-partner tooling
Evaluate network and system designs for scalability, delivery performance, safety, and operational excellence
Lead simplification initiatives that enable delivery-station and operations teams to operate independently and reduce operational and technical debt
Manage large-scale engineering and operations efforts that remediate endemic final mile problems with network-wide impact
Metrics, Visibility & Business Impact

Establish and own success metrics that connect operational and technical improvements to business outcomes (cost per package, on-time delivery, delivery defect rate, delivery speed, customer delivery experience)
Create mechanisms for continuous visibility and proactive risk identification across the final mile network
Own quarterly business reviews that translate operational metrics into business impact for executive audiences
Quantify the business impact of final mile improvements and communicate ROI to leadership
Team Development & Community Building

Amplify impact by creating and optimizing critical mechanisms that enable teams to deliver independently
Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and knowledge sharing
Raise the bar for program management excellence across Amazon Shipping
Streamline processes and drive adoption of best practices across multiple organizations

A day in the life
Your mornings start with strategic analysis—spotting patterns across the final mile network and quantifying business impact. You review delivery performance metrics, cost-per-package trends, on-time delivery rates, and delivery defect data to identify emerging trends and opportunities.

Mid-morning involves writing VP-level documents that drive operational and technology roadmaps and priorities. You craft narratives that connect delivery improvements to business outcomes, preparing for upcoming reviews and decision-making forums.

Afternoons focus on driving initiatives: partnering with Principal Solution Architects and SDMs on routing, capacity, and network design decisions, influencing cross-org priorities, and preparing narratives for executives. You facilitate alignment meetings, resolve blockers, and ensure programs stay on track.

Late afternoons are spent managing escalations and engaging with operations and enterprise partners. You work directly with delivery-station leaders and key shippers experiencing final mile challenges, translating their feedback into actionable improvements.

Throughout the day, you shift between diving deep on operational and technical problems and influencing stakeholders on business impacts. You balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, ensuring both immediate delivery wins and long-term network evolution.

You'll collaborate with engineering leaders building our adaptive delivery technology, operations teams executing our delivery promise on the ground, commercial stakeholders focused on scaling our shipper base, and product managers defining the future of final mile. This role demands someone who can toggle between strategic vision and tactical execution, turning last-mile challenges into opportunities for transformation.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. The cloud business is continuously growing and offering new features, so our data center infrastructure is always dynamic and expanding.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Sports
descriptionHtml:
Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If
this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Key job responsibilities

1. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of multi-tier distributed services and customer experiences across multiple engineers.
2. Own team architecture—providing system-wide perspective, design guidance, and influencing future technology choices.
3. Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces; understand business impact and make sound technical trade-offs between short-term and long-term needs.
4. Identify and resolve root causes of endemic problems, including areas where your team limits the innovation of other teams.
5. Communicate technical designs and decisions effectively in writing, including for technical non-engineering audiences when required.
6. Actively coach and mentor multiple engineers, fostering growth within and beyond your team.
7. Drive adoption of engineering best practices—code organization, clarity, simplicity, error handling, and documentation.
8. Collaborate effectively across a large organization (software development, QA, Project/Release Management, Build and Release, etc.) and create the right checkpoints with dependent teams to ensure successful delivery.
9. Proactively identify architecture deficiencies and simplify existing systems and solutions.
10. Deliver frequently and incrementally, balancing speed of delivery with building the right foundation for the future.

About the team
We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

title: Software Development Engineer, Billing Data Services
descriptionHtml:
We make AWS billing data trustworthy at the source. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Billing Data Services (BiDS) team, you will build and operate the foundational systems that capture, store, and serve the billing facts that AWS billing services rely on.

Our services sit upstream of bill computation systems. We ingest billing data from across AWS (such as pricing, subscriptions, and entitlements), persist it as a single source of truth, and serve it to the teams and pipelines that join it with usage to synthesize customer-facing billing artifacts. We operate at the scale of all of AWS, where correctness is non-negotiable and a single bad record can ripple into thousands of customer bills.

As a software engineer on this team, you will develop and improve large-scale distributed systems built on AWS services. You will learn new technologies, design durable storage and serving paths, and build the data layer that hundreds of AWS teams depend on. Your work will impact millions of external customers and sit on the critical path of Billing.

Key job responsibilities
- Write high-quality, efficient, and testable code in Java and other object-oriented languages.
- Build large-scale, highly available distributed systems for ingesting, storing, and serving authoritative billing data at the scale of all of AWS.
- Design storage and serving paths that meet demanding freshness, accuracy, and latency requirements for downstream billing pipelines.
- Partner with downstream teams on schema and data contract changes, making sure migrations are backward compatible and do not disrupt their pipelines.
- Own and operate the systems you build, holding a high bar for data quality, correctness, and operational rigor.
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement as a member of a Scrum team.
- Collaborate with product managers and engineers across Commerce Platform teams to deliver features and drive the adoption of best practices.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing ingestion and data quality dashboards before joining a design review for a new storage or serving path. By midday, you are working with a downstream team on a schema or data contract change, making sure the migration is backward compatible and won't disrupt their pipelines. In the afternoon, you are deep in an approach to cut serving latency or raise ingestion throughput, then aligning with a partner team on an upstream event format change. You balance long-term platform investments with the immediate needs of the teams that depend on your data.

About the team
We own the systems that hold and serve the authoritative billing facts for AWS Commerce Platform services. BiDS delivers timely and consistent operational billing data to support near real-time bill computation and cost and usage monitoring for AWS, giving billing teams a high-performance, queryable, and cost-effective data layer to store and access operational billing data.

Because we sit upstream of the bill computation systems, our data quality and freshness affect SLAs for the systems downstream. We treat correctness and operational rigor as first principles, but we move quickly when downstream teams and customers need us. We solve problems at the intersection of large-scale data systems, durable storage, and the trust customers place in their bill. This is a space where being right matters more than anything, and where the data we own touches every Billing team.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Duales Studium - BWL
descriptionHtml:
Ein Job im Operations-Bereich bei Amazon versetzt dich ins Zentrum dessen, wie Dinge vom Klick bis zur Haustür gelangen. Du hilfst dabei, Systeme zu entwerfen, zu verbessern und zu betreiben, die Menschen, Produkte und Orte miteinander verbinden – und das in großem Maßstab. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Teams zusammen, um reale Herausforderungen zu lösen, und siehst die direkten Ergebnisse deiner Entscheidungen, wenn sie täglich bei den Kunden ankommen. Hier ist die Wirkung dessen, was du aufbaust, nicht abstrakt – sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam – und hält eine der komplexesten Betriebsorganisationen der Welt am Laufen. Hier nimmt deine Reise Gestalt an – durch Handeln, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, in viele Richtungen zu wachsen Dein Einstieg in die Führung - Das Duale Studium bei Amazon
- Studiengang: BWL / Logistikmanagement (B.A.)
- Studienpartner: IU Internationale Hochschule (30+ Standorte deutschlandweit)
- Programmbeginn: 1. August 2027
- Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
- Einsatzorte: mehr als 20 Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland (Fulfillment Center und Sort Center)
Das duale Studium bei Amazon ist ein strukturiertes Führungsentwicklungsprogramm, das dich Schritt für Schritt auf eine operative Führungsrolle vorbereitet. Wer das Programm erfolgreich abschließt, hat die Chance direkt eine Position als Area Manager:in in unserem Netzwerk zu bekommen - ohne weiteres Bewerbungsverfahren.
________________________________________
Drei Phasen auf dem Weg zur Führungskraft
Das Programm ist in drei aufeinander aufbauende Phasen gegliedert, die deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich erweitern.
Phase 1 - Operative Grundlagen: Zunächst lernst du die operativen Abläufe im Fulfillment Center von Grund auf kennen, analysierst Kennzahlen und setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung um.
Phase 2 - Rotation & Führungsentwicklung: Anschließend rotierst du durch verschiedene operative Bereiche, übernimmst schrittweise Führungsaufgaben - von der Begleitung der Team Leads über Schichtplanung bis hin zur Personalsteuerung - und entwickelst ein Verständnis für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge.
Phase 3 - Area-Manager-Niveau: In der Abschlussphase arbeitest du auf Area-Manager-Niveau: Du steuerst operative Kennzahlen, führst Teams eigenständig und trägst echte Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

Das bieten wir dir
• Karriereperspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Programms wechselst du direkt in eine Area Manager Position im Amazon-Netzwerk - ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren
• Studienfinanzierung: Amazon übernimmt die Studiengebühren an der IU
• Mentoring: Strukturierte Begleitung durch Learning Manager:in und operative Führungskräfte
• Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem europaweiten Operations-Netzwerk
• Mobilität: Kostenloses Deutschlandticket
• Verpflegung: Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten am Standort
• Mitarbeitervorteile: Vielfältige Vorteile, wie ein Amazon Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Technologie: Arbeite täglich mit modernster Automatisierungs- und Robotiktechnologie

Key job responsibilities
• Analyse und Optimierung operativer Prozesse in Fulfillment- und Sortierbereichen
• Eigenständige Durchführung von Continuous Improvement Projekten mit messbaren Ergebnissen
• Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben im Rahmen von Lead-Rotationen (Schichtverantwortung, Teamsteuerung, KPI-Management)
• Mitarbeit an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten in den Bereichen Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Personalwesen und Technik
• Vorbereitung auf die eigenständige Steuerung eines operativen Bereichs als Area Manager:in
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen Team innerhalb des europäischen Amazon-Netzwerks

A day in the life
Deine Betreuung im Programm
Du bist nicht allein. Während des gesamten Programms wirst du von zwei Seiten unterstützt:
• Dein:e Learning Manager:in am Standort begleitet dich durch alle drei Phasen, ist deine zentrale Ansprechperson und koordiniert deine Entwicklung
• Operative Führungskräfte mentoren dich während deiner Rotationen und geben dir direktes Feedback aus der Praxis
Zusätzlich bist du Teil einer deutschlandweiten Community dualer Student:innen - ein Netzwerk, das mit dir wächst.

________________________________________
Dein Alltag: Theorie und Praxis im Wochentakt
Das Studium läuft parallel zur Praxis - keine langen Blockphasen, sondern ein wöchentlicher Rhythmus:
• 2 Tage Studium an deinem IU-Standort (Logistik, Supply Chain, BWL, Personalführung)
• 2-3 Tage / 20 Stunden im Amazon Fulfillment Center oder Sort Center

Du bist kein Besucher im Betrieb. Du bist Teil des Teams - von Tag eins an.

Basic qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Our Multi-Site Leaders are responsible for all budgetary, people development and operations objectives for multiple facilities. Their responsibilities include managing and leading teams across various locations, coaching and mentoring to ensure performance objectives are met and building leadership bench strength within the organization. The leader in this role must be nimble, demonstrate high judgment, make quick decisions in the face of ambiguity, and be strong in innovation. As we continue to grow, we will rely on smart and scalable practices to enable execution of a best-in-class operation and drive cost down.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer. Amazon Grocery Logistics (AGL) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to innovate for the last mile customer experience.

Responsibilities:
• Drives creation of quality initiatives, process change initiatives and other Lean initiatives meet and exceed business plan.
• Responsible for the overall safety, quality and performance and customer experience of their facilities.

title: Applied Scientist II, Amazon Search
descriptionHtml:
We are embarking on a multi-year journey to improve the shopping experience for customers globally. Amazon Search team creates customer-focused search solutions and technologies that make shopping delightful and effortless for our customers. Our goal is to understand what customers are looking for in whatever language happens to be their choice at the moment and help them find what they need in Amazon's vast catalog of billions of products — starting from the very first keystroke.

As Amazon expands to new interfaces, we are faced with the unique challenge of maintaining the bar on Search Results Quality and Search Autocomplete.

We are looking for a Applied Scientist II to work on improving search on Amazon using NLP, ML, and DL technology. As an Applied Scientist, you will lead our efforts in query understanding, semantic matching, and ranking. You will build systems that anticipate search query intent and surface the right results. As part of this role, you will develop high precision, high recall, and low latency solutions for search. Your solutions should work for all languages that Amazon supports and will be used in all Amazon locales world-wide. You will develop scalable science and engineering solutions that work successfully in production.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on the team, you will lead science innovation to improve the customer search experience through higher-quality search results. You will:
- Develop and deploy ML models to produce relevant search results.
- Design and train semantic matching models (bi-encoders, cross-encoders, and distillation from large foundation models) for ranking and relevance.
- Develop reinforcement learning and reward-modeling approaches to continuously improve search results quality.
- Train multi-objective ranking and scoring systems that balance suggestion diversity, specificity, and relevance.
- Design and implement scalable model architectures optimized for strict latency constraints, including knowledge distillation, quantization, and efficient inference strategies for production deployment.
- Lead end-to-end science projects from problem formulation through production launch, collaborating closely with engineers and scientists within and outside the team to deliver customer-facing impact.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

title: System Development Engineer - AWS Cloudfront, AWS Cloudfront, Platform Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon CloudFront is one of the fastest growing, lowest latency and highest throughput services in all of AWS. CloudFront is a fast content delivery (CDN) service that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to customers globally with low latency, high transfer speeds, all within a developer-friendly environment. We bring the Internet closer to end users, speeding up the user experience. CloudFront is integrated with physical locations that are directly connected to the global infrastructure, as well as other services. CloudFront enables multiple services including Shield for DDoS mitigation, Amazon S3, Elastic Load Balancing or Amazon EC2 as origins for your applications, and Lambda@Edge to run custom code closer to users and to customize the user experience. Amazon CloudFront uses a global network of edge locations to cache and route requests to the best possible location based on known latency, available capacity and many other factors. Amazon CloudFront’s Engineering team is looking for an experienced Systems Development Engineer to build and develop new hardware and provisioning platforms, and build automation and tooling of critical service reliability and efficient functions that are secure, massively scale, are fault-tolerant, and global. - Building systems to maintain good “fleet hygiene” and hardware lifecycle management
- Identifying and developing processes, and tools to address top operational issues.

- Own one of the lowest latency and highest throughput services in all of AWS
- Work closely with a great team of software developers and principal engineers

You will automate and scale our the hardware lifecycle process to be efficient, durable, and fault tolerant. You will ensure our servers are properly provisioned, patched, upgraded, and in service all the time.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Selection Quality, Health and Seller tools System for Amazon Now. This product will help category teams identify demand-backed selection opportunities, understand what selection is available across the broader network, move approved selection through publishing workflows, and monitor whether live selection remains healthy for customers.
