title: Principal Product Manager - AI & Cloud Media Services, AWS Elemental Media Services, Elemental Media Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elemental Inference is an AI-powered video understanding service that analyzes live and file-based video in real time, producing structured metadata that drives monetization, content transformation, and audience engagement at scale. The service delivers capabilities including intelligent video reframing, real-time highlight detection, automated subtitling, and contextual metadata for advertising workflows. Our customers today include the world's largest broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues. The core technology, real-time visual understanding at scale, is applicable to any domain where video carries signal that needs to be extracted and acted on.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of Elemental Inference. This is a single-threaded owner role. You will define what we build, why we build it, and how we bring it to market. You will work directly with applied scientists training video foundation models, engineers operating a real-time inference service, and customers running production workloads on it.

This role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of AI/ML product development and commercial execution. You will own the P&L, define pricing and packaging strategy, and drive adoption across a portfolio that spans AI inference, video monetization, and content intelligence. You will make trade-off decisions between expanding into new capabilities and verticals versus deepening quality and reducing cost on what exists today. You will represent Elemental Inference to AWS leadership, cross-org partners, and directly to customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and P&L for Elemental Inference. Set pricing, define packaging, monitor revenue, and adjust GTM approach based on adoption data and customer feedback.
- Prioritize features based on customer requirements, revenue impact, competitive dynamics, and technical feasibility. Make explicit scope decisions between breadth (new capabilities, new verticals) and depth (quality, latency, cost).
- Partner with the applied science team on model roadmap decisions. Translate customer needs into science requirements and define the bar for production readiness.
- Drive cross-service integration with adjacent Elemental services (monetization, live encoding, VOD processing) to deliver end-to-end intelligent media workflows.
- Lead cross-org initiatives that span multiple AWS organizations, building alignment on joint product development where shared customer problems require coordinated solutions.
- Engage directly with strategic enterprise customers to validate product direction, close design partnerships, and drive adoption of launched features.
- Define and manage the partner ecosystem strategy for data dependencies (sports data providers, content licensing) that enable product capabilities.
- Identify and evaluate expansion opportunities where the core technology creates value in adjacent domains beyond the service's initial market.
- Represent Elemental Inference at industry events and with AWS leadership. Communicate product vision, competitive positioning, and business performance with clarity.

About the team
AWS Elemental provides the most comprehensive portfolio of media services in the cloud, purpose-built to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video at global scale. We support technology that delivers outstanding viewing experiences to millions of viewers worldwide, from the largest live sporting events to 24/7 linear channels and on-demand libraries. Our customers include the world's leading broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the media, video, streaming, or advertising technology industry
- Experience with real-time inference systems or video processing at scale
- Experience working directly with applied science or machine learning teams on model development decisions

Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les clients pour concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et moderniser des applications afin de tirer pleinement parti du cloud AWS, notamment via les techniques de modernisation accélérées par l'IA générative (GenAI). Vous serez un acteur clé de la réussite des clients dans leur adoption du cloud, en apportant votre expertise technique et les bonnes pratiques à chaque étape du cycle de vie des projets.

En tant que Consultant en livraison – Modernisation d'applications, vous mettrez votre expertise au service de la conception d'architectures complexes, évolutives et sécurisées, taillées sur mesure pour chaque client. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir les besoins, évaluer les applications existantes et proposer des stratégies de migration efficaces vers AWS. Conseiller de confiance de nos clients, vous les guiderez sur les tendances du secteur, les technologies émergentes et les solutions innovantes, et piloterez la mise en œuvre des projets en garantissant le respect des bonnes pratiques, l'optimisation des performances et la maîtrise des risques tout au long du projet.

L'organisation AWS Professional Services est une équipe mondiale d'experts qui aide les clients à concrétiser leurs objectifs métiers grâce au cloud AWS. Nous collaborons avec les équipes clientes et le réseau de partenaires AWS (APN) pour mener des initiatives cloud en entreprise. Notre équipe propose une gamme de prestations qui aide les clients à atteindre des résultats concrets dans leur adoption du cloud en entreprise. Nous apportons également des conseils ciblés via nos pôles d'expertise mondiaux, couvrant un large éventail de solutions, de technologies et de secteurs d'activité.
-------------------------------------------------
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant – Application Modernization, to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, develop, implement and re-engineer applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud, including GenAI-accelerated modernization techniques. You'll be a key leader in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

As a Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization, you will be proficient in leading the architecture of complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current applications, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions AWS complexes, évolutives et sécurisées, adaptées aux besoins des clients
• Fournir des conseils techniques et un support au dépannage tout au long du projet
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir les besoins et proposer des stratégies de migration efficaces
• Agir comme conseiller de confiance auprès des clients sur les tendances du secteur et les technologies émergentes
• Partager les connaissances au sein de l'organisation par le mentorat, la formation et la création d'artefacts réutilisables
• Aider les clients à moderniser leurs applications existantes via des approches éprouvées comme la migration progressive (Strangler Fig) et l'isolation par couche (Anti-Corruption Layer).
• Décomposer les architectures monolithiques en microservices et architectures serverless (Lambda, ECS/EKS, Fargate, Step Functions, EventBridge)
• Moderniser les stacks technologiques existantes (par exemple, .NET Framework vers .NET Core, Java EE vers Spring Boot, transformation mainframe/COBOL)
• Moderniser les bases de données à l'aide de RDS, Aurora, DMS et des outils de conversion de schéma
• Intervenir comme référent technique aux côtés des équipes métiers, de développement et d'infrastructure des clients
-------------------------------------------------
• Designing and implementation of complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
• Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
• Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
• Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
• Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
• Helping customers modernize legacy applications using proven patterns such as strangler fig and anti-corruption layers
• Decomposing monoliths into microservices and serverless architectures (Lambda, ECS/EKS, Fargate, Step Functions, EventBridge)
• Modernizing legacy stacks (e.g., .NET Framework → .NET Core, Java EE → Spring Boot, mainframe/COBOL transformation)
• Database modernization using RDS, Aurora, DMS, and schema conversion tooling
• Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development and infrastructure teams

A day in the life
AWS Professional Services regroupe des experts provenant de l'ensemble d'AWS qui aident nos clients à concevoir, construire, exploiter et sécuriser leurs environnements cloud. Les clients innovent grâce à AWS Professional Services, développent leurs compétences via AWS Training and Certification, optimisent leurs opérations avec AWS Support et les services gérés, et atteignent leurs objectifs grâce aux services d'assurance sécurité d'AWS. Notre expertise et nos technologies émergentes englobent les partenaires AWS, AWS Sovereign Cloud, les produits AWS à l'international ainsi que le Centre d'innovation en IA générative. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe diversifiée d'experts techniques répartis dans des dizaines de pays, qui aident les clients à accomplir davantage grâce au nuage AWS.
--------------------------------------------------
AWS Professional Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Baccalauréat universitaire, ou 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en conseil, conception et mise en œuvre de solutions serverless distribuées
- 5 ans ou plus d'expérience d'architecture ou d'exploitation de solutions construites sur un fournisseur cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.)
- Expérience dans l'automatisation, le déploiement et l'exploitation d'infrastructures à grande échelle
- Expérience dans la direction de projets d'architecture, de conception et de modernisation d'applications, y compris des solutions cloud (AWS ou équivalent), tirant parti de l'IA et de l'automatisation
- 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en développement logiciel à grande échelle ou en ingénierie applicative, avec une expérience récente de codage dans au moins deux des langages suivants : Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Swift
- 4 ans ou plus d'expérience en intégration continue et livraison continue (CI/CD)
- Capacité à obtenir une habilitation de sécurité fédérale canadienne, ou habilitation Secret ou Top Secret valide
- Uniquement applicable pour les postes situés au Québec : la maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est requise en raison de la nature du poste, qui nécessite des interactions avec d'autres entités Amazon à l'échelle mondiale ainsi qu'avec des employés et parties prenantes Amazon dans d'autres provinces du Canada
- --------------------------------------------
- Bachelor's degree, or 5+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
- 5+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience leading application architecture/design/modernization projects, including cloud-based solutioning (AWS or equivalent), with AI and automation
- Experience using agentic coding tools (Kiro, Kiro-CLI, or similar) and GenAI services such as Amazon Bedrock to accelerate modernization work, including code understanding, refactoring, test generation, and documentation
- 5+ years experience of large-scale software development or application engineering with recent coding experience in two or more of: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Swift.
- 4+ years experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
- Ability to obtain Canadian federal security clearance, or valid Secret or Top Secret clearance.
- Only applicable for Quebec location: fluency in French and English is required due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada.

Preferred qualifications

- Certification AWS de niveau Professional
- Expérience pratique démontrée dans la modernisation d'applications d'entreprise complexes
- Expérience pratique démontrée dans la création d'applications infonuagiques
- Expérience dans l'utilisation d'outils de codage agentiques (Kiro, Kiro-CLI ou similaires) et de services GenAI tels qu'Amazon Bedrock pour accélérer la modernisation, notamment la compréhension de code, le refactoring, la génération de tests et la documentation
- Expérience des exigences de conformité et de gestion des risques IT (sécurité, protection des données, SOX, HIPAA, etc.)
- Expérience AWS souhaitée, avec une maîtrise d'un large éventail de services AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation, etc.)
- Expérience en automatisation et en scripting (Terraform, Python, etc.)
- Solides compétences en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer des concepts techniques à des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques
- Capacité avérée à promouvoir les bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle en matière de tests, gestion de versions, revues de code et processus de déploiement et de mise en production
- ---------------------------------------------
- AWS Professional level certification
- Demonstrated hands-on experience modernizing complex enterprise applications
- Demonstrated hands-on experience building sophisticated cloud native applications
- Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (e.g. security, privacy, SOX, HIPAA etc.)
- AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
- Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Proven ability to lead software engineering best practices across testing, source control, code reviews, and deployment/release management processes

title: Sr. Procurement Category Manager, Data Center Sourcing and Procurement (DCSP)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure team provides AWS and Amazon.com with the compute, network and datacenter capacity that are the foundations of the retail and cloud business. We are seeking a Procurement professional to support the APAC data center procurement space in India.

As a Sr. Procurement Category Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for the complex construction procurement and related categories and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

Key job responsibilities
Manage General Contractor and Construction Procurement category Strategy and Delivery for India

Construction material supply chain sourcing and program management

Achieve cost savings through negotiations, value engineering through the supply chain, and strategic initiatives

Analyze category data and metrics to establish and implement procurement category strategies

Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns across categories and regions to influence customers’ priorities

Provide in-depth knowledge about the supply market and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically, to the business.

Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost

Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance

Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships

Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle

Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as management of contracts post-execution

Some travel may be required, up to 25%.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience
- 6+ years of related industry experience
- 8+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
- 8+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
- Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies
- Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
- Experience in program, project or product management, or leading product implementation

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
- Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners
- Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)

title: Staff Pharmacist - San Antonio, TX, Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!

Work schedule: Monday - Friday 2:00 PM - 10: 30 PM

#everydaybetter

Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment
• Support operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
• Identify and report quality or safety concerns promptly while maintaining compliance with
all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy
- Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal/state regulations concerning patient care
- Can have an active and unrestricted pharmacist license in your state of employment (additional licenses may be required)
- Proficiency with basic computer functions and pharmacy systems

Preferred qualifications

- Exemplary interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality

title: Sr Electrical Hardware Development Engineer, Amazon Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to design and develop electronic hardware and related Avionic systems and architecture for Prime Air Drones. This includes, Avionic compute and Avionics distributed systems hardware. In this role you will be working with our Seattle based team to help to deploy new hardware and Avionics architecture systems for Prime Air Drones. You will work with internal and external vendors to support hardware development, manufacturing and test.

Export Control License: This position may require a deemed export control license for compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Placement is contingent on Amazon's ability to apply for and obtain an export control license on your behalf

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will help the team in the following ways:
-Architecture and Hardware Designs, develops, Avionic compute and distributed system hardware (air data probes, lidar, radar, gnss antennas)
-Design and test other analog/digital devices components such as navigation hardware, satellite communication, air data probes, DC-DC converts and protection circuitry.
-Perform electrical analyses, circuit simulation, components sizing and selection, create electrical schematics and PCB layouts.
-Support engineering trades, estimates and interact with suppliers/partners on critical components and develop hardware from concept to mass production.
-Support developing hardware and component level requirements/specifications.
-Increase the engineering rigor behind designs, verification, and documentation.
-Perform prototype hardware and systems in labs.
-Perform formal verification testing including DO-160 and DO-254
If this sounds like the role for you, come make history with us!


About the team
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization.

How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog(https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).
If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.

Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!

Basic qualifications

- Experience in component selection and understanding of component reliability
- Experience in motherboard design, PCB design including schematic capture, stackup and circuit board layout
- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 6+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- 6+ years of electrical engineering work experience in Consumer Electronics, Power Electronics, Robotics, Aerospace, Automotive, and/or Communications fields or combination thereof.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience collaborating with the ECAD/physical board designer and able to review PCB designs with Allegro, CAM350, or equivalent
- 5+ years of developing electrical schematics using AutoCAD Electrical (2010 or newer) experience
- 5+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience

title: Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーター, Central Operations
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパンAmazon Logistics(以下、AMZL)部門のセントラルオペレーションチームでは急速に拡大している物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルネットワークを円滑に運営するために注文数の予測や配送ドライバー台数の計画、運用方法を改革していくことを目指したオペレーションを構築します。そのため、イノベーションと問題解決に情熱を持ち、世界最高レベルの顧客体験を創造する能力を持つLogistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターを募集しています。日本にある全てのAMZLデリバリーステーション(以下、DS)をサポートする重要な役割を担っていただきます。

勤務形態は40時間/週、日勤・夜勤8時間勤務のシフト制(土日祝日含む)となります。シフトにより年末年始の勤務あり。

関連情報
・所属部門:ラストマイル(AMZL)
・職種:オペレーション

https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp


Key job responsibilities
全国のDSの配送オペレーションを横断的にサポートしていただく役割を担って頂きます。支える役割を担っていただきます。具体的には荷物量の予測からドライバーの配車計画、配送ルート作成、当日のリアルタイム対応まで、マネージャーやチームと連携しながら以下の業務を遂行します：
1. 配送計画の策定・調整: 全国のDSに対し、日次の荷物量予測に基づきドライバー台数・配送ルートを計画し、リアルタイムで最適化する
2. オペレーション異常への即時対応: 遅延・災害等の発生時に、配送ルート再編成やステークホルダーへの情報共有を迅速に実施し、配送サービス・納期を維持する
3. パフォーマンスの可視化・報告: 日次・週次のオペレーションレポートを作成し、改善機会をマネージャーに提案する
4. オペレーション拡大時の準備・実行: セールイベントや新規サービス・システム導入時に、手順変更の検討・標準作業手順書（SOP）の作成・トレーニング教材の構築を行い、円滑な導入を推進する
5. 業務標準化・改善の推進: チームメンバーとステークスホルダーと協力し、データに基づいた業務プロセスの改善と標準化を推進する

A day in the life
あなたの1日は、全国のDS状況をリアルタイムで把握することから始まります。シフト開始時に朝礼を行い、当日の業務内容を確認します。配送計画、リアルタイム対応、改善推進など、専門チームごとに担当領域が分かれており、あなたの強みや適性に応じたチームに配属されます。
シフト中は、複数のモニターで状況を監視しながら、配送計画の策定・調整業務を行います。突発的な遅延や天候変化に対応する場面もあります。あなたが支えるのは、デリバリーステーションに荷物が届く前からお客様の手元に届くまでの全プロセスです。1人で判断するのではなく、チームメンバーと連携しながらリアルタイムで最適な解決策を見つけていきます。
また、日々のオペレーション対応だけでなく、「もっとこうすれば効率的になるのでは？」というアイデアをチームに提案し、改善プロジェクトを主動していただきます。前職での経験や視点を活かして、新しい仕組みづくりに貢献できる環境です。


About the team
■セントラルオペレーション■
セントラルオペレーションは複数のチームからなる300人を超える大規模な組織です。大多数は日本語を母語とするメンバーですが、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが世界中から集まっています。多様性(DEI)が尊重され、安心して働ける環境です。

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており、仕事とプライベートの両方を充実させることができます。

まずは試してみることを大切にしています。好奇心を持って学び、時にはリスクを取りながら、よりよい成果に繋げていく文化があります。

■キャリアパス■
Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターからキャリアをスタートし、チームのマネージャーとなった実績も多数あります。また、社内公募制度を通じて、国内外の他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。

Basic qualifications

- 高校卒業以上
- PCスキル（WordやExcelなどで文書作成や表作成ができる能力）、但し業務を通じて向上させる意欲があること）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（文書の作成・読解能力）
- 翻訳を活用しながらでもコミュニケーションをとることができる英語力

Preferred qualifications

- 4年制大学での学士号
- チーム内でリーダーシップを発揮し、プロジェクトを完遂した経験
- マネジメント経験（人数・期間は問わず）
- 定量的なデータ分析をもとに、業務改善・標準化を実施した経験

- ビジネスレベルの英語力

title: Embedded Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are breaking new ground with every device we design, from custom silicon to secure software, to enable innovative satellite and ground systems. Be part of a team that pushes the boundaries of satellite communications technology to make global connectivity a reality.

As a Device Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Leo Satellite Gateway team, you will design and develop embedded software for Amazon Leo's satellite and ground systems. You’ll work on fault-tolerant, real-time platforms, collaborating closely with hardware, software systems, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the next generation of space-based communication systems with minimal legacy constraints. Your work will directly support critical government initiatives, enabling secure and high-performance communication systems for U.S. and allied missions.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Develop embedded software in C, C++, and Python, and Linux kernel drivers.
• Write device drivers and system applications for the various satellite systems.
• Write software to interact with micro-controllers
• Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers and device-tree overlays for SPI, I3C, I2C, CAN, GPIO, DMA and UIO interfaces.
• Work closely with other software and hardware teams to support board bring-up and integration testing.
• Build and maintain the Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution: BitBake recipes and layers, A/B partition boot, secure boot, eMMC and NOR storage, and SWUpdate image generation.
• Leverage modern application frameworks for Embedded Linux and bare-metal/AMP platforms to develop scalable, modular, and high-performance software.
• Debug and resolve complex hardware-software integration issues using tools like logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.
• Develop kernel features required to support upcoming hardware and software capabilities, targeting AMD/Xilinx Versal and Zynq SoCs.


A day in the life
As part of the Satellite Gateway team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Amazon Leo products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of embedded firmware development experience
- 2+ years of experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded or a comparable embedded Linux build system

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 3+ years of experience on networking and/or consumer devices using embedded Linux, Yocto, and/or bare-metal targets; experience with eBPF/libbpf or Lua tooling.
- 2+ years of experience in manufacturing diagnostics through production phases like Hardware Validation Testing (HVT), Engineering Validation Testing (EVT), Device Validation Testing (DVT), Production Validation Testing (PVT)

title: Senior Security Engineer, Operational Research and Development
descriptionHtml:
We are building systems that investigate and remediate security incidents at machine speed, reducing human intervention from triage to eradication to the strict minimum. Join us to define what autonomous incident response looks like at the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

Amazon Security's Operational Research and Development team combines deep security expertise with software engineering to transform how AWS responds to security events. We don't just build tools for responders; we build the intelligence that replaces manual investigation entirely: automated log dives, DFIR pipelines, fix identification, and autonomous mitigation.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Security Engineer, you will:
- Own the response playbooks and investigation methodology that power our automation platforms
- Design and implement autonomous incident response workflows: from initial triage through root cause analysis to remediation
- Build automated DFIR capabilities including log correlation, forensic evidence collection, and threat eradication at cloud scale
- Drive the security domain decisions (how to investigate, when to act, what to fix) while partnering with SDEs on platform scalability
- Participate in an on-call rotation focused on maintaining automation health, and seucrity escalations

About the team
The Operational Research and Development team sits within Amazon Security. We are a mixed team of Security Engineers and Software Development Engineers who share a single mission: make security incident response so fast and accurate that human involvement becomes a choice, not a necessity.

Our engineers own what they build. Each person carries meaningful end-to-end ownership of production systems, from design through deployment and operational excellence. We prototype rapidly, ship iteratively, and treat every manual step in our response pipelines as a problem to solve permanently.

The team values directness, intellectual honesty, and a bias toward building over discussing. We maintain a flexible, distributed working culture and core collaboration hours that respect personal time.

We are intentional about building an inclusive environment where diverse backgrounds and perspectives drive better security outcomes. Whether your path to security engineering was traditional or not, what matters is your ability to think critically about threats and translate that thinking into systems that act autonomously.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Revenue Cycle Analyst, AI & Process Innovation, Healthcare Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Healthcare Finance Operations Services as a Revenue Cycle Defect Analyst focused on identifying, documenting, and validating revenue cycle defects that impact financial performance. In this role, you will serve as a critical individual contributor responsible for defining defects within billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. You will hypothesize about potential defects, design and execute experiments to prove their existence and impact, and package findings into structured defect analyses that enable technology and operations teams to implement solutions.

Through data-driven analysis and manual review, you will identify patterns among aged receivables, analyze billing and cash receipts reports, and surface trends that contribute to revenue leakage, claim denials, and operational inefficiencies. You will leverage your knowledge of AI-assisted analytics and statistical methods to strengthen the rigor of your findings, ensuring that each defect paper provides clear evidence, quantified impact, and actionable root cause analysis.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare revenue cycle expertise, demonstrates exceptional analytical capabilities, possesses an eye for detail and process improvement, and has a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, evidence-based documentation. Experience with statistical methods, AI-enabled tools, and a passion for experimentation are highly valued.

The Finance Operations organization works with every part of Amazon to provide procure-to-pay, revenue-to-receipt, real-estate and facilities, operations accounting and operations excellence services with the highest level of controllership at the lowest cost to the company. We provide the backbone systems and operational processes which completely, accurately, and validly pay Amazon's suppliers, invoice our customers and report financial results. Amazon is quickly building the Finance Operations capabilities in the healthcare industry by creating the Healthcare Finance Operations Services.


Key job responsibilities
In this analytical role, you will identify and investigate revenue cycle defects across billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. Your primary focus will be discovering issues through data analysis, forming hypotheses about root causes, and running targeted experiments to validate your findings before packaging them into structured documentation for stakeholder action.

- Analyze coding, charge capture, billing, cash receipts, and accounts receivable reports and activities to identify defects, anomalies, and trends that impact revenue, cash flow, and operational efficiency
- Hypothesize about potential defects based on observed patterns, denial trends, and system behaviors, then design and execute experiments (through analytics or manual review) to prove or disprove defect existence and quantify impact
- Package validated defects into structured defect analyses that clearly articulate the problem, evidence, root cause analysis, quantified financial impact, and recommended resolution path for technology and operations stakeholders
- Leverage AI-enabled tools and awareness of emerging AI/ML capabilities to enhance defect detection, automate pattern recognition, and improve the speed and accuracy of analytical workflows
- Apply statistical methods and experimental design principles to ensure rigor in defect validation, including appropriate sampling, significance testing, and data-driven conclusions
- Identify trends and categories among aged receivables, denial patterns, and payer behaviors; provide clear, actionable feedback to stakeholders to improve results and prevent recurrence
- Identify trends and develop insights that ultimately reduce cost and improve revenue lift
- Analyze workflow and operational procedures to identify opportunities for improved reimbursement; document findings and present recommendations to leadership
- Produce clear, well-structured technical writing including defect analyses, root cause analyses, and process documentation that effectively communicates complex findings and processes to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Coordinate cross-functionally to analyze data drivers, develop comprehensive insights, and present clear, actionable findings to key stakeholders including technology teams, operations, and finance
- Contribute to the evaluation of AI initiatives and explore how automation, machine learning, and robotic process automation (RPA) can enhance defect detection and resolution workflows

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience within registration, scheduling, billing, cash collection, cash application, or denial management/follow-up
- Medical billing experience with an understanding of healthcare reimbursement processes, third-party payer guidelines, and compliance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to analyze processes and information, identify problems and trends, and develop effective solutions and strategies
- Strong technical writing skills with the ability to clearly document findings, articulate complex issues, and communicate effectively in written form to diverse stakeholders
- Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and exhibit problem-solving skills with an exceptional eye for detail

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience in a hospital or physician provider setting
- Coursework or applied experience in statistics, experimental design, or quantitative research methods
- Professional certifications such as CPC (Certified Professional Coder) or CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
- Awareness of AI/ML tools and their application to data analysis, pattern recognition, and process automation in revenue cycle contexts
- Experience writing structured analyses, research papers, or technical documentation that translates complex findings for diverse audiences
- Extensive knowledge of critical business processes including Coding, Charge Capture, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute and Denial Management
- Knowledge of system interfaces with Accounts Receivable and experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data and determining root causes
- Experience creating process improvements through analysis and automation
- Experience with electronic health record systems and clearinghouse platforms

title: Tecnico/a de Ingenieria de Mantenimiento
descriptionHtml:
El equipo de ingeniería de mantenimiento y fiabilidad (RME) de Amazon es fundamental para nuestras operaciones, ya que se encarga de mantener la maquinaria esencial en funcionamiento de forma permanente. Como técnico/a de mantenimiento, te encargarás de revisar una gran variedad de maquinaria y espacios de trabajo, velando siempre por las buenas prácticas en materia de salud y seguridad. Ayudarás a proteger a los miembros de tu equipo y a prevenir las interrupciones de la actividad. Nuestros/as técnicos/as de mantenimiento y fiabilidad multiplican la disponibilidad y calidad de nuestra maquinaria, además de procurar la mejora del entorno operativo.

Key job responsibilities
Llevar a cabo tareas de mantenimiento proactivo y de prevención de una gran variedad de equipos.
Realizar reparaciones reactivas y diagnósticos de averías en un almacén de distribución en funcionamiento.
Utilizar las herramientas más modernas para maximizar la eficacia de los equipos.
Respetar todas las políticas y prácticas en materia de salud y seguridad.
Contribuir al desarrollo y la formación de los empleados en prácticas.
Trabajar en proyectos de mejora continua e implantar buenas prácticas en distintos centros de la UE.

A day in the life
Nuestros/as técnicos/as de mantenimiento y fiabilidad trabajan sobre el terreno en nuestros centros, lo que les permite responder rápidamente ante cualquier problema que surja con la maquinaria. Te encargarás del mantenimiento preventivo planificado de los equipos de nuestras instalaciones para garantizar que funcionen con seguridad. Como técnico/a de ingeniería de mantenimiento y fiabilidad, también deberás reaccionar con celeridad ante cualquier avería, investigando, identificando y aplicando soluciones lo antes posible. También propondrás mejoras a largo plazo.
Te encargarás de las tareas diarias de mantenimiento, como pintura y fontanería, codo con codo con los miembros sénior de tu equipo, y te pondrás en contacto con contratistas si hace falta ayuda externa. Trabajarás en distintos turnos para garantizar que nuestros centros cuentan con un servicio de asistencia las 24 horas del día, lo que permitirá a Amazon realizar sus entregas a la velocidad acostumbrada.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de ingenieros de mantenimiento y fiabilidad (RME) se encarga de que nuestros sistemas funcionen a pleno rendimiento. Nos caracterizamos por nuestra gran aptitud técnica y nuestra excelente capacidad para el trabajo en equipo, liderados por unos responsables con gran experiencia. Nuestro trabajo comprende el mantenimiento, la reparación y la solución de problemas relacionados con los equipos en toda nuestra red mundial de centros de distribución. El equipo cuenta con una serie de perfiles de dirección que se encargan de supervisar el desarrollo de tecnologías fascinantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.
Nuestro equipo se ocupa de la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon, desempeñando tareas que van desde la instalación de sistemas automatizados de embalaje hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un centro o la reparación de equipos clave de distribución. Esto incluye adaptar los edificios a la legislación vigente, para que todo el personal esté seguro y nuestras instalaciones funcionen con la mayor eficiencia posible. El equipo de RME, al igual que ocurre en otros departamentos de Amazon, ofrece numerosas oportunidades de progresar profesionalmente.
Todo nuestro trabajo gira en torno a reducir los periodos de inactividad en los centros de operaciones cruciales de Amazon, para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Con frecuencia, trabajamos de madrugada o a altas horas de la noche para poder realizar las tareas de mantenimiento ocasionando las mínimas molestias, por lo que hacemos turnos nocturnos. Si descubrimos que hay una forma mejor de hacer algo, tenemos la capacidad y la posibilidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos totalmente nuevos o tecnología punta, como Amazon Robotics y nuestro clasificador de artículos complejos.

title: Account-Based Marketing Manager , NAMER Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a results-driven Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to design and execute high-impact ABM programs for enterprise customers. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive measurable business outcomes through targeted marketing initiatives.

The Account-Based Marketing Manager will own the ABM strategy and end-to-end execution of territory ABM programs, working backwards from customer needs to create data-driven, multi-channel campaigns that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. This role requires strategic marketing expertise, strong project management skills, analytical capabilities, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

We are looking for a marketer who is intellectually curious, analytically grounded and creatively agile; someone who can navigate ambiguity, challenge conventional approaches, and build scalable solutions while maintaining the personalization required for strategic account outreach.


Key job responsibilities
* Develop account-based marketing strategies for priority enterprise customers, translating business objectives, customer insights, account priorities, and market dynamics into actionable 1:1 and 1:few marketing plans.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to Sales, working closely with account teams and Sales leaders to understand customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and determine where marketing can have the greatest impact.
* Build integrated customer engagement initiatives that connect account insights, messaging, content, executive engagement, digital marketing, events, and other channels into cohesive customer experiences.
* Bring creative agility to account challenges, identifying new approaches and developing differentiated programs that engage key decision makers, buying groups, and influencers.
* Own programs from strategy through execution, establishing objectives, developing plans, coordinating cross-functional resources, managing budgets and timelines, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
* Develop account-specific content and messaging that translates account insights, business priorities and AWS capabilities into relevant narratives and assets that engage key decision makers and buying groups.
* Use data and customer intelligence to inform strategy, leveraging engagement data, buying signals, account insights, and market trends to identify opportunities and continuously optimize programs.
* Partner across AWS marketing organizations, including Global CoE, Industry, Partner, Digital, Events, and other teams, to orchestrate AWS capabilities around strategic customer opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to collaborate with AWS partners where joint engagement can strengthen customer value propositions, deepen relationships, or accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Measure business impact, establishing account-level objectives and evaluating engagement, account progression, opportunity acceleration, pipeline influence, revenue contribution, and program ROI.
* Build for scale, identifying successful approaches, codifying best practices, and creating repeatable frameworks that can be adopted across accounts and regions.
* Contribute to the evolution of ABM at AWS, sharing insights, experimentation, and best practices with the broader global ABM community.

A day in the life
The Account-Based Marketing Manager role sits within the NAMER Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing organization and is responsible for accelerating adoption, growth and revenue across our largest and and fastest growing enterprise customers. The ABM Marketer
will develop a deep understanding of the accounts within their portfolio and use those insights to develop and execute account-specific marketing strategies that advance account and business goals. This marketer will partner closely with Sales and Business Development teams to identify opportunities and lead the end to end execution of targeted marketing programs, which may include integrated campaigns, executive engagements, events and other account-specific activations. The ABM Manager will measure performance, optimize strategies based on results and provide regular reporting and insights to key stakeholders and business partners.


About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Strong written and verbal communications skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and clearly articulate program plans, recommendations and results.
- 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, including experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies for enterpise customers or complex B2B audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into marketing strategies and programs
- Experience building and executing cross-functional marketing initiatives from strategy and concept through execution, measurement and optimization.

- Experience using data and analytics to inform marketing strategy, prioritize investments and measure performance

title: Engineering Operation Technician, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Edge Connectivity Services
descriptionHtml:
Edge Connectivity Services enables AWS Cloud connectivity options for US Intelligence and Department of Defense customers. These connectivity options allow our customer to deploy and run their isolated, sensitive workloads in an environment exclusive for their use-case. We help our customers to onboard, manage, and scale their connectivity options for maintaining persistent connection to AWS Isolated cloud.

In this role, you will build network pathways with which customers connect to Amazon's Dedicated Cloud partitions. You'll architect and implement software security protocols across Wide Area Networks (WANs), ensuring seamless and secure access to dedicated cloud environments. By developing sophisticated control and dataplane systems, you'll protect critical customer connections flowing through Amazon's global network of datacenters. You'll leverage the AWS ecosystem and integrate with third-party solutions to create secure pathways that meet our customers' stringent security requirements. Working alongside technology experts across Amazon, you'll define the next generation of dedicated cloud connectivity, setting new standards for enterprise-grade security. title: Sr. Communication Sys Engineer, Modeling and Simulation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a low Earth orbit satellite constellation providing low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The mission of Amazon Leo for Government is to leverage Leo and provide high speed, low latency, and secure satellite services to United States and allied government customers. As a Modeling and Simulation Systems Engineer supporting that mission, this role is primarily responsible for assessing and analyzing how both Leo's capabilities and Leo products built for government perform against government use cases, and for producing the analyses that underpin government contract work. You will evaluate system and network performance from the capacity, coverage, latency, and availability point of view to determine how Leo delivers the operational outcome the customer mission needs. It is a unique opportunity to innovate and define groundbreaking wireless technology with few legacy constraints.

Key job responsibilities
• Own system-level modeling, simulation, and analysis for government mission scenarios and constellation designs, across coverage, capacity, latency, and availability, from concept trades through customer deliverables
• Perform mission engineering: translate customer mission objectives into scenarios and measures of effectiveness, develop design reference missions and CONOPS, and model whether the end-to-end system delivers the required operational outcome
• Apply orbital mechanics, including orbit and constellation geometry, reference frames, revisit and access behavior, and station-keeping and conjunction considerations, as the foundation of coverage, access, and contact analyses
• Design and evaluate resource scheduling and allocation approaches, heuristic or solver-based, for contact scheduling, satellite beam assignment, and prioritization under power, thermal, and spectrum constraints
• Evaluate complex multi-disciplinary trades involving RF bandwidth and network resource allocation to customers, optimizing customer experience against cost, power, and spectrum, including constellation design and link selection trades
• Build and/or utilize RF and optical link budgets and combine them with orbital constellation dynamics to model time-varying system capacity, latency, and availability
• Model inter-satellite geometry and access, including link availability windows, contact scheduling, and handover behavior
• Extend existing simulation code and tools, and create new simulation models representative of the target system (primarily MATLAB, also C++ / Python), designing around hardware and software capabilities and constraints to support a dynamic network topology
• Prepare and present technical content for government customers and program reviews, including analysis packages, visualizations, briefings, and proposal material
• Account for self-interference and interference with other space and terrestrial communication systems in coverage and capacity analyses


Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- 8+ years of experience in satellite or network system design, modeling, and analysis
- Strong understanding of orbital mechanics and constellation geometry, including modeling orbits, reference frames, and vector geometry to simulate the time-varying relative geometry of satellites and ground nodes
- 8+ years of experience developing code in MATLAB, C, C++, or Python, including industry-standard coding and regression practices
- Working knowledge of RF or optical link budgets and how link performance drives system capacity and availability
- Experience with resource scheduling, allocation, or optimization for a communications or satellite system (e.g. contact scheduling, link or beam assignment)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparing and presenting technical content for customers and program reviews

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, a related discipline, or equivalent experience
- Experience with satellite constellation design and constellation management trades
- RF or communications system design and modeling background, covering link-level analysis, communication theory, OFDM/MIMO, and digital/wireless communication systems
- Experience with optical inter-satellite links and space-to-space access analysis
- Experience with graph theory and network topology analysis
- Familiarity with satellite operations, mission planning, and contact scheduling
- Experience supporting government or national security programs and proposals
- Experience with mission engineering or mission-level analysis, including design reference missions, CONOPS development, scenario and vignette analysis, and measures of effectiveness

title: Construction Manager Internship Spring and Summer 2027 (Bellevue, WA)
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places at scale.
You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

IMPORTANT NOTE: This role is based out of Amazon's Bellevue, WA corporate office (SEA104). Applicants must be able to work on-site at our Bellevue, WA office during the spring semester and be available for travel during summer months. During summer months, travel to Amazon fulfillment centers under construction and corporate offices around the US is required.

The Construction Manager (CM) Internship is an on-site part-time internship (20 hours a week) during the Spring 2027 academic season (February 2027 – May/June 2027) based in our Bellevue, WA corporate office.

Upon school release for Summer 2027 (May/June 2027 – July/August 2027) this position shifts to a 12-week internship “full-time” (40 hours/week) with travel opportunities to project sites and Amazon facilities across the United States.

This is a hybrid corporate and field position, combining strategic construction management work in our corporate office environment with hands-on exposure to large-scale industrial building projects at fulfillment centers, construction sites, and job trailer environments.

Amazon’s Global Engineering Services (GES) NA Design & Construction team is looking for innovative and solutions-oriented interns to support our construction management function. Construction Manager interns will support Construction programs to deliver the built facilities and infrastructure that power Amazon’s logistics network — including fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings — through new builds, retrofits, initiatives, and expansions.

In this role, interns work under the guidance and direction of senior Construction Managers, owning specific workstreams and deliverables within larger projects. You will coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, and internal teams to ensure project documentation is current, schedules are tracked, budgets are monitored, and stakeholder communications are maintained. You will serve as a key liaison between field teams and project leadership — ensuring information flows accurately and action items are resolved.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to large-scale industrial construction projects while developing your construction management expertise through hands-on project execution, mentorship from senior CMs, and exposure to the full construction lifecycle.


Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
Support Amazon’s safety programs and standards by monitoring compliance on assigned projects; report safety concerns and near-misses immediately

Assist in coordinating with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) for permitting, regulatory compliance, and inspections

Participate in site safety walks and document findings; track corrective actions to closure

Project & Construction Management
Support concurrent construction projects by owning specific workstreams such as documentation management, punch list tracking, permit coordination, and close-out activities

Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, and internal teams on daily project activities

Review and track submittals, RFIs, change orders, and schedule updates; flag discrepancies to the supervising CM

Assist with site inspections to verify construction quality, progress against schedule, and specification conformance

Maintain accurate project files and documentation in Amazon’s project management systems (BIM 360/ACC, Source, Pimento)

Support project handover activities including punch list management, turnover documentation, and operational readiness coordination
Track project milestones and deliverables; proactively identify potential delays and escalate

Budget, Schedule & Contract Support
Assist with budget tracking and cashflow reporting; maintain accurate cost documentation and flag variances

Support bid package preparation by compiling scope documents, drawing packages, and specification requirements

Track contractor billing and invoice submissions; verify against contracted amounts and milestone completion

Monitor project schedules against baseline; update schedule tracking tools and report progress in weekly meetings

Support contract administration by maintaining contract logs, tracking insurance certificates, and managing document submissions

Assist in reviewing proposed change orders for completeness and accuracy

Contractor & Stakeholder Coordination
Coordinate daily with general contractors and subcontractors on project status, upcoming activities, and logistics

Serve as a liaison between field teams, project leadership, and internal Amazon stakeholders (operations, equipment, IT)

Support managing contractor performance by tracking deliverables, documenting issues, and following up on action items

Assist with vendor onboarding, site access coordination, and resource planning

Coordinate with internal teams on facility readiness, equipment delivery schedules, and operational handover preparation

Communication & Reporting
Prepare weekly project status reports including schedule updates, budget summaries, risk items, and action logs
Attend and support weekly Owner/Architect/Contractor (OAC) meetings; take and distribute meeting minutes; track action items to closure
Update Amazon’s project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information

Communicate clearly and promptly with all internal and external stakeholders on assigned tasks and deliverables

Prepare presentation materials and project summaries as directed by the supervising CM

Learning & Continuous Improvement
Actively develop construction management expertise through on-the-job execution, mentorship, and Amazon training programs
Identify and suggest process improvements within assigned workstreams

Participate in project retrospectives and lessons learned sessions

Seek exposure to all phases of the construction lifecycle to build breadth of knowledge and readiness for advancement

Develop proficiency with Amazon’s construction tools and systems (BIM 360/ACC, Source, Pimento, ACS)


A day in the life
During the spring semester, CM interns work part-time out of SEA104 supporting construction management activities such as coordinating with general contractors on project activities, reviewing and processing RFIs, submittals, and change order requests, preparing project status updates, updating project management systems, and coordinating with internal stakeholders on equipment delivery, facility readiness, and handover preparation. You will work under regular guidance from senior Construction Managers, building your knowledge of construction and project management concepts while contributing to real project deliverables.

During the summer full-time period, interns travel to project sites to support active construction projects, attend OAC meetings, conduct site walks to verify construction progress and document conditions, support punch list tracking and close-out documentation, and gain firsthand exposure to Amazon’s industrial building projects. You will work across multiple stakeholder groups and build effective working relationships while developing toward independence under the mentorship of senior Construction Managers. Travel to various locations across the United States is expected during summer months (up to 80%).

Physical ability to:
1. Work 12-hour shifts on feet (when supporting field operations)
2. Cover extensive distances in large warehouse facilities
3. Use ladders, stairs, and gangways safely
4. Lift/move totes up to 49 lbs
5. Perform frequent bending, stretching, and reaching motions
6. Travel to various locations across the United States during summer months (up to 80%)

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program with all requirements anticipated to be completed between December 2027 and August 2028.
- Able to work on-site at Amazon’s Bellevue, WA corporate office
- Available to work part-time (20 hours/week) during Spring 2027 semester (February 2027 – May/June 2027) from our Bellevue, WA office
