title: Manager III Operations, Quick Commerce Central Flow, NOC, NOC - Central Flow Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). Building on this legacy, Amazon is now redefining speed through Quick Commerce — delivering to customers in minutes, not days.

APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle-free, on-time flow of inventory across all hops — from hubs to Micro-Fulfillment Centers (MFCs) and onward to the customer. In case of any exceptions, the NOC steps in to resolve the issue in real time and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving, the NOC is charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations — work that involves live network monitoring and significant analysis of high-velocity delivery data.

Overall, Quick Commerce Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's ultra-fast delivery promise, and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to delight its customers in minutes.

Key job responsibilities
This role sits at the heart of Central Flow for Quick Commerce, owning end-to-end network flow health across all hops — from hubs into MFCs and every flow in between. As the network's flow steward, the incumbent will:

Identify egregious metrics in real time — spotting flow disruptors, bottlenecks, and exceptions before they cascade.
Coordinate actions across teams — mobilizing operations, tech, program, and field teams to keep the network in flow when disruptions hit.
Build learnings for next time — codifying every intervention into playbooks and reusable recovery frameworks so the network responds faster with each recurrence.
Track until normal state — owning each disruption from detection through recovery, confirming stabilization before closing the loop.
Leadership Scope: The incumbent will lead a team of L2s, L3s, and managers. As Quick Commerce scales, this role will continuously evolve to take on new workstreams — the successful candidate must be energized by ambiguity and comfortable building the plane while flying it.

What We're Looking For: An experienced, hands-on Manager passionate about using data to drive efficiencies and influence decisions. Deep functional knowledge, program-design ability, and defect-reduction experience required. Strong analytical skills and Excel expertise essential; SQL and R/Python a plus. Superb communication, project management, and stakeholder skills, with adeptness in AI tools (Kiro, Amazon Quick).

About the team
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). Building on this legacy of innovation, Amazon is now redefining speed itself through Quick Commerce — delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes, not days.

APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle-free, on-time flow of inventory from dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs), and neighborhood hubs to the customer's doorstep within the promised delivery window (typically 10–30 minutes). In case of any exceptions — a delayed rider, an out-of-stock item, a demand surge, or a hyperlocal supply gap — the NOC steps in in real time to resolve the issue and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings.

Along with this tactical, real-time problem solving, the NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions across dense delivery zones and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations. This second aspect involves live network monitoring, demand forecasting, and significant analysis of high-velocity delivery data.

Overall, Quick Commerce Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's ultra-fast delivery promise and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to delight its customers in minutes.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience establishing processes, workflows, standard procedures and change management

title: Data Center Security Manager, DUB West Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking to hire a customer-obsessed Data Center Security Manager to provide hands-on support to our Data Center Infrastructure Operations team across the DUB Cluster.

As a Data Center Security Manager, you will be tasked with running day-to-day data center security operations, supporting and executing security projects and programs, as well as assuring audit compliance with AWS policies and procedures.

Key job responsibilities
Direct and manage contract guard force to run daily data center operations.
Handle site security incidents, escalations or any other security related issues.
Provide after-hours on-call management support and participate in emergent, large scale event response when needed.
Participate in re-occurring data center security audits and reviews.
Executes established compliance processes with AWS policies, standards, guidelines and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
Provides input on, and may develop security methodologies, policies and procedures.
Write reports and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations.
Oversee new security construction or retrofit projects.
Manage the security P&L for assigned site(s), assist management with financial analysis and contribute to financial decisions for security requirements.
Collaborate with other teams to protect AWS Data Center personnel, information and assets.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply as we focus on talented people who are motivated to learn and be successful in our growing industry. The successful applicant will receive comprehensive onboard training as well as continuous support from a local and regional security team. You will also have opportunities to collaborate and engage with various teams across the globe.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Ability to walk a facility and observe security gaps in physical barriers, security officer procedure, policies, surveillance equipment, and alarm points
Drive campaigns to reduce nuisance alarms
Experience with workflow ticketing and extraction of performance metrics
Investigate accidents, thefts, disturbances, discrepancies
Oversee physical security sub contractors that provide guards, electronic security systems, door construction, door repair, fencing, and access controls
Distill overarching security strategy into daily tactics to reach management goals
Oversee security construction projects
Teach others the proper security processes and methods

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience overseeing security operations and working with security vendors/contractors

Preferred qualifications

- Experience acting as a Program Security Officer, Security Specialist, or Security Manager with duties including interpreting and implementing requirements within the personnel, industrial, and physical security disciplines and overseeing security operations
- Associate's degree, or CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification

title: Senior Delivery Consultant – (Cloud Infrastructure Architect), AWS Professional Services, Media & Entertainment
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help the world's leading media companies reinvent how content is produced, processed, and delivered on the cloud? AWS Professional Services is looking for a Senior Delivery Consultant (Cloud Infrastructure Architect) to join our Media & Entertainment (M&E) team.

As a Senior Delivery Consultant, you will be the trusted technical advisor on our most complex M&E engagements — architecting and delivering cloud solutions for live production, broadcast, playout, media supply chain, and OTT/streaming workloads. You will work hands-on with customers and partners to turn ambiguous business objectives into production-grade architectures on AWS, while shaping reusable IP and influencing AWS service roadmaps for the media industry.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who combines deep AWS technical expertise with real M&E domain knowledge, and who leads by influence across AWS, customer, and partner teams.
221100

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the technical design and delivery of complex M&E cloud solutions (live video, broadcast, playout, media supply chain, OTT) across customer engagements.
- Operate with autonomy in ambiguous environments where the technology strategy and solution design are not yet defined, delivering independently with limited guidance.
- Act as the technical leader on engagements — guiding customers on technology strategy, architecture, and investment decisions, and earning trust with technical and executive stakeholders.
- Collaborate across AWS service teams (e.g. Elemental, MediaConnect, MediaLive), partners, and customer teams; identify and close platform gaps and feed requirements into AWS service roadmaps.
- Transform engagements into reusable assets, reference architectures, and public references that accelerate future customer adoption.
- Mentor and develop other architects and contribute to the M&E technical community and best-practice education.

A day in the life
You'll partner with customers' architecture and engineering teams to solve industry-complex challenges — for example, bringing live/uncompressed video workflows to the cloud, or modernising a media supply chain. A typical day blends hands-on architecture and prototyping, whiteboarding with customer stakeholders, collaborating with AWS service and partner teams, and writing narratives that align business outcomes with technical delivery. You will move fluidly between tactical delivery and strategic influence, often leading across multiple workstreams and diverse groups, and managing escalations with ease. Internal stakeholders include AWS account teams, service teams, and partners; your customers are leading M&E organisations transforming their operations on AWS.

About the team
AWS Professional Services Media & Entertainment (ProServe M&E) works directly with the world's leading broadcasters, studios, and streaming providers to reinvent how they produce and deliver content on AWS — from live cloud production and broadcast to media supply chain and OTT. We are a team of specialist architects and engineers who combine deep AWS expertise with broadcast industry experience to break new ground for the M&E industry.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or experience in a professional field or military
- Experience as technical specialist in design and architecture
- Experience in consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions
- Experience in cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system
- Experience in external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management

- Broadcast, live production, media supply chain, or OTT/streaming domain experience
- Demonstrated technical leadership on complex, ambiguous transformation engagements, leading across customer, partner, and internal teams

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Loss Prevention Expert/ Profit Protection Manager / Gerente de Mermas / Gerente de Prevención de Pérdidas, Security & Loss Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day.

To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for proactive and solution-based professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Expert.

In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external actors (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards
• Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level


A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area.

You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.


About the team
Sitting within the Global Security Operations organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:

• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish and English at C1 level or above
- A degree or degree equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience in an analytical tasks or projects, working with data
- Driver's license

descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
Work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow Amazon's most strategic brands and improve their performance within a retail category.

Support vendor managers in providing a suite of services designed to help brands succeed, collaborating with cross-functional teams including in-stock and marketing.

Develop analytical and problem-solving skills by collecting, analysing, and interpreting data to drive category performance.

Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value across retail, advertising, and merchant services.

Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence to support business growth.

Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools across the business.

Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including category teams, product teams, and technical support teams.

Every day is a little different as a Retail Vendor Manager Working Student. Working alongside a vendor manager, you'll learn how Amazon handles its e-commerce retail business across product categories — from books to fashion, electronics to grocery, and everything in between. You might spend your morning analysing category performance data and identifying growth opportunities for strategic brands, then spend your afternoon working with marketing or in-stock teams to implement an improvement project that enhances the customer shopping experience.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which retail category you join, part of your role will involve working backwards from the customer to identify what matters most. You'll gain exposure to Amazon's advertising products and merchant services, learn how we create custom opportunities to delight clients, and partner across functions to deliver results — building your analytical, commercial, and problem-solving skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

title: Sr. Manager, Supply Chain, Merch on Demand
descriptionHtml:
Merch on Demand is Amazon's print-on-demand business, enabling customers to purchase custom-printed products including apparel, drinkware, phone cases, jerseys, backpacks, PopSockets, and more; that are produced and fulfilled on demand within Amazon's fulfillment network. The Head of Merch on Demand Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for the end-to-end supply chain strategy and execution for this business. This leader sets the long-term vision for how Merch on Demand sources materials, develops and scales new print technologies, maintains best-in-class product quality, and delivers orders to customers faster and more cost-effectively.

Key job responsibilities
This role owns the global sourcing strategy for all raw materials, blanks, inks, and components used across the Merch on Demand product catalog. The leader drives R&D efforts to identify, test, and scale new print methods, substrates, and product formats that expand the Merch on Demand offering. They are responsible for quality assurance and quality control programs across the network, reducing defect rates and improving the end-to-end customer experience. The role owns production throughput and shipping speed performance, identifying and removing bottlenecks to deliver orders to customers faster. This includes defining the strategy for current and next-generation print technologies (Direct-To-Garment, Direct-Film-Transfer, sublimation, UV, etc.), ensuring the network operates on the most efficient and highest-quality methods available. The leader drives capacity planning and network design, including site selection, capacity expansion, and geographic optimization to support growth and improve delivery speed. They partner with technology teams to develop and deploy fulfillment systems, automation, and tooling that improve operational efficiency and scalability. Across all of these areas, this role drives supply chain innovation, building a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

A day in the life
• Review daily production metrics across the Merch on Demand network, including DPMO (defects per million opportunities), throughput per hour, SLA performance, and shipping speed to identify trends and areas requiring immediate action.
• Lead a weekly business review with sourcing, quality, production, and fulfillment technology teams to assess performance against goals and align on priorities.
• Evaluate a new blank supplier proposal, comparing cost, quality samples, and lead times against current vendors to determine whether to proceed with a pilot.
• Meet with the R&D team to review test results from a new print method trial, assess quality and cost implications, and decide whether to scale to additional sites.
• Partner with the network planning team to model capacity scenarios for an upcoming product launch, determining how to allocate volume across sites to meet demand while optimizing shipping speed and cost.
• Dive deep into a quality excursion at a specific site, reviewing defect data, root cause analysis, and corrective actions with the quality team.
• Join a working session with the fulfillment technology team to review the roadmap for automation investments, prioritizing projects based on expected throughput improvement and ROI.
• Conduct a monthly innovation review, where teams present new ideas and experiments across print methods, materials, packaging, and process improvements.
• Align with finance on variable cost performance and improvement plans, reviewing cost per unit trends and identifying levers to drive further savings.
• Meet with transportation and logistics partners to review shipping cost and speed performance, exploring opportunities to improve delivery promises through network placement or carrier strategy.

You are a leader, builder, and operator. You have experience leading or contributing to multiple simultaneous product development efforts and/or projects and initiatives. You’ll strive for simplicity and will demonstrate significant creativity.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- 6+ years of team management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred qualifications

- Experience engaging and influencing senior executives
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees

title: Senior Supply Chain Manager, Inbound and MM Topology（輸送ネットワーク企画）
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a Senior Supply Chain Manager to lead First Mile network planning in Japan. This leader will shape how sorting and transportation capacity scale to support a fast-growing business and a reliable customer experience.
You will develop long-term network and capacity plans that connect First Mile sorting with Inbound and return flows. You will turn complex data into clear decisions, create scalable mechanisms, and lead cross-functional execution across planning, procurement, operations, and technology.

Amazon Japan は、First Mile のネットワーク計画をリードする Senior Supply Chain Manager を募集しています。本ポジションは、成長する事業と安定した顧客体験を支えるため、仕分けおよび輸送キャパシティをどのように拡張するかを設計します。
First Mile の仕分けと Inbound・返却フローを結ぶ中長期のネットワーク・キャパシティ計画を策定します。複雑なデータを明確な意思決定に変え、拡張可能なメカニズムを構築し、計画、調達、オペレーション、テクノロジーを横断した実行を主導します。


Key job responsibilities
• Own the multi-year strategy for First Mile sorting and transportation capacity across Japan.
• Develop integrated network plans that improve capacity, service, and efficiency across First Mile, Inbound, and return flows.
• Model network scenarios, demand growth, capacity constraints, and operational trade-offs to guide investment and planning decisions.
• Define separate Business as Usual and Peak capacity plans, including operating assumptions, risk mitigation, and contingency actions.
• Create scalable planning mechanisms, performance metrics, and review cadences that link long-term design with daily execution.
• Lead cross-functional programs with transportation procurement, operations, technology, finance, and fulfillment teams.
• Influence senior leaders through clear written narratives, data-backed recommendations, and well-managed trade-offs.
• Lead pilots, measure outcomes, and scale network and capacity improvements across the business.

• 日本全体の First Mile における仕分けおよび輸送キャパシティの長期戦略を担う。
• First Mile、Inbound、返却フローを横断し、キャパシティ、サービス、効率を高める統合ネットワーク計画を策定する。
• ネットワークシナリオ、需要成長、キャパシティ制約、オペレーション上のトレードオフを分析し、投資・計画の意思決定を導く。
• 運用前提、リスク緩和、コンティンジェンシーアクションを含む BAU および Peak の個別キャパシティ計画を定義する。
• 長期設計と日々の実行を結ぶ、拡張可能な計画メカニズム、パフォーマンス指標、レビューサイクルを構築する。
• 輸送調達、オペレーション、テクノロジー、ファイナンス、フルフィルメントのチームを横断してプログラムを主導する。
• 明確な文章、データに基づく提案、適切に管理されたトレードオフを通じて、シニアリーダーへ影響を与える。
• パイロットを主導し、結果を測定し、ネットワークおよびキャパシティ改善を事業全体へ展開する。


A day in the life
You will balance long-term network design with current business needs. A typical day includes analyzing demand and capacity data, leading planning reviews, and aligning decisions with operations and procurement partners. You will resolve cross-functional trade-offs, communicate recommendations to leaders, and build mechanisms that make future decisions faster and more consistent.

About the team
The Inbound and MM Topology team designs scalable supply chain networks for Amazon's Japan business. We solve complex transportation and capacity problems with data, customer thinking, and practical operations knowledge. We value ownership, strong judgment, and respectful debate. Our leaders turn ambiguous business problems into simple mechanisms that improve customer experience and business performance.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

You’ll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You’ll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day.

Here, the impact of what you build isn’t abstract, it’s visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world’s most complex operations moving forward.

This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

You'll apply your problem-solving and technical skills to real challenges, while developing important communication and professional soft skills through hands-on experience. With a dedicated mentor guiding your development throughout the programme, you'll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organisational excellence — providing a strong foundation for a career in human resources.

title: Senior Finance Analyst, Selling Partner Services, Central FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Seller Partner Services (SPS) Finance team is hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to help embed AI directly into financial planning and analysis. You'll work across a 3P business spanning FBA and MFN, NA and International — where your modeling and automation work shapes how sellers are priced, forecasted, and reported on.

This isn't a reporting-support role. You'll partner directly with finance managers on ASP and profitability analysis, build sensitivity models that inform investment decisions, and turn dense data into narratives that hold up in front of senior leadership. You'll also build AI workflows that replace hours of manual work — freeing capacity for deeper analysis, not just faster output.

Key job responsibilities
- Build AI-powered workflows that automate recurring financial analysis — trend reporting, variance commentary, data extraction — cutting manual cycle time while improving accuracy
- Run deep-dive analysis on ASP and profitability trends across size bands, flagging trend breaks that need manager or leadership attention
- Build sensitivity models and dynamic forecasts that let leadership stress-test scenarios before committing to a plan
- Partner with finance managers to convert raw data into decision-ready narratives for executive reviews
- Mentor peers on analytical rigor and AI tool adoption, raising the bar on both without sacrificing data integrity

A day in the life
No two weeks look the same here. Some days you're heads-down building or refining an AI workflow; others you're in a business review defending a forecast assumption to a finance manager who'll push back on every input. You'll move between quiet analytical work and live collaboration — often in the same afternoon.

You'll sit close enough to the business to see how a pricing change or seller trend actually shows up in the numbers, and close enough to leadership reviews to know what questions they'll ask before they ask them. The team is small enough that your work gets noticed and used quickly, and collaborative enough that you're rarely solving a hard problem alone.

About the team
The SPS FP&A team supports the financial operations for 3rd Party Sellers, one of Amazon's largest businesses. We're building the tools and processes that let financial planning scale globally while holding the precision that billion-dollar decisions require — including embedding AI directly into core workflows rather than treating it as a side project. The team values analytical rigor, mentorship, and a genuinely diverse set of perspectives on hard problems.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

The architectural decisions being made now - how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale - will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade. You won't be inheriting someone else's design choices. You'll be making them.

Your Role in This Story
Imagine being the person who keeps the heartbeat of Australia's most critical infrastructure steady and strong. As a Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician, you'll be the front line guardian of the systems that power innovation at national scale — from stand-by diesel generators and UPS systems to precision cooling and building automation. Every shift you work ensures that thousands of customers maintain uninterrupted access to the services they depend on.

This isn't just maintenance — it's mastery. You'll develop deep expertise across electrical and mechanical systems, troubleshoot complex challenges in real time, and build the kind of hands-on engineering intuition that takes others a lifetime to develop. You'll work alongside a diverse team of engineers, security experts, and operations leaders who share your passion for excellence and your commitment to keeping the world's most advanced infrastructure running flawlessly.

Your career trajectory here is limitless. Whether you aspire to lead teams, specialise in critical systems design, or shape the future of data centre operations, this role gives you the foundation and the momentum to get there — fast.

Benefits
- Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
- Health, income protection and life cover - Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.
- Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.
- Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
- Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.
- Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key job responsibilities
You'll own the operational excellence of some of the most sophisticated critical infrastructure in the country. Your days will be defined by impact — reviewing and managing both routine and corrective maintenance across switch gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, and building monitoring systems.

You'll establish the performance benchmarks that set the standard, conducting deep analyses and preparing reports that drive continuous improvement across every aspect of facility operations. When new facilities come online, you'll be there from the ground up — contributing to design, implementation, commissioning, and build-out that shapes how these environments perform for years to come.

Your creative problem-solving will shine as you develop and implement projects that push the boundaries of capacity, efficiency, sustainability, and reliability. You'll take ownership of facility assets, managing infrastructure and inventory with precision and accountability.

On any given day, you might be coordinating contractors and vendors on-site — ensuring every piece of work meets established practices, procedures, and local legislation — or collaborating with business leaders to optimise plant safety, performance, and efficiency across the operation.

This is a role where your technical expertise meets strategic thinking, and where every decision you make ripples outward to support Australia's national security mission.- Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses & prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility infrastructure operations & maintenance.
- Help with the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
- Create and implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
- Manage the facility assets and the provision of infrastructure & inventory asset management.
- Manage the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed, is observing established practices, procedures & local legislation.
- Work with other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimise plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.·

A day in the life
Your alarm goes off and you know today matters. You arrive on-site and immediately check the building management system — everything's green, but you notice a trend in one of the chiller units that warrants investigation. That's the kind of proactive thinking that sets you apart.

By mid-morning, you're deep in a corrective maintenance review on a UPS system, coordinating with your team to ensure zero disruption to operations. The complexity energises you — every variable you account for, every system you restore to peak performance, reinforces why you chose this path.

After lunch, you're meeting with a contractor team performing switchgear upgrades. You're the person ensuring their work meets every standard, every procedure, every safety requirement. Your attention to detail protects not just the facility, but the mission it supports.

title: Senior Energy and Water Public Affairs Manager, AWS East Energy and Water Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS is building data center infrastructure to support our digital way of life, and the public conversation around that growth — power demand, grid reliability, and water use, — is increasingly shaped by regulators, policymakers, elected officials, and community stakeholders. The Energy & Water team is looking for a Senior Manager in Public Affairs, to lead how we engage in that conversation.

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to energy and water: you understand industry trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage with the right internal and external stakeholders, and translate that understanding into the right messaging, You are the expert who shows up, engages authentically with community members, organizations, public officials, builds lasting relationships , and contributes to an informed, transparent, and productive public dialogue. You will be one of a small cohort of 3–4 regional representatives who collectively own how the Energy & Water team builds public engagement, in coordination with our policy, legal, community, comms, and economic development partners.

Represent Energy & Water in public and community settings — open houses, boot camps, hearings, and stakeholder forums— building trusted relationships with officials, regulators, and community stakeholders.

Engage authentically on energy and water topics in real time — accurately representing Amazon's approach and genuinely addressing community questions

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to energy and water: you understand industry and energy-sector trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage credibly with regulatory bodies and policy audiences, and you translate that understanding into the right messaging, delivered in the right tone, to the right stakeholders.

Develop and maintain talking points, FAQs, and Q&A guidance on energy and water topics for use by the broader team, Comms, and cross-functional partners

Provide the energy and water subject matter foundation to develop materials and translate complex topics into channel-specific formats

Serve as a key resource when the team needs to respond quickly to emerging topics or prepare a spokesperson

Cross-Functional & Team Support

Serve as the Energy & Water liaison to Public Policy, Legal, Community Engagement, and Economic Development partner teams, aligning on messaging, sequencing, and tone before positions reach external audiences

Work closely with the External Engagement team to ensure E&W subject matter is well-represented in event programming

Coordinate with Water and Energy SMEs to stay current on technical data (FAQ maintenance, approved stats, updated infrastructure positions)

Support regional leads and the broader team with ad hoc communications needs — presentations, talking points for senior stakeholders, positioning for emerging issues

Drive negotiations and agreements to support community benefit energy and water projects as needed

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you write crisp, you speak with authority, and you know when to be direct and when to listen

- Comfort with ambiguity, evolving facts, and situations where you are not the decision-maker but are the face in the room

- Working knowledge of the energy and/or water regulatory landscape (e.g., utility regulation, interconnection, rate and reliability policy, water sourcing and permitting).

You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.

About the team
Sitting within the Global Security Operations organization, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation



Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing re-occurrence.

- Experience in security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
- Experience with physical security best practices which includes the application of physical security systems, investigation techniques and management of contract security guards
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with data and analytics

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.



A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Gute Schulnoten in Mathematik und Physik (abhängig von der Schulform)

Preferred qualifications

- Du besitzt handwerkliches Geschick und verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis
- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)
- Du bringst bereits erste Vorerfahrungen im handwerklichen Bereich mit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität“
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). title: Security Tech Operations Manager, Amazon Security Hardware
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Hardware Supply Chain Security (HSCS) organization is looking for a Hardware Security Operations Manager who has a passion for security and the curiosity to analyze and report conclusions on the integrity of AWS hardware at any stage in its life cycle. You will lead a team of hardware security engineers and work alongside them, both doing the technical work and growing the people who do it. You will partner with professionals around the world to help assess and mitigate risks in partner manufacturing and logistics, contribute to new mechanisms for defense and response, and analyze the ever-shifting threat landscape to help us prioritize continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to build and lead a team in a supportive, collaborative environment while helping secure the future of the cloud.

The HSCS organization exists to set the bar for AWS hardware life cycle security from design through end of life and drives durable mechanisms to meet requirements. If you have experience in areas such as modern semiconductor manufacturing and test, hardware/firmware analysis, or supply chain security, and you enjoy developing others, your expertise is needed more than ever and we are interested in talking to you.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with experience diagnosing and troubleshooting electronics PCB assemblies, including proficiency with test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, X-ray systems, shredders, and decap tools. They will demonstrate strong analytical judgment in interpreting test results and applying findings, supported by a solid understanding of hardware security fundamentals. They will have experience leading engineers or technicians, setting priorities for a team, and holding a high bar for the quality of technical work.

Key job responsibilities
Lead, hire, and develop a team of hardware security engineers, including setting goals, giving regular feedback, and managing performance
Plan and prioritize team workload across projects, balancing customer commitments, operational needs, and long-term capability building
Perform hands-on testing, automation, root cause analysis, and engineering artifact generation alongside the team
Own the development and review of SOPs for operation, equipment, testing, and analysis, and make sure the team follows them consistently
Review and approve engineering reports with the internal team and internal customers before publishing
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal customers and partner teams on the team's work, escalations, and results
Define and track operational metrics for the team and report status and risks to leadership
Drive a security mindset and provide guidance across all functions and operations
Own audits and reviews of operational activities (for example cycle counts, physical security, and inventory management) and drive corrective actions to closure
Manage lab equipment, assets, and resources, including identifying capability gaps and proposing investments
Lead continuous improvement efforts that increase the automation and efficiency of operations

A day in the life
In this role you will lead a team that assesses risks to AWS infrastructure by validating hardware security controls through inspection and testing of devices across the whole lifecycle, from suppliers through decommissioning. You will split your time between leading the team and doing the work. On a given day you might review a test plan with an engineer, troubleshoot a board on the bench, walk an internal customer through findings, and meet one on one with a team member about their development. You will implement, refine, and execute testing plans that use both simple and advanced techniques, oversee their execution, direct revision and follow-on testing, and make sure the analysis and reporting meets the bar before it goes out. You will grow the team's capabilities to protect Amazon and its customers, working with security professionals across Amazon as well as supplier and data center operations teams to keep AWS infrastructure secure.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of maintenance or engineering experience, or experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- 2+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience, or Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure, or experience driving collaborative projects from conception to delivery

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- Master's degree, or experience in hardware lab equipment such as digital scopes, logic analyzers, and soldering tools
- Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or a GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials) or Security+ and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate
- 2+ years of technical work with computer systems and technology components, or 4+ years of Amazon experience

descriptionHtml:

As a Transportation Associate you will:

• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.

• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!

• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.

title: Construction Manager, GES Ops Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design & Construction, you are Amazon's owner's representative throughout the full construction lifecycle. You play an integral role in delivering the built facilities and infrastructure that power Amazon's logistics network — including sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings — through new builds, retrofits, and expansions.

In this role, you serve as the primary point of interface between Amazon and its external partners — developers, general contractors, design engineers, and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) — while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders responsible for equipping, furnishing, and operating our facilities. You are accountable for the safe, on-time, in scope, and on-budget delivery of construction projects, and you bring a disciplined approach to budget management, schedule oversight, contract execution, and quality assurance.

You operate with a high degree of independence within your assigned region, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear and transparent communication with all project stakeholders. This role combines construction management, engineering, project planning, contract management, and facilities delivery — and requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance

· Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; hold all participants accountable to a safety-first culture

· Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to maintain regulatory compliance and ensure seamless project execution

· Lead or assist in negotiations with regulatory bodies as required for permitting and approvals

Project & Construction Management

· Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously — ranging from small renovations to large-scale ($100M+) new facility builds — from design phase through construction completion and operational handover

· Serve as Amazon's owner's representative and primary integrator between construction execution teams and internal stakeholders (operations, equipment, IT, etc.)

· Review construction documents, drawings, and specifications for conformance to Amazon's building standards and design guidelines

· Identify and resolve design conflicts, schedule clashes, and coordination gaps with other Amazon execution teams

· Conduct detailed reviews of contractor bid packages, budgets, and schedules to identify and resolve discrepancies

· Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management

· Own comprehensive budget tracking, cashflow forecasting, and cost management across assigned projects

· Review, analyze, and respond to all proposed cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams

· Negotiate construction, procurement, and labor contracts with developers and general contractors; present formal documentation for approval when required

· Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements

· Advise on the impact of changes in scope, schedule, cost, and permitting

Contractor & Stakeholder Management

· Audit contractor performance to ensure skills, competencies, and resources are appropriate for the work being performed

· Ensure contracted resources deliver work that meets duration and quality targets; address and resolve underperformance issues

· Coach and guide project teams — including developers, design engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders — throughout the full project lifecycle

· Inform developers and contractors of projected changes in resource or work demand to enable proactive planning

· Partner with teams responsible for base building management transition and oversight of all turnover documentation

Communication & Reporting

· Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication with all internal and external stakeholders on project status, risks, and key developments

· Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project data

· Participate in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

· Prepare reports, specifications, and technical analyses to define design requirements, equipment needs, and services for expansion and remodel projects

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

· Provide critical review of current design standards to identify value engineering and design enhancement opportunities

· Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices

· Identify and implement process improvements that drive better outcomes across safety, cost, schedule, and quality

A day in the life
Each day, you act as Amazon's owner on the ground — ensuring the safe, on-time, and on-budget execution of construction projects across your region. Your day may include:

· Coordinating with general contractors on project status, upcoming milestones, and emerging risks

· Reviewing and responding to RFIs, submittals, change order requests, and schedule updates

· Participating in AOC meetings and driving accountability across the project team

· Conducting site visits to verify construction quality and safety compliance

· Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information

· Collaborating with internal stakeholders on facility readiness, equipment coordination, and operational handover planning

· Reviewing design documents and providing feedback to engineering and design partners

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or an equivalent engineering science
- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience in facilities management, or experience in construction or project management
- Experience in project management or management consulting including handling multiple ongoing projects
