title: Sr Strategic Account Manager, AB - EU - UK Government
descriptionHtml:
Can you build trusted relationships with the most senior leaders in UK central government — and turn them into long-term, mission-shaping partnerships?

Do you want to shape how the public sector procures, in one of Amazon Business’s fastest-growing and most strategically important verticals?

This is a senior, high-visibility role for a proven operator who thrives in the room with the most senior leaders in Whitehall and wants to shape how the public sector procures.

Customers rely on Amazon for convenient access to millions of products delivered right to their doorstep. The Amazon Business team is reimagining that experience to fit the specific needs of the UK’s public sector — the central government departments, agencies, and arm’s-length bodies that run the country’s critical services, alongside local authorities, combined authorities, blue light services, and the wider public estate. From Whitehall departments and national agencies to councils, emergency services, and the metro-mayor combined authorities now taking on devolved budgets, these customers exist to serve citizens — and we exist to help them do it more efficiently, transparently, and cost-effectively.

Amazon Business helps public sector organizations reshape their procurement with cost and time savings, greater productivity, and insightful purchasing analytics. Customers benefit from a curated site experience, Business Prime, business-only pricing and selection, multi-user accounts, approvals workflows, purchasing system and framework integrations, payment solutions, dedicated customer support, and more. In an environment of constrained budgets, heightened scrutiny of public spend, and rising demand for frontline services, every pound saved on procurement is a pound that can be redirected to delivering for citizens.

B2B procurement is undergoing a digital transformation, and nowhere is the opportunity greater than across UK central government. As a Strategic Account Manager in the UK Gov team, you will own the most strategically significant customers in our book — including major central government departments — and help shape how Amazon Business shows up across the wider public sector. This is a senior, strategic role built for someone who can sit across the table from a Permanent Secretary, Director General, CDIO, CFO, or Commercial Director at a central government department and build a long-term, multi-year partnership rooted in their mission and their commercial and digital agenda — and who can raise the bar for how the rest of the team approaches strategic account development.

Credibility at the most senior levels of central government is central to this role. You will build and sustain relationships with senior stakeholders across Whitehall, translate departmental priorities into a compelling Amazon Business proposition, and influence procurement and digital strategy at the executive level. Being comfortable and effective in CxO and Permanent-Secretary-level conversations — earning the trust of senior civil servants and commercial leaders, and leading those conversations autonomously — is a key attribute for success.

It’s always Day 1 at Amazon. The UK Gov vertical is one of the most strategically important growth areas within Amazon Business, and we need a senior operator to bring their creative spirit, customer obsession, and best ideas to shape how we serve a sector that operates differently to commercial customers. You will help define the playbook, not just execute against it, and have a lasting impact on the way the UK’s public services are procured and delivered.

A successful Strategic Account Manager will be a confident, autonomous self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a track record of building strategic customer relationships at the most senior levels, and genuine curiosity about the operational and political realities of central government. You will be motivated by public impact as much as commercial outcomes — and will see no tension between the two. You will also be the kind of senior team member who lifts those around you, mentoring junior Account Managers and raising the standard of how we engage with the sector.



Key job responsibilities
Own C-suite relationships in central government — build executive-level relationships with the most senior stakeholders across UK central government departments and agencies (Permanent Secretaries, Director Generals, CDIOs, CFOs, Commercial Directors).

Own and grow a portfolio of the most strategically significant UK public sector customers — central government departments, local authorities, combined authorities, and blue light services.

Lead high-stakes commercial and strategic conversations autonomously, positioning Amazon Business against departmental priorities, spending controls, and transformation agendas.

Shape the UK Gov vertical strategy with the team lead, championing where Amazon Business can do more for customers.

Evolve the proposition to public sector realities — procurement frameworks (e.g. Crown Commercial Service), the Procurement Act, spend controls, and governance.

Engage emerging combined authorities and metro-mayor bodies taking on devolved budgets — a first-mover opportunity to shape platform needs.
Own strategic customer and territory planning; forecast accurately and represent UK Gov in leadership reviews.

Advise customers on Amazon Business solutions (100+) to free up frontline resources, and surface new product opportunities internally.

Maintain deep expertise on the UK public sector and competitive procurement landscape.

Mentor junior Account Managers and meet or exceed targets for customers and Amazon Business.

A day in the life
Most days blend deep customer work with cross-border teamwork. You might spend the morning prepping a QBR with a major central government department, jump into a Pan-EU sync with colleagues on public sector procurement, then talk strategy with a department's Commercial Director or CDIO about how Amazon Business supports their transformation agenda. You'll own your accounts autonomously while working as one team across five countries — mixing strategic planning, internal influencing, and time in front of senior customers.
Want to spend your career helping the organizations that serve UK citizens do more with what they have?



About the team
You’ll be part of the EU Public Sector team at Amazon Business, a tight-knit group of Account Managers and Account Executives covering the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and Spain. We are a small team with an outsized remit, working across five of Europe’s most distinctive public sector landscapes and learning from one another constantly. The culture is collaborative, ambitious, and unapologetically mission-driven — we genuinely care about the customers we serve, and we expect every member of the team to bring both commercial rigor and a real sense of purpose to the work.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field
- Experience positioning and selling technology to new customers and in new market segments

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
- Experience identifying trends and needs to improve an already closed large-scale technology deal
- Experience in B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business
- Hold current UK Security Clearance at SC, or above, or be willing to undergo clearance.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.


Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Systems Development Engineer, Analytics ADC
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Analytics team is at the forefront of delivering AWS cloud analytics services to our customers. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in this rapidly evolving field, leveraging the power of cloud computing and the latest advancements in data technologies. With a focus on expanding analytics services across AWS regions, driving automation investments, and delivering scalable data solutions, we are at the forefront of modernization. Our teams are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems and delivering the next generation of cloud analytics with services like Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena, and Amazon Redshift.

We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer II who can think big and simplify solutions to complex problems, all while ensuring our customers continue to have the best experience possible!

A successful Systems Development Engineer II joining the team will be an innovator, building solutions and working closely with Amazon's largest and most demanding customers to address their specific needs across a suite of Analytics services — including Amazon EMR, Athena, and Redshift. They will drive the resolution of technical issues and work diligently to improve the customer experience.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:

Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.
Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and conduct technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.
Have strong software and skills. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with systems in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You are comfortable facilitating deep-dive troubleshooting and leading technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.
Love to solve problems. The ideal candidate will love leading teams to solve difficult technical problems related to AWS service builds and operations in air-gapped cloud environments. You have a solid understanding of systems design, operations, automation, and process improvement.
Think Big. The ideal candidate will work on projects building and deploying solutions across ADC partitions and regions. You will strive build a culture to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

A day in the life
As a Systems Development Engineer II in Analytics, you will build innovative solutions, expand services into GovCloud regions, and improve our operations to provide resiliency and the best experience for our customers. You influence technical strategy and architectural decisions within the team and with partner teams and make data-driven decisions. You bring in best practices in operational and engineering excellence by actively contributing to ticket resolution and infrastructure improvements. Successful candidates will be expected to show leadership on strong Bias for Action, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

You will develop, build, and operate AWS Agentic AI services that enable customers to optimize their data. Our engineering teams support services running in air gapped regions that are isolated from the public internet creating unique engineering challenges and opportunities for innovation. The Analytics team is responsible for diving deep to resolve operational challenges, innovating to automate operational tasks, build open source solutions for our customers, supporting execution of various security campaigns (blocked software, host patching), and parity programs.

As a Systems Development Engineer II you will:

Work cross functionally to foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.
Love to code. Whether its building tools in Java or solving complex system problems in Python, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems. You have a solid understanding of software development methodology and know how to use the right tool for the right job.
Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions across thousands of devices. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 1+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with PowerShell (preferred), Python, Ruby, or Java
- Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
- Experience with PowerShell (preferred), Python, Ruby, or Java
- Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- 7+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience

title: Software Development Engineer, Selling Partner Experience Core Services
descriptionHtml:
Millions of sellers list products on Amazon. You'll own the services that tell them what a valid listing needs, get their submissions live, and explain what to fix when one fails.

Selling on Amazon comes down to three things a seller has to get right: learn what a valid listing needs, get it submitted, and fix it when something goes wrong. We build for all three, in every marketplace where Amazon operates. Some of our services tell a seller what their category requires before they submit, and whether their product is already in our catalog. Others take listings in and update them, one at a time or thousands at once in a bulk feed, and carry them through to a live offer. When something breaks, ours are the services that say what went wrong, in the seller's own language, while there's still time to fix it.

You'll work on software that every seller and every seller tool passes through. The problems are API design, concurrency, event-driven processing, and data modeling over a catalog whose rules shift by product, by marketplace, and by seller. You'll own what you build, from design through production and the on-call rotation that follows, on a team cutting years of overlapping systems down to fewer and simpler ones. There's room to grow into owning a system end to end.

Key job responsibilities
- Own features end to end, from understanding what the customer needs through design, code, tests, deployment, documentation, and the operations that follow. This includes refactoring and removing software, not only writing new software.
- Design solutions to difficult problems where the goal is clear but the implementation is not. Reduce them to the simplest design that works, and review that design with senior engineers before you build it.
- Operate what you build. Take part in an on-call rotation, hold the line on the latency and availability sellers depend on, drive issues to a permanent root cause fix, and automate recurring work instead of absorbing it.
- Document how your systems are built, tested, secured, and operated, and train new engineers on them. Give useful review feedback to engineers at every level, including engineers more senior than you.
- Work with the customers and partner teams that depend on your services, and make priority calls between new features, operational work, and business commitments. Keep your tools current, including AI-assisted development, and stay accountable for the quality of everything you ship.

A day in the life
You join a team of six to twelve engineers, with a manager and senior engineers who read your designs and your code. A typical day looks like this:

- Participating in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives
- Writing, testing, and debugging code for ongoing projects
- Reviewing code and incorporating feedback from your team
- Collaborating on technical solutions in design and architecture reviews
- Working with stakeholders to understand requirements
- Monitoring existing systems and resolving production issues
- Documenting technical specifications and processes
- Learning and applying new technologies and best practices
Sellers are on the other end of all of it. A change you write this month is something a seller runs into next month, and the feedback comes back fast.

About the team
Our customers are the sellers who list products on Amazon, the software companies that build tools for them, and the internal teams that serve them. Sellers should not have to learn how Amazon works internally in order to sell on Amazon, so we absorb that complexity instead of passing it to them. Our teams together cover the full path a listing takes: creating and updating listings, defining what a valid listing requires and what already exists in the catalog, and telling sellers what is wrong and what to do about it.

Our direction for the next few years is set. Make listing simple enough that sellers bring us their whole catalog. Make selling in several stores as straightforward as selling in one. Raise the quality and completeness of the catalog underneath both, and tell a seller about a restriction before it costs them a listing rather than after. Getting there means fewer systems, not more, so we are consolidating overlapping tools, retiring the ones that no longer earn their place, and applying AI both in what we ship to sellers and in how we build it. You will own parts of that work, with room to grow into owning a system end to end.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value

descriptionHtml:

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Logistics Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or a similar discipline who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

- Receive parts, maintain inventory records, and check out parts

descriptionHtml:

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. investigation Excellence Overview
Investigation Excellence (IE) is the deep-dive team within ATS Central Operations, owning root-cause investigation across Amazon's European Transportation Surface Transportation network. IE dives deep into every DEA miss — tracing VRIDs from origin to destination, separating true root cause from recovery, and ensuring each disruption is attributed to the right controllable owner. Rather than accepting metrics at face value, the team operates at the lowest level of detail, audits the data themselves, and stays connected to the specifics. IE plays a critical role in giving the network an honest, accurate picture of performance — which is what allows the right teams to fix the right problems and keep Amazon serving customers on time.

Purview of a Program Manager
As a program manager within Investigation Excellence, your role centers on diving deep into transportation execution data to uncover the true drivers behind DEA misses, and on inventing and simplifying the way we investigate — turning manual, repetitive deep dives into scalable, automated solutions (e.g. Kiro, Quick investigation tooling). You will own root-cause classification and attribution logic, drive accuracy and standardization so investigations can be consistently applied across teams, and monitor performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. You hold a high bar for quality and data integrity, look for ways to eliminate effort rather than add it, and foster cross-functional collaboration. Above all, you provide leadership and direction that keeps IE operating as a high-performance, self-sufficient investigation team — focused on efficiency, accuracy, and simplification.

title: Senior Security Engineer, AWS Security Verification & Validation Team
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to join Point-in-Time Security Testing, AWS's expert security assurance function for the launches and architectures where security automation alone is not enough. You will be a technical leader on a team, owning complex security testing engagements end-to-end, applying human judgment where it changes security outcomes and building automation for everything else.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud service provider, providing virtualized infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world, including government customers. AWS runs a globally distributed environment operating at massive scale, and businesses from start-ups to large enterprises and governments run their most sensitive workloads on it. Point-in-Time Security Testing takes on the security engagements where the architecture, threat model, or potential impact is complex enough that expert reasoning matters most. We start from the architecture and the risks rather than a generic checklist, think like an adversary, and demonstrate realistic impact. We build harnesses that steer agentic AI so experts have more time for the difficult problems, and we turn what we learn into shared methods, mechanisms, and detections for the rest of the team. As AWS ships agentic systems of its own, those same systems become targets we test.

Our work is measured by how much difficult security uncertainty we resolve with the human time available to us, not by how many issues we find. In this role you will investigate high-consequence risks, which are specific, testable claims about how an adversary could cause harm, and take each one to a documented conclusion. You will either demonstrate the issue, rule out the attack path with enough evidence, or expose a weakness in a shared mechanism or detection.

You must produce results in the face of ambiguity and imperfect knowledge, foster constructive dialogue, and drive resolution when faced with disagreement. You work efficiently and routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. You take a long-term view of the team's methods and tooling, proactively fix architectural and mechanism deficiencies, and propose larger project scopes that you can split into parallel work for yourself and others and reassemble successfully.

Amazon's Leadership Principles of "Dive Deep", "Earn Trust", "Deliver Results", and "Invent and Simplify" will be called upon daily. Above all, we earn trust by choosing carefully where humans spend time, testing those areas deeply, and being honest about what we know and what we do not.

Key job responsibilities
- Own security for a portfolio of testing engagements across your team and partner-orgs, as well as leading individual complex engagements. Set the testing strategy across interconnected microservice architectures, successive launch iterations, and cross-service campaigns, and decide where to spend expert effort across the whole service portfolio.
- Perform penetration testing and AI-augmented source code review of complex proprietary AWS software, directing the tooling at trust boundaries, abuse cases, and attack paths it would not reach on its own, confirming what it reports, and setting the methodology your team follows when they do the same.
- Take each agreed risk hypothesis to a documented conclusion, whether that means demonstrating the issue with proof-of-concept code, ruling out the attack path with sufficient evidence, or identifying a weakness in a shared mechanism or detection that affects services beyond the one under test.
- Take on engagements where the customer case is understood but no security strategy exists yet, bring clarity to the ambiguity, and define the approach others will reuse. Challenge what a scope document assumes and identify what it misses, then keep the engagement moving when conditions change by building alternative test paths, re-scoping, and parallelizing work with dependent teams.
- Trace attack paths across chained components and demonstrate compound risk that stays invisible when components are tested in isolation, including risk that crosses organizational and ownership boundaries.
- Produce clear engagement results that record what you tested, why you chose those tests, what you found or ruled out, the limitations of the work, and the risk that remains, and write for non-engineering audiences in your domain when the decision sits with them.
- Lead communication with developers, AppSec engineers, and other stakeholders when the scope is ambiguous or a fix is not straightforward, validate the fixes, work as an embedded security tester inside the development lifecycle when a launch calls for it, and lead escalations to closure with Senior Managers and Principal Engineers when a fix or a risk decision stalls.
- Build the frameworks, runbooks, and rubrics that let the whole team test a new problem domain repeatably, not only automation for a single harness. Tune the harnesses that raise the precision of the team's AI tooling, measure where they produce false positives or miss attack patterns, and generalize what works into a mechanism the team adopts.
- Leave reusable mechanisms behind, such as fuzzers, integration security tests, detection rules, tooling, or documented methodology, track their adoption, and where the work depends on teams with their own priorities, build the mechanisms that get security outcomes prioritized and tracked to delivery.
- Set the peer-review bar for the team. Review test plans, scopes, runbooks, and reports from peers and other teams, question coverage gaps, add the missing test cases, and ensure the work fits into the bigger picture and stays extensible and low-cost to adopt.
- Lead multi-engineer engagements and mentor multiple engineers across your own and related teams, are sought out for your expertise, and participate in promotion assessments.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. title: Test Lab Manager
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the next generation of multi-purpose robotics systems, and scaling from prototype to production. We are looking for an experienced Test Lab Manager to play a key leadership role in proving robots are ready for deployment. This is a chance to join a growing System Verification and Validation team at a pivotal moment and build a lab organization from the ground up. You will own the processes that keep our hardware and physical system test environments running, and you will directly shape how we verify and validate the next generation of Amazon robotics.

As a Test Lab Manager, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of infrastructure, operations, and maintenance staff spanning multiple lab locations that support hardware and physical system testing. Your team runs tests and experiments, operates and maintains test fixtures, lab equipment, control systems, and motion capture systems, coordinates test intake and scheduling, and keeps test uptime high through proactive and corrective maintenance. You will be responsible for standing up new lab spaces, establishing the processes and systems that manage incoming test demand, and growing and developing the team as the lab footprint expands. If you are energized by leading hands-on technical teams, building operational excellence into a scaling organization, and enabling robotics verification and validation, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead execution of hardware and physical system test and experimentation campaigns across multiple lab locations, ensuring tests are run safely, on schedule, and with high-quality data in support of verification and validation goals.
- Partner with cross-functional project groups—hardware, software, systems, and quality engineering teams—to understand test requirements, plan lab capacity, and support experimentation from setup through data collection and review.
- Build and own test request intake and management processes and systems, standardizing how test demand is submitted, prioritized, scheduled, and tracked across sites.
- Provide visibility into lab testing activities, capacity, and equipment availability by developing dashboards and reporting that help stakeholders track test status, utilization, and throughput across sites.
- Lead and develop a multidisciplinary lab team (infrastructure, controls, operations, and maintenance staff) across multiple test lab locations, providing coverage across shifts and on-call rotations.
- Own the operation, availability, and uptime of test environments, fixtures, lab equipment, control systems (PLC, I/O), motion capture systems, and environmental test chambers.
- Establish and continuously improve lab operational processes, SOPs, and documentation to enable safe, repeatable, and high-throughput testing.
- Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for lab equipment and electro-mechanical systems to maximize test readiness.
- Stand up new lab spaces, coordinating equipment sourcing, installation, calibration, and onboarding of staff to bring labs online on schedule.
- Ensure safety compliance and manage lab safety protocols specific to robotics hardware testing (e.g., gantry interlocks, robot safety devices, lockout procedures).


A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the test request queue and the day's schedule across your lab sites, reallocating staff to keep high-priority verification campaigns on track. You could spend part of the day running a hardware test campaign alongside a cross-functional project team, then work with your controls engineers to resolve an issue with an automated test cell. In the afternoon you might refine your test intake process based on feedback from engineering partners, review a dashboard of lab utilization to rebalance capacity, and coach a team member stepping into a new area of ownership. Throughout, you will remove bottlenecks, improve processes, and keep your labs running safely and reliably.

About the team
We are a growing System Verification and Validation organization building the lab infrastructure that validates robotic hardware and physical systems across multiple dimensions of performance and reliability as we scale from prototype to production. This Test Lab Manager role will lead the first dedicated lab engineering organization on the team, spanning multiple sites and disciplines. If you want to help build a lab organization from the ground up and leave your mark on the next generation of Amazon robotics, this is the team to join.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering team management
- Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- 7+ years of experience in technical lab, robotics, electro-mechanical, or automation environments, including operating, testing, and maintaining equipment
- 3+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams or lab/test operations
- Experience planning and executing hardware or physical system test or experimentation campaigns in partnership with cross-functional engineering teams
- Experience managing lab resources, equipment, supplies, and operational processes across one or more lab environments
- Experience troubleshooting, diagnosing, and maintaining electro-mechanical systems, control systems (e.g., PLC, I/O), or lab equipment
- Experience interpreting engineering documentation, including CAD, drawings, schematics, equipment specifications, test procedures, and/or Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
- Experience with project management of technical projects, including scheduling, tracking, and documentation

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience managing robotics, mechatronics, or system-level test labs across multiple physical locations

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization with ownership of the end-to-end customer experience for large, heavy, and bulky products. We are seeking a highly skilled and results-driven Design Engineer to join our dynamic AMXL Worldwide Industrial Design Engineering (WIDE) team. The individual will primarily own the capacity models for Last Mile and will help improve and automate the model refreshes going into organizational quarterly guidance and planning cycles. Additionally, the role requires driving concept designs that enhance our customer and associate experience by introducing new capabilities and re-engineering processes while increasing the overall safety and efficiency of our operations.

We are looking for someone who possesses a blend of customer-facing and technical skills and will own retrofit programs and projects from ideation through execution and validation. Successful candidates will possess a strong background in facility design, material handling equipment, automation, and process engineering with a blend of deep skills in program managing complex projects, strong technical aptitude, troubleshooting capabilities, and customer-facing skills, along with a passion for innovating and simplifying processes. You are able to work successfully across multiple large engineering and operations teams at a strategic level and at an operations integration level.

- Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to generate high quality, cost effective solutions in very short periods of time

The role will require daily interactions with Operations, Safety, Process/Design Engineering, Launch, Finance, Supply Chain Execution, and Planning teams to ensure delivery station and sort center retrofit programs are well-defined in terms of aligning on the launch calendar, determining capacity requirements, identifying resources, clarifying roles and responsibilities, and leading the change management process. title: Finance Manager, Amazon Last Mile Topology & Investment Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to influence capital intensive, one way door decisions as we expand Amazon's last mile delivery footprint to better serve our end customers?

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is Amazon's "Last Mile" delivery service, responsible for delivering packages (and smiles) to households/businesses across the planet. Our finance team closely partners to support this rapidly expanding business while building a portfolio of delivery stations, vans, and technology to deliver customers' packages on time - often next day, sometimes faster. You will make history as you help build one of the largest carriers on the planet.

AMZL Finance seeks a Finance Manager to join the Last Mile Topology & Investment Analytics team, partnering directly with our business and finance partners to own capacity expansion investments and influence decision-making within the org. You will have extensive cross-functional partnership opportunities with business and finance leaders across multiple disciplines including Topology, Real Estate, Construction, Engineering and Launch teams to solve high visibility, high impact, unstructured problems as we grow our AMZL delivery network. Your ability to deliver meaningful financial analysis through ambiguous situations and operate with a high degree of critical thinking will allow you to operate as the primary Finance stakeholder in the decision-making of growing our AMZL network.

Success in this role requires you to partner with and influence business owners, respectively audit and challenge business model assumptions, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment. You will own the financial analysis behind the decisions AMZL will make, and hold yourself and partners accountable for ensuring those data-driven decisions are best for Amazon. You will collaborate with all types of stakeholders, from other finance leaders, to functional leaders, to executives, across multiple business units within Amazon. You bring best-in-class business partnership, critical thinking, and high judgement not only in the execution of your work but also while advocating strong controllership within your team and across stakeholders. You are comfortable asking thoughtful questions, communicating insights, and presenting your analysis to business leaders during reviews. You're a team player who thinks 2 steps ahead, prioritizes building analysis the "right" way, and appreciates process as much as execution.

This role directly impacts the decision on billions of dollars of investments in Amazon Last Mile infrastructure. A successful candidate effectively influences business partners, provides sound and thoughtful recommendations leveraging high degrees of financial knowledge and critical thinking, and manages competing priorities in a quickly changing environment. The candidate should demonstrate amazing analytical skills, ability to work with ambiguity and strong analytical and verbal and written communication skills as direct interaction with worldwide operations leadership is common.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build processes that improve the level of accuracy, automation, and scalability of financial analysis
Own a subset of financial analyses from ideation through execution that balances speed of execution with accuracy to deliver the highest degree of value to Amazon

title: Strategic Account Manager, US Global Selling Team
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a candidate with a passion for e-commerce and a desire to make a real impact on global customers in a Day One business. Our mission is to expand selection from US-based retailers and brand owners worldwide. Although we are already a multi-billion-dollar business, we believe we are just getting started, as less than 5% of US-based sellers have started their international journey. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and elevate the seller and customer experience on a global scale.
As a Strategic Account Manager on the Amazon Global Selling team, you will work with top Amazon.com sellers, helping them expand their online retail business to Amazon's stores worldwide. You will work with sellers leadership teams, identifying key decision-makers and aligning them to prioritize actions required to expand their online retail business to Amazon's global stores such as Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.com.mx. You will build and cultivate strong relationships with sellers in your portfolio and be a trusted e-commerce and global sales advisor to the leadership in seller organizations. You will partner with external service providers to help your sellers obtain the required tax and product-level compliance certifications for selling in new markets. You will be comfortable with long sales cycles, often lasting more than 8 months, taking sellers through step-by-step processes to launch in a new market. Success in this role will be evaluated based on the scale of the sellers you manage, the number of new markets into which you help your sellers expand, unique selection additions in global markets, and the global sales revenue you drive from sellers in your portfolio. You will utilize a wide range of sales and negotiation skills and work across cross-functional areas to drive the performance of sellers in your portfolio.
In addition to your day-to-day role working with sellers, you will also contribute to business development and identify the correct input metrics that drive business growth for sellers in Amazon's global stores. You will use customer feedback, market growth trends, competitive best practices, and Gen AI developments to suggest new features required in our products and promotional programs to accelerate seller growth or improve the selling partner experience.
Ideal candidates will thrive in an ambiguous and dynamic environment where they must develop, evolve, and implement business strategies to deliver results, have relentlessly high standards, and operate as business owners with end-to-end responsibility to deliver business growth.


Key job responsibilities
• Build strong relationships with CXO-level stakeholders in sellers' organizations to drive decisions and actions required to launch sellers' businesses on Amazon's global online stores.
• Pitch CXO-level stakeholders on the benefits of selling their products on Amazon's global online stores in Europe, Asia, and South America.
• Guide sellers through the step-by-step process for global account registration, KYC, tax and product compliance, etc.
• Provide ongoing post-launch support on selection expansion, deals, sponsored ads, etc., to help sellers grow sales on Amazon's global stores.
• Prepare and conduct monthly business reviews with CXO stakeholders in sellers' organizations regarding progress and strategies to increase their revenue on Amazon's global websites.
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and program leaders to drive business growth.
• Pilot new initiatives and iterate the existing best practices to improve productivity and impact.
• Identify automation opportunities for manual tasks and partner with Gen AI product team to scale automation across our WW global selling team.


About the team
The Amazon Global Selling team's vision is to be the first choice for all US retail businesses to go global. We operate with the agility of a startup and a singular mission to empower US-based sellers to expand their businesses worldwide. We are committed to building an AI-native, agentic organization — one where AI agents increasingly handle execution at breadth and speed, while our account management team owns the strategy, the deep insights, the judgment, and the outcomes. The US Global Selling (USGS) team owns the full business lifecycle of North American sellers, expanding them into 20 global markets. Our mission is to make US selections available to customers worldwide. We're dedicated to simplifying global expansion and international selling for US-based sellers, working closely with them on both tech and non-tech aspects of product, supply chain, compliance, and international logistics.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- 2+ years of sales or account management experience
- Experience with sales targets, business development, and driving customer satisfaction

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience in a client facing consultative role working with large, complex enterprise customers
- Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Controls Engineering team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

title: Manager I, Ops, Linehaul
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.

Key job responsibilities
• Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.
• Risk Mitigation & Process Improvement — Apply risk-management best practices and methodologies to mitigate identified risk issues. Execute against established SOPs, identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, draft SOP revisions, and conduct risk assessments for new process implementations to ensure vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated before go-live.
• Team Management & Development — Manage and supervise investigators — including workload assignment, quality review of investigation outputs, SLA adherence monitoring, and calibration. Mentor new hires and participate in the development and delivery of risk management training.
• Trend Analysis & Financial Impact Quantification — Conduct weekly and monthly trend analysis across assigned RoW geographies, including period-over-period comparisons and concentration analysis. Own the financial impact quantification framework — tracking cost leakage, cost avoidance, and cost savings attributable to risk interventions, coordinating with finance for periodic validation.
• Proactive Risk Identification & Expansion — Proactively identify new risk patterns through systematic analysis of investigation outputs and region-specific vulnerability assessments. Drive cross-pollination of risk management learnings into adjacent operational functions and workstreams to expand the program’s impact beyond core scope.
• Business Reviews & Escalation Management — Own and drive operational review cadences including business review content preparation and escalation management. Perform deep-dive analysis and draft COE based on identified deviations and recommend appropriate solutions to ensure leadership visibility into program health and outcomes.
• Investigation Oversight & Triage — Oversee the investigation triage process — reviewing flagged cases from monitoring dashboards, determining root cause, validating operational justifications, identifying gaps in controls and processes, and managing escalations in consultation with legal where required.
• Technology Partnership & Monitoring Enhancement — Partner with automation and technology teams on dashboard enhancements, detection logic refinement, and false positive reduction to continuously improve monitoring accuracy, coverage, and program efficiencies.
• Project Delivery & Execution — Develop appropriate milestones and launch project schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of projects and standard work (e.g., audits/reviews, licensing).
• Program Alignment & Business Understanding — Ensure program alignment with the risk strategy, regulations, policies, and team objectives. Understand the business needs and workflows owned by your team including financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, automation/tools, and risk-assessment methodologies.
• Stakeholder Management & Risk Culture — Maintain structured stakeholder cadences with country-specific leadership, operations execution, procurement, and carrier management teams across all assigned RoW geographies. Support risk reporting and risk-aware culture initiatives across RoW countries.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level, SQL, and MS Access
- • Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
- • Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
- • Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement documents

title: Software Dev Engineer II - Full stack,  Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS), Control Plane
descriptionHtml:
About US
Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment.

Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast.

About The Role
As a Software Development Engineer on the Amazon IVS Control Plane team, you will build customer-facing experiences and highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems that power Amazon IVS.

The IVS Console is the primary interface through which customers configure, monitor, and manage their IVS resources, while the IVS Control Plane provides the APIs and backend systems that orchestrate those resources at AWS scale. You will work across both to build seamless end-to-end experiences for IVS customers. Your work will directly empower developers, broadcasters, and businesses around the world to deliver low-latency, interactive video experiences.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop intuitive user interfaces for the IVS Console using modern web technologies
- Design and develop scalable backend services and public APIs for Amazon IVS
- Build distributed systems that manage the configuration, orchestration, and lifecycle of live video streaming resources using TypeScript, Go or similar modern programming languages
- Define and maintain infrastructure using infrastructure as code practices, primarily with AWS CDK
- Work closely with engineers, product managers, UX designers, and applied scientists to deliver seamless customer experiences
- Ensure systems are highly available, scalable, and secure at AWS scale
- Apply engineering best practices across testing, performance optimization, observability, and code quality
- Collaborate with other AWS teams to integrate shared services and deliver consistent customer experiences across AWS services
- Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, design reviews, and on-call rotations
- Drive operational excellence through automation, metrics, alarms, and runbooks

A day in the life
You might start the morning by checking how the service is running and investigating an issue that surfaced overnight. Later, you could join a design discussion for a new customer feature, thinking through the experience from the public API, console, all the way to the backend systems that make it work. After lunch, you might work through an interesting technical problem with a teammate, review a change, or meet with product to refine how a feature should work for customers. Some days are focused on building intuitive customer experiences, while others take you deep into distributed systems and large scale service operations. You’ll have the opportunity to follow problems across the stack and see the features you build through from idea to launch.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience building web applications with React and modern web technologies
- Experience with both frontend and backend development
- Experience building backend services using Go or similar modern programming languages
- Experience building/designing UIs with multilingual support in mind

The Core Networking team is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our Network Product Development (NPD) team. As a Network Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying and scaling the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global datacenters.
AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.


Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers will:
• Be responsible for deploying network infrastructure across all of our network fabrics that supports the Amazon Retail Service, Kindle, Payments and multiple AWS services.
• Deploy, scale and automate our network across multiple global datacenters. This includes existing footprints and greenfield locations.
• Drive scaling of current network designs to meet the demand of our customers.
• Create simple, repetitive deployment processes that increase both velocity and quality.
• Work closely with our internal customers on designs/solutions; bringing those designs/solutions from concept to production.
• Create and update our network standards and ensure that the network is deployed to these standards.
• Create and implement changes on the network.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at higher volume.


A day in the life
On an everyday basis as part of our team, you have the unique opportunity to understand the growing AWS network and our internal customers’ requirement on interconnect solutions. You'll work backwards to devise hardware solutions by influencing the broad industry and/or to develop software tools with sister teams to maintain a highly available network that delights AWS customers. You design and implement processes and mechanisms that both help the team to deliver business impact to the organization in a systemic way, while also helping to raise the bar on our operational excellence.

Operating at the scale we do, there is no blueprint for how to do what we do, which encourages our engineers to identify and develop simple solutions to complex problems. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. We work closely with our internal partners that design, build and operate the network to ensure that our solutions meet their needs and exceed their expectations.

Beyond product delivery we actively manage the fleet or routers in a network that grows by 70% annually. This means tracking key business and operational metrics to ensure that we operate smoothly and minimize or eliminate customer impact due to device related issues for a transparent AWS customer experience.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.

- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Tech deployment (TD) within Amazon Robotics (AR). title: WFM Manager, LMAQ
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.

Key job responsibilities

• Own forecasting, planning, and execution to ensure operational performance meets or exceeds targets

• Ability to partner with multiple teams and build strong stakeholder relationships to drive HC planning for the LMAQ space

• Own end-to-end delivery of multiple projects focused on performance optimization and cost efficiency

• Work through and influence WFM leads and analysts across each space without direct authority, aligning them to a common planning and execution standard
• Demonstrate a strong eye for detail, uncovering trends, going beyond the obvious, and identifying root causes
• Thrive in ambiguous environments and proactively take on new challenges
• Influence hiring quality by raising the bar on interviewing standards across the organization

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

3.データ集計とレポート作成： 配送スピードや輸送能力に関するデータを集計し、定期レポートやダッシュボードを更新・整備する。実装前後の指標を正確にまとめ、チームの意思決定を支援する。

4.ドキュメント整備： 課題・進捗・決定事項を簡潔に文書化し、SOP（標準手順書）やチェックリスト、議事録を作成・更新する。チームの情報を整理し、参照しやすい状態に保つ。

5.標準化・運用改善の支援： 繰り返し発生する作業を整理し、マネージャー・プロジェクト担当者の指示のもとで、テンプレートやチェックリストの整備など運用改善をサポートする。

1. Support project operations: track progress of assigned projects against defined goals and design direction, and keep milestones, tasks, and schedules up to date. Report progress and issues to the manager and project owners weekly.

2. Coordinate and communicate: work day to day with internal stakeholders, set up meetings, organize agendas and action items, and share information. Promptly escalate issues or risks as they arise.

3. Compile data and report: gather data on delivery speed and transport capacity, and update and maintain regular reports and dashboards. Accurately summarize before/after metrics to support the team's decision-making.

4. Maintain documentation: concisely document issues, progress, and decisions, and create and update SOPs, checklists, and meeting notes so team information stays organized and easy to reference.

5. Support standardization and process improvement: organize recurring tasks and, under the direction of the manager and project owners, help improve operations by maintaining templates and checklists.

A day in the life
本ポジションでは、JP Easy Shipのネットワークプランニングチームの一員として活動していただきます。日次では、配送スピードや輸送能力のデータを集計してモニタリング資料を更新し、関係部門との連絡・調整を行います。週次では、担当プロジェクトの進捗やリスクを整理してチームに報告し、シニアプログラムマネージャーやプログラムマネージャーと優先順位を確認します。月次以降のサイクルでは、実装した改善の効果を測定・レポートし、繰り返し発生した課題を標準手順（SOP）やダッシュボードの改善に反映する作業を支援します。

In this role, you will be part of JP Easy Ship's Network Planning team. Daily, you will compile data on delivery speed and transportation capacity to update monitoring materials, and communicate and coordinate with stakeholder teams. Weekly, you will organize and report project progress and risks to the team, and review priorities with the Senior Program Manager and program managers. On a monthly and longer cycle, you will help measure and report the impact of implemented improvements, and support reflecting recurring issues into SOPs and dashboards.

About the team
本ポジションは、JP Easy Shipのネットワークプランニングチームに所属します。当チームは、ファーストマイルからラストマイルまでのエンドツーエンドのネットワーク設計とキャパシティコントロールを通じて、配送スピードとコスト最適化の両立を担っています。JP Easy Shipは急成長中のビジネスであり、当チームはそのネットワークの中核を担っています。

This role sits within JP Easy Ship's Network Planning team, which owns end-to-end network design and capacity control connecting first mile to last mile, balancing delivery speed with cost efficiency across a fast-growing business.
