title: EasyShip プログラムサポートスペシャリスト, Easy Ship, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
[English followed by Japanese]

役割概要

プログラムマネジメント（PM）チームの日常的な業務運営、事務管理、レポーティング、データ分析、およびデータ管理活動をサポートし、細部に注意を払い、主体的に行動できるプログラムサポートスペシャリストを募集しています。本ポジションは、PMが戦略的なプログラム推進に集中できるよう、チームの業務およびデータ基盤を管理する重要な役割です。

主な職務内容
レポーティング＆データサポート
PMチーム向けの週次/月次ビジネスレポートおよびダッシュボードの作成、維持、配信
複数のソースからデータを収集、クリーニング、整理を行い、プログラムのトラッキングおよびレビューをサポート
プログラムのマイルストーン、成果物、アクションアイテムに関するトラッカー（Excel、Quip、社内ツール等）の構築および維持管理の支援
PMの要望に応じた臨時データ抽出およびサマリーの作成

データ分析
プログラムおよび業務データにおけるトレンド、パターン、異常値を特定するための初級～中級レベルのデータ分析の実施
ビジネスレビュー（WBR、MBR、QBR）に向けたデータに基づくインサイトの準備においてPMを支援
ピボットテーブル、チャート、ビジュアルサマリーを作成し、生データを実用的なインサイトに変換
データの不整合に対する根本原因分析を実施し、PMに問題を先回りして指摘・エスカレーションする
定期レビューサイクル向けの標準化された分析テンプレートの構築および維持管理
複数のソースからデータを収集・統合し、構造化された形式で調査結果を提示することで、ディープダイブ分析を支援

データ管理
チームレベルのトラッカー、データベース、共有リポジトリにおけるデータの正確性・整合性の維持に一貫して責任を持つ
チームファイル全体にわたるデータ入力基準、命名規則、バージョン管理プロトコルの策定および徹底
重複、欠損、不整合を特定するための定期的なデータ監査の実施
共有データフォルダ、Wiki、ナレッジリポジトリのアクセス権限管理および整理
PMの指示に基づくデータ移行、統合、およびアーカイブ作業の支援
主要プログラムメトリクスおよび業務データの信頼できる唯一の情報源（Single Source of Truth / SSOT）の維持管理
プログラムトラッキングのためのタイムリーかつ正確なデータ入力を確保するための部門横断チームとの連携

事務サポート
定例会議（WBR、MBR、プログラムレビュー）のスケジュール調整、運営管理（アジェンダ作成および議事録を含む）
チームドキュメント、Wiki、共有ドライブの整理整頓および最新状態の維持管理
新規チームメンバーのオンボーディングロジスティクス支援（アクセス申請、ツールセットアップ、オリエンテーションのスケジュール調整）
必要に応じた発注書、調達申請、ベンダー関連書類の処理
チームレベルのコミュニケーション、配信リスト、カレンダー調整の管理

プログラム運営サポート
レビューからのオープンアクションアイテムをトラッキングし、期限超過アイテムをPMにエスカレーション
複数のワークストリームにわたるプログラムタイムラインおよびステータス更新の維持管理
ビジネスドキュメント（BRD、ステータスアップデート、ステークホルダー向けプレゼン資料）の作成およびフォーマッティングの支援
ステークホルダーへのフォローアップによる、プログラム成果物に対する部門横断インプットの調整

ビジネス＆プロセス改善
繰り返し発生するプロセスの効率化機会を特定し、シンプルな自動化またはテンプレートソリューションを提案
チームSOP、テンプレート、レポーティングフォーマットの標準化を支援
チームイベント、オフサイト、ナレッジシェアリングセッションの企画運営を支援

Role Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Program Support Specialist to support the Program Management team, in day-to-day operational, administrative, reporting, data analysis, and data management activities. This role is critical in enabling PMs to focus on strategic program delivery by managing the operational and data backbone of the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting & Data Support:
• Prepare, maintain, and distribute weekly/monthly business reports and dashboards for the PM team.
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources to support program tracking and reviews.
• Assist in building and maintaining trackers (e.g., Excel, Quip, internal tools) for program milestones, deliverables, and action items.
• Generate ad-hoc data pulls and summaries as requested by PMs.

Data Analysis:
• Perform basic to intermediate data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in program and operational data.
• Support PMs in preparing data-backed insights for business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs).
• Create pivot tables, charts, and visual summaries to translate raw data into actionable insights.
• Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and flag issues proactively to PM owners.
• Build and maintain standardized analysis templates for recurring review cycles.
• Support deep-dive analysis by compiling data from multiple sources and presenting findings in a structured format.

Data Management:
• Own the end-to-end data hygiene and integrity of team-level trackers, databases, and shared repositories.
• Establish and enforce data entry standards, naming conventions, and version control protocols across team files.
• Perform regular data audits to identify duplicates, missing entries, and inconsistencies.
• Manage access permissions and organization of shared data folders, wikis, and knowledge repositories.
• Support data migration, consolidation, and archival activities as directed by PMs.
• Maintain a single source of truth (SSOT) for key program metrics and operational data.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate data inputs for program tracking.

Administrative Support:
• Schedule, coordinate, and manage recurring meetings (WBRs, MBRs, program reviews) including agenda preparation and meeting notes.
• Maintain team documentation, wikis, and shared drives in an organized and up-to-date manner.
• Support onboarding logistics for new team members (access requests, tool setup, orientation scheduling).
• Process purchase orders, procurement requests, and vendor-related paperwork as needed.
• Manage team-level communications, distribution lists, and calendar coordination.

Program Operations Support:
• Track open action items from reviews and escalate overdue items to the PM owners.
• Maintain program timelines and status updates across multiple workstreams.
• Support the creation and formatting of business documents (BRDs, status updates, stakeholder decks).
• Coordinate cross-functional inputs for program deliverables by following up with stakeholders.

Business & Process Improvement:
• Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive processes and propose simple automation or template solutions.
• Support standardization of team SOPs, templates, and reporting formats.
• Assist in organizing team events, offsites, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Basic qualifications

- プログラムマネジメントまたはオペレーション環境での1年以上の実務経験
- データ抽出およびデータ処理における1年以上のハンズオン経験
- Microsoft Excelの熟練（ピボットテーブル、VLOOKUP、条件付き書式、基本関数、チャート）

- 優れた文書および口頭でのコミュニケーション能力
- 複数のタスクを同時に管理し、期限を遵守する能力
- データ処理およびレポーティングにおける高い注意力と正確性
- 日本語ビジネスレベル（JLPT N2相当）必須（日本拠点向け業務のため）

- • 1+ year of experience working in a program management or operations environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Amazon社内ツール（Quip、Wiki、SIM/チケッティング、QuickSight等）の使用経験

- プロセス志向の思考を伴う優れた組織管理能力

title: Senior Partner Development Manager - France, Partners - France
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to be part of a team that is redefining the IT industry? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next paradigm shift in cloud computing and AI, and is looking for world class candidates to help drive the strategic growth and field activation of some of our most important Global System Integrator (GSI) and Business Consulting & Advisory Partner (BCAP) partnerships across France.

The AWS Partner Network (APN) is core to how we help customers transform their businesses. As part of the AWS Partner Organization (APO), you will own the strategic growth and field activation of a portfolio of Global System Integrators (GSIs) and Business Consulting & Advisory Partners (BCAP) in France. You will be in the field with partners, driving joint go-to-market execution and accelerating revenue through active co-sell motions. You will own the joint go-to-market strategies, provide direct sales support to joint opportunities, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and drive overall partner expansion aligned with AWS strategic priorities. This role requires someone who is customer-obsessed, delivery-focused, and able to think strategically about long-term partner and customer success.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end partner relationships at area level across a managed portfolio of GSI and BCAP partners, serving as the primary strategic advisor and activation lead
• Develop and execute Area Partner Business Plans that translate partner capabilities and market opportunities into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes
• Design and deliver Joint Go-To-Market (JGTM) strategies — vertical solution positioning, demand generation campaigns, field alignment, and activation programmes — prioritising investments that drive the highest customer and business impact
• Build multi-quarter capacity roadmaps across priority workloads (Migration, Modernisation, GenAI, Industry Solutions) and drive execution against milestones
• Spend most of your time in the field with partner sellers and AWS account teams — running GTM bootcamps, joint customer sessions, and co-sell deal support
• Drive proactive pipeline generation — originating, qualifying, and advancing both Amazon-Originated (AO) and Partner-Originated (PO) opportunities through the ACE co-sell motion
• Coach partner sales teams on co-sell best practices, advancing their motion from reactive deal registration to proactive, seller-initiated pipeline creation at scale
• Lead complex IT and Business transformation deals with partners, bringing AWS best practices to deal execution
• Enable partners to build and position industry-specific and workload-specific solutions addressing key customer needs (e.g., VMware displacement, GenAI adoption, cloud migration at scale)
• Manage partner funding and MDF investments with a high bar for ROI, ensuring alignment with joint business objectives
• Build and maintain senior-level relationships with partner C-suite and practice leadership, orchestrating executive engagement, quarterly business reviews, and multi-year strategic planning
• Conduct regular pipeline and business reviews using data-driven frameworks, proactively raising findings and recommendations to leadership

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in business development, partner development, sales, or alliances management
- Experience working directly with Global System Integrators and/or large consulting and advisory firms
- Demonstrated success building and executing partner business plans with measurable revenue outcomes
- Deep expertise in enterprise IT transformation — including cloud migration, modernisation, ERP, data centre exit strategies, and/or GenAI adoption
- Proven ability to design and execute joint go-to-market strategies that generate measurable pipeline
- Experience in AI, cloud computing, enterprise software, or infrastructure technology sectors
- Track record of influencing cross-functional teams across organisations without direct authority
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C1 level or above

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, commerce, business administration or equivalent
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Familiarity with the AWS platform, products, solutions, and capabilities
- Experience activating GSI and/or advisory partners in the field
- In-depth knowledge of the French market and business landscape
- Experience developing, negotiating and executing complex business and legal agreements

title: IT-tekniker, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services ansvarar för design, planering, leverans och drift av AWS globala infrastruktur. Vi ser till att molnet fungerar – dygnet runt, världen över.

Vi ansvarar för infrastrukturen i AWS datacenter, inklusive servrar, lagringslösningar, nätverksutrustning samt kraft- och kylsystem. Det är denna infrastruktur som säkerställer att våra kunder har tillförlitlig och kontinuerlig tillgång till de molntjänster och den innovation de förlitar sig på.

Vi tar oss an komplexa utmaningar där tusentals faktorer påverkar allt från leveranskedjor till den dagliga driften. Nu söker vi engagerade och kompetenta medarbetare som vill vara med och utveckla, driva och säkra den infrastruktur som får AWS att fungera.

Du blir en del av ett mångsidigt team med mjukvaru-, hårdvaru- och nätverksingenjörer, specialister inom leveranskedjan, säkerhetsexperter, driftchefer och andra nyckelkompetenser. Tillsammans med kollegor inom hela AWS bidrar du till att upprätthålla högsta standard inom säkerhet och driftsäkerhet, samtidigt som vi levererar skalbar kapacitet till våra kunder på ett så kostnadseffektivt sätt som möjligt.
Hos oss möter du en inkluderande kultur där nya idéer uppmuntras och du får möjlighet att omsätta dem i praktiken.

Vi söker nu datacentertekniker (Data Center Technician) som vill bli en del av vårt växande team inom Data Center Operations (DCO).

Som datacentertekniker arbetar du med drift, underhåll och felsökning av den IT-infrastruktur som ligger till grund för AWS molntjänster. Du ansvarar för att identifiera och lösa tekniska problem inom bland annat serverhårdvara, nätverksutrustning, fiberanslutningar och relaterade system.

Du blir en viktig del av teamet och fungerar som en central resurs vid teknisk felsökning och incidenthantering. I rollen utvecklar du din kompetens inom både hårdvara och mjukvara samtidigt som du arbetar självständigt med att identifiera, analysera och åtgärda olika typer av infrastrukturproblem.

Du förväntas kunna hantera och lösa de flesta vanligt förekommande tekniska problemen. Vid mer komplexa ärenden samarbetar du med specialiserade supportteam för att säkerställa effektiva lösningar och minimera påverkan på driften.

Key job responsibilities
Säkerhet

Du följer och upprätthåller AWS höga säkerhetsstandarder och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla och stärka en säkerhetskultur i världsklass. Du tar ansvar för säkerhetsinitiativ och projekt som främjar ett säkert arbetssätt och bidrar till en trygg arbetsmiljö.

Datacenterdrift (DCO)
Du diagnostiserar och felsöker problem med hårdvara och nätverksutrustning och utför nödvändiga fysiska reparationer. Du hanterar incidenter inom fastställda servicenivåavtal (SLA) och genomför rotorsaksanalyser vid utrustningsfel för att identifiera bakomliggande problem och bidra till långsiktiga lösningar.

Arbetet kan innebära manuell hantering och lyft av utrustning i enlighet med gällande arbetsmiljöföreskrifter. Du arbetar enligt ett roterande skiftschema som omfattar morgon- och nattskift samt helger, eftersom datacentren behöver fungera dygnet runt.
Plats och körkort.

AWS datacenter är ofta belägna i områden med begränsad tillgång till kollektivtrafik. Därför krävs ett körkort giltigt inom EU för den här tjänsten.
Arbetsplats och arbetsschema
Detta är en helt platsbaserad tjänst där arbetet utförs på datacentret. Närvaro på plats är nödvändig eftersom rollen innebär praktiskt arbete med verksamhetskritisk IT-infrastruktur.

A day in the life
I rollen arbetar du med AWS ärendehanteringssystem för att prioritera, hantera och följa upp tekniska ärenden. Du felsöker och löser komplexa problem med serverhårdvara och arbetar strukturerat för att återställa funktion och minimera påverkan på driften.

Du blir en del av ett samarbetsinriktat team som säkerställer att AWS molninfrastruktur fungerar tillförlitligt. Du hanterar automatiserade arbetsorder och instruktioner från teamledningen, samtidigt som du planerar och prioriterar ditt arbete utifrån verksamhetens behov.
Din förmåga att hantera tekniska ärenden, följa eskaleringsrutiner och samarbeta med andra supportteam är viktig för att uppfylla AWS höga krav på teknisk kompetens och operativ kvalitet. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till att upprätthålla tillgängligheten, effektiviteten och tillförlitligheten i datacentrets infrastruktur.

Vi söker engagerade och tekniskt kunniga medarbetare som vill lösa problem, utveckla sin kompetens och bidra till nästa steg i utvecklingen av AWS molninfrastruktur.

About the team
Olika erfarenheter är en styrka - På AWS värdesätter vi olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och kompetenser. Även om du inte uppfyller alla kvalifikationer som anges i annonsen uppmuntrar vi dig att söka tjänsten. En inkluderande arbetskultur - På AWS värdesätter vi nyfikenhet, samhörighet och olika perspektiv. Balans mellan arbete och privatliv - Vi värdesätter en hållbar balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Att lyckas i arbetet ska inte behöva ske på bekostnad av livet utanför jobbet. title: Prod Compliance Sr. Associate, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Compliance Associate, your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.

Required Skills:
• Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
• Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
• Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
• Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
• Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
• Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
• Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, payment processing, IT services, human resources, quality assurance
- Advanced Excel skills (VBA)
- Knowledge of database querying (SQL)
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management, Fast Moving Consumer Goods company, or corporate role
- Experience with data analysis in quantitative fields and building data and decision support systems

title: Solutions Architect - AWS WWPS DoW, US Army Solutions Architecture, U.S. Army Solutions Architecte
descriptionHtml:
Do you like helping the U.S. Army and broader Department of War implement cloud computing solutions and solve difficult technical problems? Do you have a knack for helping these groups understand application architectures and integration approaches, and the consultative skills to launch a project on a trajectory to success?

As a Solutions Architect II at Amazon, you will help accelerate our rapidly growing Department of War business as part of the World Wide Public Sector practice. You will shape and deliver on a strategy to build broad use of Amazon Web Services (e.g., Amazon EKS, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2, Amazon Bedrock, etc.) directly with customers and our ecosystem of system integrators and solution providers. Your work will span data services, generative AI, serverless, compute, and storage, with a particular focus on database modernization and migration efforts that improve how the Army operates and delivers on its mission. This is an opportunity to join a truly collaborative technical team while developing your skills and furthering your career at Amazon.

You will provide thoughtful technical design and offer sensitivity to our customer needs in the Defense markets for cloud computing working with a truly innovative sales and business development team. You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solution architect community. You will have the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise architecture.

You should apply to this role if you are passionate about:
- Creating, building, educating, training and designing cloud computing architectures, especially if it’s for Defense Department customers.
- Getting hands on to experiment, build, and demonstrate technology solutions leveraging the latest AI technologies to expedite delivery and quality.
- Deep-dive technical discussions around design and the curiosity to keep your technical skills current while maintaining a pulse on industry trends
- Our company credo: “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” It’s critical to love what you do and take pride in your value proposition to our customers.

Must be willing to travel within the US and overseas up to 35%. This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver cloud architectures for Army workloads spanning data services, generative AI, serverless, compute, and storage, evaluating trade-offs across areas such as data store selection, scaling strategy, and failover mechanisms.
- Own the technical engagement and success of implementation projects, including defining implementation architectures and responding to RFPs, while developing deep expertise in AWS technologies and how applications are built on the platform.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor and security subject matter expert to Army and Department of Defense stakeholders, helping them identify opportunities and risks with their technical decisions and guiding solution adoption.
- Lead database modernization and migration engagements, leveraging repeatable design patterns and reference architectures where appropriate and creating new reusable designs when novel approaches are required.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge across the Solutions Architect community through presentations, workshops, written guidance, and peer collaboration.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with an architecture review alongside Army technical staff, where you help them evaluate database options and security controls for a migration workload. After lunch, you join a peer design review with fellow Solutions Architects to pressure-test a serverless approach you have been developing. Later in the afternoon, you work with a system integrator partner to align on an implementation architecture for an upcoming RFP, then wrap up by preparing a workshop for customer technical leadership.

About the team
Our team is a dedicated group of Solutions Architects within the World Wide Public Sector practice, focused on supporting the U.S. Army and the broader Department of Defense. We partner closely with Army stakeholders, system integrators, and solution providers to understand their goals and architect cloud solutions that create lasting operational impact. As the 16th member of this team, you will join a collaborative group that learns from each other through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.

We are expanding our team as we increase capabilities and services for the Army through CY2027 and beyond, making this a compelling time to join. If you are excited about continuous learning and shaping how a critical government organization adopts cloud at scale, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Bachelor's degree, or CASP+ (CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner) or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or Cloud+ or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

title: Sr Retail Manager - Households Goods, Retail Consumables
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Brazil is looking for a dynamic Retail Manager to play an important role within the Retail team by adding selection, analyzing business data, driving vendor performance, negotiating terms and handling promotions. As a Retail Manager, you will report to the head of category and developing relationships with several of our key vendors and partners. You will work with Brazilian and global vendors to drive all aspects of terms improvements, which includes analysis and projections, as well as direct negotiations with decision makers in local vendors. Additionally, you will increase product category sales, by driving store marketing promotions, negotiating partners to improve selection, and reacting to industry-related economic trends.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to analyze and communicate complex terms and margin structure and work well across other teams including Finance, Marketing and Inventory Management. Candidates who are organized, flexible, creative, analytical, and able to drive negotiations through completion will be highly appreciated. Strong ownership values, a real passion for innovation, and hustle are also key to succeed in this position.
If you are passionate about e-commerce and career growth, this opportunity with Amazon.com.br is for you!

Key job responsibilities
Retail Managers focus on and act at the intersection of customers, vendors, and functional teams:
- Customers: They rely on specialized teams for customer and category information and insights, and works with and influences other teams to get the category-specific customer needs addressed. The Retail Manager is responsible to hold category-specific knowledge about customers and their needs, emerging product trends and the market segment evolution, and new business opportunities.
- Vendors: RM are the ultimate owners of the vendor relationship, with a direct focus on the top vendors that drive the vast majority of sales. They are directly responsible for auditing and escalating performance, improving overall terms and cost structures of the relationship by means of negotiation, and for developing long term partnerships with new and existing vendors to drive topline and selection fueling category growth.
- Central and Functional Teams: As a business owner, the RM represents customer and business needs in interaction with central teams, projects and initiatives. The Retail Manager drives central teams for the evolution of customer-facing and internal systems to improve the customer experience from the category perspective. At the same time, they implements centrally driven initiatives within the category to drive CX or cost improvements, even more important prioritize based on impact and potential tradeoffs, and if need be pushing back on selected initiatives.

A day in the life
Retail Managers are owners of the Retail business. Either for subcategories or subgroup of vendors they own the respective business end-to-end including the entire P&L, from topline down to free cash flow. They manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel. While they focus their activities on our most strategically relevant vendors and holdouts, they audit and escalate the performance of lower tiered vendors.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data to influence business decisions
- Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
- Experience with business analysis and P&L management
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in account management, project/program management, or buying
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

title: Robotics Field Hardware Engineer, Robotics Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 13, 2026

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Robotics Technical Services (RTS).

We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. The RTS Field Support team provides critical support to internal fulfillment and transportation network customers relying on advanced robotics technology.

You will be responsible for a technical product portfolio. In this role, you serve as the vital link between on-site technicians and RTS engineering teams, ensuring maximum performance of advanced robotics systems. You will launch new systems, develop preventative maintenance procedures, ensure spare part availability, proactively monitor system performance, provide troubleshooting support, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across Amazon's fulfillment network. You will establish standard operating procedures, performance metrics, and feedback mechanisms that enable the RTS team to scale effectively. Working closely with technical support teams and regional support managers, you will build a cohesive organization responsible for the safety, reliability, and performance of emerging robotics technology. This role requires independent judgment and comfort working with ambiguity in a complex, fast-paced, high-throughput environment where multi-tasking is essential.

Key job responsibilities
- Provide on-site support for new product implementations, upgrades, hardware audits, and troubleshooting for advanced robotics systems
- Partner with site-level reliability (RME) and controls teams to maximize advanced robotics system performance
- Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical and system issues across the RTS product suite
- Design and implement electro-mechanical tools, fixtures, and diagnostic solutions to minimize troubleshooting and machine downtime
- Develop and implement proactive monitoring tools to measure safety, reliability, and performance of advanced robotics systems
- Create escalation processes, standard operating procedures, and preventative maintenance protocols for the RTS product suite
- Design and lead training sessions and develop training content for on-site RME teams
- Develop and implement spare parts management systems and processes
- Produce performance reports and provide "voice of the customer" feedback to development and support teams
- Up to 75% travel expected

A day in the life
Your day begins by reviewing system performance reports for your regional portfolio. Perhaps the metrics dashboard revealed unusual performance at a facility or spare parts dropped below threshold at a site. You analyze metrics to identify trends and risks, developing de-risking actions for leadership's weekly business review. You troubleshoot with RME technicians via video, walking them through diagnostic procedures. On-site, you conduct hardware audits for new deployments, gathering customer feedback. Afternoons include designing tools, optimizing processes, and coordinating with regional managers on scaling strategies. Throughout, you're the critical link between field technicians and engineering teams. Every member on the team leverages AI to drive efficiency and most build with it; you will be provided ample learning resources and challenges to demonstrate your skillset.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
RTS Field Hardware Support Engineers (FHSE) ensure that our customers—site Reliability and Maintenance Engineers—are equipped to independently maintain Amazon Robotics technologies. Our team achieves this by identifying deficiencies, communicating risk, and proposing mitigation strategies. Our hands-on approach to testing, troubleshooting, and investigating puts us in the shoes of operators and technicians in the field. We work backwards from these insights to satisfy engineering requirements, partnering with safety, hardware, software, and cross-functional support teams.

- 4+ years of systems engineering experience
- Experience maintaining the resilience and reliability of services by troubleshooting deployment failures, creating infrastructure as code, creating resources (alarms, metrics, IAM role credentials), infrastructure provisioning and patching hosts
- Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
- Experience performing testing and tuning
- Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
- Experience designing, implementing, and executing systems and processes to ensure the reliability and performance of products and components, including the use of tools and techniques such as failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and reliability testing to identify root causes of failures and develop strategies to prevent recurrence.
- Experience using data analytics tools to monitor equipment performance, predict failures, and drive continuous improvement

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Sr Forward Deployment Engineering
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Key job responsibilities
Lead technical delivery across customer engagements. Own the technical strategy and execution for complex, multi-workstream customer AI programs. Make architecture decisions that span multiple services and organizational boundaries. Align technical approach with the customer's long-term technology strategy. Requires 30–50% travel.

Architect and build production AI systems at scale. Design the foundational architectures — multi-agent orchestration, enterprise retrieval systems, decision intelligence platforms — for the most complex customer engagements. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

Own production excellence across workstreams. Define operational standards, evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria for AI systems across your engagement scope. Establish mechanisms (testing strategies, observability standards, incident response playbooks) that ensure AI systems remain healthy. Drive operational improvements that raise the bar for the team.

Scale the team's effectiveness. Define engineering patterns, contribute to the interview and hiring process, and mentor junior FDEs into independent contributors. Coach others on system design, customer engagement, and production operations. Drive engineering excellence standards within your scope.

Accelerate customer transformation. Identify systemic opportunities to expand AI adoption across the customer organization. Create accelerators and reusable platforms that reduce time-to-value from months to weeks. Feed learnings back into AWS services and the FDE practice.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Front-End Engineer II, FBA Placement
descriptionHtml:
READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?

How would you build the next generation of experiences that help hundreds of thousands of sellers make smarter decisions about where, when, and how to send billions of products into Amazon’s fulfillment network?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a global service that gives sellers access to Amazon’s world-class fulfillment and distribution network. Sellers—from large global brands to small businesses and entrepreneurs across 135 countries—rely on FBA to store their inventory, fulfill customer orders, and deliver products quickly and reliably to customers around the world.

The FBA Placement organization is at the heart of this experience. We build intelligent systems and seller-facing experiences that determine how inventory enters and is distributed across Amazon’s fulfillment network. Our products help sellers understand their inbound options and make decisions across cost, delivery speed, inventory placement, capacity, and operational constraints—while helping Amazon position inventory closer to customers.

We are looking for a Front-End Engineer II to help build the next generation of FBA inbound and placement experiences.

As a Front-End Engineer II, you will work at the intersection of customer experience and large-scale distributed systems. You will translate complex supply-chain decisions and optimization capabilities into simple, intuitive experiences that sellers can understand and act on. You will build responsive, performant, accessible, and maintainable web applications used by sellers around the world.

You will collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, software engineers, and science teams to take ideas from concept through launch. You will influence front-end architecture, establish reusable patterns and components, and raise the engineering bar for seller experiences across FBA.

This is an opportunity to solve challenging customer and technical problems, influence the evolution of a global product, and build experiences that directly affect how billions of units move through Amazon’s fulfillment network.

Come join us and help build the future of FBA.

Key job responsibilities
As a Front-End Engineer II, you will:

Design, develop, test, and launch high-quality web experiences for FBA sellers worldwide.
Translate complex workflows involving inventory placement, capacity, cost, and delivery options into simple and intuitive customer experiences.
Work closely with UX designers and product managers to turn customer needs and product concepts into scalable technical solutions.
Own significant front-end features and components from design through implementation, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Build reusable UI components, frameworks, and patterns that improve consistency and accelerate development across FBA experiences.
Make sound architectural and technology decisions for large-scale front-end applications while balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
Integrate front-end experiences with APIs and distributed backend services, designing gracefully for latency, failures, asynchronous operations, and changing data.
Deliver responsive, performant, secure, and accessible experiences across browsers, devices, marketplaces, and seller workflows.
Apply strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals to write simple, extensible, testable, and maintainable code.
Improve engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to development practices.
Investigate customer and operational issues across the full application stack and drive them to resolution.
Collaborate with engineers across FBA and Amazon to influence technical direction and deliver experiences spanning multiple systems and organizations.
Mentor other engineers, contribute to engineering best practices, and help raise the technical bar of the team.

A day in the life
You might start your day reviewing customer feedback and operational metrics for a recently launched seller experience. You could then work with a UX designer and product manager to refine a new workflow that helps sellers understand their inventory placement and delivery options.

Later, you may collaborate with backend and science engineers to define an API contract for a new optimization capability, review a teammate’s design or code change, and spend focused development time building and testing a new experience.

The problems we solve often span UX, front-end architecture, distributed services, and complex supply-chain decisions. You will have significant ownership over how those capabilities ultimately come together as a simple experience for our sellers.

About the team
The FBA Placement organization owns the technology that determines where and when seller inventory enters Amazon’s fulfillment network.

Our systems evaluate factors including fulfillment cost, customer delivery speed, available capacity, seller preferences, and network constraints to provide sellers with inbound options and recommendations. These decisions have significant impact on both the seller experience and Amazon’s fulfillment network.

Our front-end experiences are where these sophisticated optimization systems become tangible for sellers. Our goal is to make complex supply-chain decisions understandable and actionable—helping sellers confidently choose the right inbound options without needing to understand the complexity of the systems operating behind them.

We are a multidisciplinary organization spanning front-end and backend engineering, product, UX, and applied science. We operate with a high degree of ownership and encourage engineers to influence both the customer experience and the underlying technical architecture.

If you enjoy turning complex problems into simple customer experiences, building products at global scale, and working across the full technology stack, FBA Placement offers a unique opportunity to make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
- 1+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
- Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
- Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node

descriptionHtml:

- Experience with version control systems and CI/CD pipeline implementation

title: Regional WHS Manager (AMZL), Workplace Health and Safety (WHS)
descriptionHtml:
The Regional WHS Manager will be responsible for two regions of AMZL Brazil partnering with a regional operations team in our Delivery Station Network to execute company Safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates.

The Regional WHS Manager must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.

The Regional WHS Manager must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company WHS policies and assist the regional teams in incorporating our WHS standards at their sites.
The Regional WHS Manger will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company Safety policies.

The Regional WHS Manager will be required to possess excellent WHS program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations.

The Regional WHS Manager will be responsible to lead a team of WHS Managers in their region. This individual must create and execute leadership development plans for their WHS Managers and WHS Associates on their team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to their WHS teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon professional. This individual must also demonstrate the ability to judge and assess WHS talent and select appropriate bench strength to current and future business needs.


Key job responsibilities
• Manage overall compliance with local requirements and authorities.
• Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies and regulatory requirements
• Measure the regions and sites’ performance against published requirements in WHS policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
• Ensure WHS recordkeeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business WHS initiatives.
• Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. Deliver quality projects on time to Operations.
• Analyze WHS metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
• Audit recordkeeping practices and Global WHS Database entries to ensure compliance to global WHS standards and local regulations.
• Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
• Manage and mentor the region WHS Managers and EHS Associates in your assigned sites.
• Spend time at the sortation centers, and delivery stations, and seek input from WHS teams, Associates and leaders on WHS program improvement opportunities.
• Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
• Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required WHS training.
• Review for effectiveness the deployed WHS tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
• Partner with corporate and other regional field WHS personnel to leverage global WHS standards.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, InfoPath, SharePoint, etc.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

title: Software Development Engineer, WW Returns and Recommerce
descriptionHtml:
Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.

We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.

Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Warehouse Automation Manager, Engineering
descriptionHtml:

Amazon is looking for a Warehouse Automation Manager to drive innovation and product development for material handling equipment (MHE) across our operations. You will research emerging technologies, evaluate cost-effective alternatives, and collaborate with Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance teams to deliver solutions that increase productivity and capacity. title: Senior Program Manager, EU AMXL
descriptionHtml:
Our Program Managers are always thinking about the bigger picture. At Amazon, every position offers the chance to influence business decisions and shape what comes next. As a Senior Program Manager in EU AMXL Growth, Profitability and Programs, you will sit at the center of one of Amazon's most premium selection businesses: the operation that moves, delivers, assembles, and installs the largest and most valuable items customers buy. You will own programs that span the entire value chain, from fulfilment and middle mile through last mile, delivery, returns, and the profitability engine that ties it all together.

This is the strategic arm of the EU AMXL Strategy Execution team. You will be the connective tissue that keeps a fast-scaling, multi-country organization coordinated, accountable, and aligned on what matters. You will build and run the operating infrastructure that lets EU AMXL leadership deliver critical programs, track progress, and make high-quality decisions with confidence, and you will personally lead the high-stakes programs that define the three-year path for the business.

You will captain the strategic leadership reviews that steer the organization: Quarterly Business Reviews and the OP1 and OP2 operating plans. You will manage programs that cut across every EU AMXL function and coordinate with NA and International teams, including the country expansion portfolio that brings the AMXL service to new markets. The role carries frequent exposure to seior leaders and decison makers, so you will shape narratives, challenge content quality, and drive clarity at the most senior forums in the organization.

This is a role for someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity: designing the frameworks, cadences, and mechanisms that let a large, distributed organization move fast without losing sight of the long-term vision.

Key job responsibilities
1) Own and operate the EU AMXL planning cadence (OP1, OP2), business reviews, and reporting that keeps the organization aligned from working teams to VP forums.

2) Captain the strategic leadership reviews end to end (QBR, MBR, BMBR, OP1, OP2), coordinating content across 10+ teams to quality bar-raising and executive readiness.

3) Lead high-stakes programs spanning Fulfilment, Middle Mile, Last Mile OTR and UTR, and Returns, driving measurable improvement against the three-year profitability plan.

4) Own the country expansion portfolio: coordinate the programs that bring AMXL to new EU markets, working backwards from launch readiness across operations and finance.

5) Build the mechanisms that keep the organization on plan: trackable goals, quarterly status, year-end reviews, and governance that surfaces risk and drives resolution.

6) Design program management infrastructure (templates, trackers, SOPs) that lets EU AMXL compare initiatives, plan projects, and report results in a common language.

7) Coordinate across Supply Chain, Transportation, Finance, Safety, People, CX, and ACES, and partner with NA and International counterparts across regions.

8) Own the technology roadmap to automate EU AMXL reporting at parity with NA, replacing manual document production with scalable, self-serve mechanisms.

9) Develop program management talent: mentor and coach PMs across EU AMXL teams, and spread the standards and ways of working that make the organization stronger.

A day in the life
No two weeks look the same, because you sit at the intersection of strategy and execution for the whole EU AMXL business. One morning you are running the timeline for a VP-level Quarterly Business Review, pulling inputs from a dozen section owners across four countries and sharpening the strategic narrative before it reaches a Director. That afternoon you are deep in the profitability program, connecting a middle-mile cost initiative to its downstream effect on last-mile delivery and returns, so leadership sees one coherent story instead of six disconnected updates.

The next day you are working the country expansion portfolio: syncing with reatail, 3P, Transporation and Ops teams on launch readiness, comparing mechanisms that already work in other regions, and translating them into an EU plan. You will facilitate a pre-review with directors to pressure-test an OP2 narrative, then step back to improve the goal-tracking framework so the next quarter's updates are more actionable.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Safety, and CX leaders, not as a passive coordinator, but as a thought partner who understands the business well enough to challenge the content and push for clarity. Some weeks lean heavy on document production and stakeholder management. Others are about stepping back to design the systems that make the whole machine run. Across all of them, you are the person who connects fulfilment, middle mile, last mile, returns, and profitability into a single line of sight, and who keeps the organization moving in the same direction.


About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like large domestic appliances and furniture. Our team manages the end-to-end supply chain across fulfilment, delivery, and returns. What sets this service apart is the extra level of customer care: we don't just deliver large items, we unpack, assemble, and install them, and take away old items where needed. The EU AMXL Strategy Execution team is the operating and strategic backbone of the EU AMXL organization. The Growth, Profitability and Programs function within it drives planning cycles, business reviews, goal tracking, the profitability agenda, and cross-functional program coordination across 6+ countries.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Leo Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are looking for a senior software development engineer to be a founding engineer on the Engineering and R&D team within Leo Space Security. The team defends the manufacturing lines, launch sites, and global ground infrastructure behind the constellation from the most sophisticated threat actors on the planet. You will build a neuro-symbolic reasoning platform: large language model agents combined with a knowledge graph and real-time asset state store that ground every conclusion in verifiable fact, so every automated decision is auditable. The platform automates incident response, threat analysis, offensive security testing, and detection authoring, backed by a high-throughput streaming pipeline that takes a detection from concept to production in hours. This is a unique opportunity to build a security platform from early stage through global scale, at a consequence level few teams ever encounter.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen.


Key job responsibilities
You will own architecture decisions across the platform, providing system-wide design guidance and ensuring our services are secure, scalable, and operationally simple. You will design and build the distributed systems that carry the platform, from telemetry ingestion and real-time correlation through agent execution and observability, in an environment where a wrong automated action has real operational consequences. You will drive automation relentlessly: replacing manual security operations with software, building the evaluation and backtesting infrastructure that proves a model or detection is correct before it is trusted in production, and creating deployment guardrails that prevent human error in high-consequence environments. You will partner with applied scientists to turn research prototypes into production capabilities, mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and set the standard for code quality across the team. You will operate what you build, owning operational health, incident response, and reliability for services the security organization depends on.

A day in the life
One morning you might lead a design review for a new detection pipeline stage, challenging the team to eliminate every manual step and asking what happens when each component fails or is fed hostile input. That afternoon you could be writing code to tighten the guardrails on an agent tool, or profiling the correlation path to shave seconds off the time from event to detection. The next day you might investigate an anomalous pattern in your service metrics, treating it as hostile until proven otherwise, then work with a scientist to backtest a candidate detection against retained telemetry before it ships. You will obsess over the two latencies that define the platform, the time from event to detection and the time from detection to containment action, and question any process that relies on a human doing the right thing under pressure. The team is new, so the architecture decisions you make now will carry the platform for years.

About the team
Leo Space Security protects the people, facilities, hardware, and supply chain behind a global satellite constellation. The Engineering and R\&D team within this organization builds the platforms and tooling the security pillar teams operate on, moving security operations from manual triage to correlation-based detection, automated response, and agentic AI. The team is composed of applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers working across physical and digital security domains.

#### Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

#### Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#### Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)
