descriptionHtml:
Amazon Economics is seeking Forecasting, Macroeconomics and Finance (FMF) Economist Interns who are passionate about applying time-series econometric methods to solve real-world business challenges. FMF economists interpret and forecast Amazon business dynamics by combining advanced time-series statistical methods with strong economic analysis and intuition. In this full-time internship (40 hours per week, with hourly compensation), you'll work with large-scale datasets to forecast business trends and inform strategic decisions, gaining hands-on experience that's directly applicable to dissertation writing and future career placement.

By applying to this role, you are automatically being considered for all 2027 FMF Economist Internships.

Key job responsibilities
As an FMF Economist Intern, you'll specialize in time-series econometric analysis to understand, predict, and optimize Amazon's business dynamics. Your responsibilities include:
- Analyze large-scale datasets using advanced time-series econometric techniques to solve complex business challenges
- Applying frontier methods in time series econometrics, including forecasting models, dynamic systems analysis, and econometric models that combine macro and micro data
- Developing formal models to understand past and present business dynamics, predict future trends, and identify relevant risks and opportunities
- Building datasets and performing data analysis at scale using world-class data tools
- Collaborating with economists, scientists, and business leaders to develop data-driven insights and strategic recommendations
- Tackling diverse challenges including analyzing drivers of growth and profitability, forecasting business metrics, understanding how customer experience interacts with external conditions, and evaluating short, medium, and long-term business dynamics
- Build and refine comprehensive datasets for in-depth time-series economic analysis
- Present complex analytical findings to business leaders and stakeholders

Basic qualifications

- 3rd year or greater PhD student in Economics or related field

Preferred qualifications

RLS operates over 600 assisted pickup and returns locations and continues to expand its footprint. The Operations Support Specialist role is focused on supporting the labor department to ensure locations are properly staffed and providing field leaders with new and incredibly fast resolution speeds for scheduling issues. This role will play a critical role in reacting to same-day scheduling issues that create potential for operational closures that can impact customer experience.

Our team is focused on streamlining and centralizing tasks that our field leaders action upon, and this role will be a key in our commitment to removing such tasks.
This position is performed remotely, with a requirement for quick and reliable access to return point locations. Coverage is provided across all North American time zones 7 days a week, with shift schedules that vary based on operational needs.

Key job responsibilities
A successful Operations Support Specialist will demonstrate the ability to perform the following functions, including but not limited to:

Work independently without continued guidance
Maintain punctuality, reliability, and consistent attendance
Be flexible with scheduling, including early mornings and late nights
Cover at least one weekend as part of the regular schedule
Execute tasks with a high degree of attention to detail
Respond to escalations quickly with a strong sense of urgency
Apply departmental resources, policies, and procedures to resolve issues accurately
Communicate clearly in writing and verbally with teammates, management, and field operators (customer)
Prioritize the most important tasks appropriately
Navigate multiple systems and programs to deep dive issues (e.g., scheduling platforms, Slack, Excel)
Proactively flag system and process issues to management
Fulfill all required job functions as assigned

A day in the life
Roles within the team will vary and may include some or all duties below:

1.Monitor communication tools for potential scheduling escalations (i.e. Slack/SIM)
Investigate scheduling escalations utilizing a set of process paths to determine which steps (if any) must be taken
2.Process paths can include sending communications to employees, posting new shifts, communicating with field managers, etc.
3.Provide communications to associates regarding how/when to operate tools
4.Follow up on pending issues
5.Provide teammates with a detail of what pending issues still require support
6.Communicate with managers and leadership on staffing status, escalations, and operational needs
7.Utilize Excel, Slack, and similar platforms to perform daily functions
8. All other duties as assigned

About the team
We strive to offer all-inclusive solutions, including program development and real time assistance. Our Northstar is ensuring our field leaders can get back the bandwidth to focus on the basics of developing their people and ensuring their sites offer exceptional customer service. Our commitment to this goal drives us to ask the important question of “what’s not working” or “what can work better” and provide the best possible centralized, streamlined, or automated solution.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience in an operational role

title: Software Development Engineer II, Lightsail
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Lightsail makes AWS accessible to developers and business customers who want to get their cloud stacks running in seconds without the complexity of traditional infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Lightsail team, you will build features and services that simplify compute, storage, networking, and website hosting for customers who need things to just work. The team is expanding quickly, adding new capabilities like website hosting and agent hosting, and you will help shape what comes next. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding customer problems through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are an engineer who enjoys building products you would actually use yourself, and you want to do that at AWS scale, we would like to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build features for Amazon Lightsail's distributed systems, working in Java, Go, JavaScript, and React across both backend services and frontend experiences.
Collaborate with partner teams across AWS — including Amazon EC2, Amazon Route 53, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) — to integrate Lightsail capabilities with the broader AWS ecosystem.
Own the operational health of the services you build by identifying root causes of production issues and driving permanent fixes, ensuring customers experience reliable performance.
Participate actively in design reviews and code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and mentoring other engineers on writing clean, maintainable code.
Evaluate new technologies and approaches, including generative artificial intelligence tools, to improve team productivity and the quality of solutions delivered to customers.

A day in the life
You start your morning checking operational dashboards for a Lightsail service you recently launched, then join a design review where you and a teammate work through how to integrate a new hosting capability with an existing AWS service. After lunch, you pick up a feature task, writing backend logic in Java and wiring up the React console so customers can try it out. Later, you review a pull request from a teammate, leave detailed feedback, and update documentation so the next engineer who touches this code can ramp up quickly.

About the team
Amazon Lightsail sits within AWS and has a distinctive mission: make cloud infrastructure simple and approachable for non-enterprise customers. While we run on the same AWS infrastructure that powers the world's largest workloads, our focus is on removing complexity so developers and small businesses can launch and scale without a steep learning curve. We are an inclusive team that values knowledge sharing and mentorship, and we intentionally assign projects to help each engineer grow. Right now we are investing in new hosting and agent capabilities, so there is plenty of room to have a direct impact on what we build next.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 2+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

AWS IoT Core enables billions of devices to connect securely to the cloud — and the Identity and Registry team is at the heart of it. We own the foundational primitives that give every IoT device its identity, manage its metadata, and govern how it interacts with the cloud at massive scale.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that customers rely on to provision, authenticate, and manage their IoT fleets — from a single prototype to billions of devices in production. You'll work on challenges spanning distributed systems, security, identity management, and scalable metadata storage and retrieval, directly shaping the experience for some of the world's largest IoT deployments.

This is a high-impact role where your work will be felt across the entire AWS IoT platform and by customers spanning multiple industries — from smart home and automotive to broadcasting and industrial automation. If you're excited about building foundational infrastructure that operates at Internet of Things scale and solving hard problems in device identity and registry, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

- Build and operate highly available, low-latency distributed systems that handle device provisioning, authentication, metadata and state management
- Own the full software development lifecycle — from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations

A day in the life
You'll spend focused time writing code — building new APIs, tuning system performance to reduce latency at billion-device scale, or improving provisioning workflows. You'll collaborate with teammates through design reviews and code reviews, and partner with other IoT Core teams on cross-cutting features. Some days you'll dig into customer escalations, tracing issues through logs and metrics. Other days you'll experiment with AI tools to improve engineering processes. No two days are the same, but every day you're building the foundation that enables billions of devices to connect to AWS IoT.

The Identity and Registry team owns the foundational services at the core of AWS IoT — device identity, registry, shadow, and provisioning. We build and operate systems that enable billions of devices to securely connect, be managed, and interact with the cloud. Our team values operational excellence, customer obsession, and a strong ownership culture where every engineer has a direct impact. title: WHS Officer, Workplace health and safety
descriptionHtml:
The Site WHS Officer will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in a delivery station to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. A successful Site WHS Officer will demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and inspire change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.
The Site WHS Officer must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will instruct and train Operations Leaders in Amazon WHS policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. You will work to identify best practices and incorporate these standard methodologies into our standards to continuously improve the safety landscape.
Site WHS officer will possess excellent safety program knowledge as well as environmental and ergonomic knowledge and be able demonstrate this expertise when working with Operations.
The Site WHS officer will be a part of site WHS team and reports to site WHS manager. The WHS officer should be flexible to work in shifts.
Possess a thorough understanding of local/regional regulations and company policy.


Key job responsibilities
Provide guidance and oversight to ensure site compliance with Amazon WHS standards, policies, and local regulations.
Measure site performance against safety requirements and drive action plans to close gaps.
Deliver quality safety projects to Operations on time.
Analyze safety metrics and weekly/monthly incident trends to focus resources where risk is highest.
Ensure proper incident investigation and timely closure of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Conduct regular audits to find unsafe equipment and processes, and implement solutions to prevent injury.
Audit record-keeping and ensure Austin entries meet global WHS standards and local regulations.
Audit workplace organization and associate behaviors to ensure training, auditing, and scoring are accurate and consistent.
Lead and mentor Safety Associates, including during peak.
Engage with associates, safety teams, and leaders to gather improvement ideas and communicate progress.
Ensure leaders and associates are trained on their safety responsibilities, and audit training quality, delivery, and effectiveness.
Manage PPE inventory with procurement and ensure PPE compliance.
Implement best practices, PIT and yard safety, the work permit system, and contractor safety management.
Maintain the site safety training calendar, including firefighting and first aid training.
Partner with the facility team to ensure preventive maintenance of fire protection and emergency equipment

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work all days and shifts, including overtime (24 hours a day, 7 days a week operation, including holidays)
- Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering
- 3+ years of implementing safety standards experience
- Experience with OSHA regulations
- NEBOSH IGC

title: Transportation Representative
descriptionHtml:
Network Operations Center (NOC) – Overview

The Network Operations Center (NOC) serves as the central command and control hub for Transportation Execution across Amazon's Supply Chain network, spanning multiple geographies including North America, India, and the EU.

NOC is responsible for ensuring the seamless, on-time movement of freight — from vendor pick-ups to Amazon Fulfillment Centers (FCs), and from FCs to carrier hubs. When exceptions arise, NOC takes swift ownership of resolution while keeping all relevant stakeholders informed throughout the process.

Beyond tactical problem-solving, NOC is also entrusted with a strategic mandate: identifying trends in network exceptions, driving process automation, and recommending operational improvements to streamline transportation workflows. This requires continuous network monitoring and in-depth analysis of network data.

In essence, NOC plays a pivotal role in the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network — directly influencing Amazon's ability to deliver on its promise to customers.

Role of a Trans Ops Representative

A Trans Ops Representative at NOC acts as a critical link between key stakeholders — including Transportation Carriers, Hubs, and Warehouses — facilitating the flow of information and resolving issues that could impact customer experience or business continuity. The role spans two core verticals:

Inbound Operations – Manages the Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring freight is picked up on time and delivered to FCs as per scheduled appointments. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues arising during the pick-up to delivery lifecycle.
Outbound Operations – Manages the FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring trucks depart FCs on schedule to fulfill customer delivery promises. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues from the point freight leaves the FC through to last-mile delivery.
Trans Ops Representatives drive real-time resolutions by leveraging internal tools, querying relevant data, and making informed, time-sensitive decisions. The ideal candidate brings a solid understanding of logistics operations, a sharp eye for data trends, and the ability to communicate effectively — both verbally and in writing.

Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representatives are expected to proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and drive them to completion. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Serving as the communication bridge between external stakeholders (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal stakeholders (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
Systematically escalating issues or data variances to the appropriate owners and teams, and following through to ensure timely resolution
Preparing and presenting weekly narratives that outline key findings and variances against goals in review forums
Delivering real-time customer experience support within a 24×7 operating environment

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline
- 12–24 months of relevant work experience
- Strong communication skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to facilitate seamless information flow between external and internal stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree with strong academic foundation
- Sound logical and analytical thinking skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple cross-functional teams

descriptionHtml:

Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
- Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
- Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
- Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.

About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

title: HR Specialist, People Foundations, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wanted to be part of a team building industry-changing technology? At Leo, we are building a low Earth orbit satellite network that will deliver broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities. Come join one of Amazon's most ambitious bets, scaling fast toward commercial launch with a workforce that spans hourly 24/7 production operations and corporate teams.

We are seeking an HR Specialist to serve as the programmatic owner for building, shaping, and onboarding Leo onto the people systems and mechanisms that HRPs, managers, and employees rely on. This role exists to unlock HRPs and managers by making sure the platforms, content, and listening mechanisms that serve Leo actually fit Leo's workforce, not configurations built for other populations. This role is a rethink of how the work gets done. You will work AI-native from the start, using AI to drive a step change in your approach and maximize output across programs, not just to do the same work faster.

You will own the work end-to-end, turning business requirements into configured, working solutions and driving them through the central teams that own the platforms. That includes standing up mechanisms that give leaders a real-time read on workforce sentiment and culture risk, getting Leo-specific content and policy into the right places while removing what does not apply, and locking in the right survey questions and definitions for both the hourly and corporate populations.

This is a portfolio and influence role. You will operate as an independent strategic owner, not a conduit. You will set the prioritization criteria that determine which requirements get resourced, build the intake and road mapping mechanisms the function runs against, and secure Leo's position in central roadmaps. Leo is smaller by headcount but outsized in business criticality, so it does not always compete for roadmap space on size alone. Your job is to make sure both populations are reflected in the systems that serve them, so HRPs and managers are not left to absorb the gaps.

This role is net-new. You will stand up the inaugural charter, mechanisms, and standards based on customer needs rather than inheriting an established playbook. While Leo is the primary portfolio, this role reports to the Sr. HRP Manager for Leo, Entertainment, Ads/IMDb/Grand Challenge, and Devices & Services (LEAD) and is designed to extend this programmatic muscle across LEAD business lines where similar people-systems needs exist.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the People Systems and Mechanisms Portfolio End-to-End. Own the work to build, shape, and onboard Leo onto its people systems and mechanisms. Run intake, set the criteria that determine which requirements get dedicated resources, and make capacity tradeoffs across active workstreams so the highest-leverage needs land first. Partner with the Leo HRBP team on central efforts like compensation and time systems.
- Build and Onboard Listening and Sensing Mechanisms. Partner with central science teams to stand up the mechanisms that give leaders a real-time read on workforce sentiment and site-level culture risk. Configure them so the signal is accurate and leaders get a self-serve asset, not one that requires HRP interpretation.
- Build AI-Native Mechanisms. Build AI into the portfolio's core mechanisms rather than treating it as an add-on. Set the standard for how AI-enabled workflows scale this work across LEAD, keeping human judgment on the tradeoffs and decisions.
- Configure Content and Policy Across the Central Platforms. Get Leo-specific content and policy into the right places and remove what does not apply, so self-service actually fits the workforce and directly unlocks HRPs and managers.
- Ensure the Mixed Workforce Is Correctly Represented. Lock in the right survey question sets for both the hourly 24/7 and corporate populations, and codify durable definitions the HRP role runs against, including how proximity is defined and applied.
- Own Portfolio Health and Surface Systemic Risk Early. Build the metrics and status mechanisms that show whether requirements are landing as working solutions, not post-launch defects. Spot systemic vulnerabilities in the intake-to-delivery pipeline before they become compliance exposure or business disruption and drive them to resolution through the owner teams you influence but do not manage.
- Lead Change Management and Write the Strategic Narratives. Roll out delivered solutions with the business and the HRP team, build scalable mechanisms and standards for intake and change, author the PR/FAQs and MBR/QBR inputs that articulate decision points and tradeoffs, and own inputs into OP1 and OP2.
- Extend Programmatic Capabilities Across LEAD. Scale this work across the broader LEAD business lines where similar needs exist, rather than solving them one by one. That includes thinking through hourly-population needs across business lines together, or owning scoping and implementation for shared tool rollouts, so one build serves many.
- Contribute to Initiatives Beyond the Core Portfolio. Take on work that requires programmatic execution, including people-systems integration for acquisitions and preparation for new site buildouts. Sequence the mechanisms so they are operational before the complexity lands.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- 7+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience
- Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
- Experience translating ambiguous, high-stakes business needs into structured requirements and action plans
- Experience in project or program management across cross-functional partners for business operations or process improvement
- Experience partnering with central or shared-service owner teams to deliver outcomes through influence rather than direct authority

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
- Experience prioritizing competing demands, scoping large efforts, and negotiating timelines
- Direct experience building, configuring, or onboarding HR systems, content, or listening mechanisms (for example TimeHub, Connections, or policy and content platforms), or comparable HR-systems configuration environments
- Experience supporting a mixed hourly and corporate workforce, where populations have materially different system, policy, and listening needs
- Experience in acquisition integration, site launch, expansion, or stand-up contexts (new-country, in-country, greenfield, or net-new operating model)
- Experience working cross-functionally with legal, policy, benefits, tech, and operations teams in a matrixed environment
- Experience owning inputs into OP1/OP2 and presenting narratives to senior leaders
- Demonstrated experience building AI-enabled workflows or mechanisms that scale HR processes

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Forward Deployment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon is a fast-paced, dynamic, high-tech company based in Seattle. Global Tax Data (GTD) organization provides data management services and supports program and product initiatives that improve tax data integrity across Amazon's global indirect tax compliance operations. GTD ensures timely, accurate data is available for tax compliance reporting and audit readiness, and our teams manage the tax data infrastructure, pipelines, reconciliation tools, and operational reporting that compliance teams rely on worldwide.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) II in GTD, you'll build gold-standard analytics datasets and data mart/warehouses while driving the data analysis, reconciliation operations, root-cause investigations, and process improvements that directly support Amazon's monthly tax compliance cycles. You'll partner cross-functionally with your customers in tax compliance and accounting, and with stakeholders across finance technology, to make sure the data behind every filing is complete, accurate, and delivered on time. You'll also work closely with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Solutions Architects.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys digging into large datasets — spotting patterns, explaining the story behind the variances, and driving issues to resolution independently.

You'll thrive here if you bring strong analytical skills, the ability (or a genuine eagerness to build it) to work with large-scale data, and the business judgment to translate tax and accounting context into the right system configurations.

• Build and own the Gold standard data mart/warehouse for business reporting and analysys
• Perform hands-on reconciliation and detailed analysis of large financial datasets each month, investigating and resolving discrepancies across source systems, tax reporting warehouses, and the general ledger.

• Partner with compliance and customer teams to understand reporting requirements and translate business objectives into clear data specifications and technical development requirements.
• Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and metrics that give visibility into reconciliation health and data readiness.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controllership, and data quality — automating manual processes, reducing cycle time, and coaching customer teams on how to use the reporting and functionality you build.
• Own and manage SIM tickets and intake workflows, ensuring timely response and resolution for internal and external stakeholders.

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager, Ring Business
descriptionHtml:
Ring's mission is to make neighborhoods safer, and businesses are an integral part of it. The Amazon Key and Ring teams empower customers to seamlessly manage access to their homes and businesses. We are looking for a results-driven Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own demand generation for Ring Business and build a repeatable engine that acquires new business customers at scale.

This is a builder's role. Business demand does not always exist, in many of our segments it has to be created. You will own the full demand funnel across both established and new channels, deciding where to invest, what to test, and what to scale. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset and a sprint-based approach: form a hypothesis, run a tightly-scoped test, read the data, and double down or kill it fast.

You will: i) own and execute the Ring Business demand generation strategy across the funnel; ii) stand up, test, and scale new acquisition channels; iii) run a rigorous test-and-learn operating cadence; and iv) deliver the reporting and insight that steers investment. As a senior individual contributor, you will set the plan, influence cross-functional partners, and be measured on business outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own demand generation end-to-end: Build and execute the Ring Business demand gen strategy across the full funnel, from category awareness and consideration through to conversion, accountable for new business location growth and qualified lead/pipeline targets.

- Scale established channels: Drive performance across in-market channels (Amazon.com, Amazon Business, Search, paid media, retail), improving targeting, conversion, and cost per acquired location.

- Build new channels: Stand up, test, and scale emerging channels (LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, events, association and partner marketing, 3P-led / influencer content) to create demand where it does not yet exist.

- Run a test-and-learn cadence: Operate in sprints, define hypotheses and kill criteria, launch scoped experiments, read results quickly, and reallocate budget to what works.

- Develop and localize B2B materials:Create demand gen assets and adapt them to resonate across diverse markets and business segments (small vs. medium businesses), including EU localization.

- Lead market research: Plan and manage research initiatives (incl. EU) to uncover customer and category insight that sharpens targeting and messaging.

- Provide B2B reporting: Deliver weekly and quarterly business reviews (WBR & QBR), own the demand gen dashboard and KPIs, and translate performance into clear investment recommendations.

A day in the life
In this role you balance strategy with hands-on execution to drive B2B growth. You set the demand gen plan, then get into the detail of making it work. A day might include reviewing live campaign performance and reallocating spend, scoping the next channel test, briefing and localizing creative for EU markets, pressure-testing a targeting segment with the analytics team, and preparing the week's demand gen read-out for leadership. You work closely with sales, product, finance, and regional teams — and you are comfortable moving fast, making decisions with incomplete data, and owning the outcome.

About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages

- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Help millions of authors around the world get their books published, discovered, and supported. As one of the first scientists on our new team in Bengaluru, you'll help turn ideas into models authors rely on every day, building agentic solutions with large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, and fine-tuning.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the multi-agent system behind KDP's author support assistant: orchestration across specialized agents and tools, personalization, and the evaluation that drives its continuous improvement.
- Build multimodal models of book attributes, and use them for similar-book search across languages, catalog quality, and category and keyword recommendations.
- Post-train open models on KDP expertise (for example with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning), and deploy them where they beat general-purpose models on accuracy, cost, or speed.
- Work closely with our scientists in the US and with engineering partners to take your work to production, design rigorous offline and online experiments, and write clear readouts with recommendations.

About the team
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) lets anyone publish a book. We are the science organization for Amazon's Books business, now building our science teams in Bengaluru. Our team works in three connected areas: a support assistant that answers authors' questions from their own account data, in every language KDP supports; multimodal models that use book attributes to keep the catalog trustworthy and help authors reach the right readers; and fine-tuned models that power the assistant and catalog models with KDP expertise. We serve authors, from first-time writers to full-time publishers. You will work closely with engineering, product, and policy partners. We value safety before speed and shared foundations over one-off fixes. Scientists here get dedicated time for innovation, which can lead to patents and conference papers.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building LLM-based agents or multimodal generative AI workflows, including tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, or evaluation
- Experience fine-tuning or post-training models, including with reinforcement learning
- Experience with large-scale retrieval, embeddings, or ranking, including text and image embeddings
- Experience with multilingual natural language processing or computer vision
- Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing a regulated waste program across multiple sites, including hazardous waste accumulation, manifesting, and disposal
- Hazardous waste certification such as RCRA or DOT (49 CFR) training, or 40-hour HAZWOPER
- Experience conducting site audits or inspections and tracking findings to closure

descriptionHtml:
The Foundational AI (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning background, to build industry-leading Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) technology with Large Language Models (LLMs).

As an Applied Scientist with the FAI team, you will support the development of RL Gyms, assess their usefulness for the frontier model advancement and build techniques to advance the state of the art with LLMs. You will support the foundational model development in an applied research role. A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing experimental results from a model training run you kicked off the previous afternoon, analyzing metrics and refining your approach. By mid-morning, you are whiteboarding a new algorithmic design with engineering partners, working through system integration details. After lunch, you lead a science review where you present findings and gather feedback from peers. Later, you pair with a junior scientist to debug a data pipeline issue, turning it into a coaching moment. Your day wraps up drafting a section of a research paper capturing your team's latest results.

About the team
The FAI team has a mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers.

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience

title: HR Partner, Human Resources, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the AMZL PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and HR technologies to enhance the employee experience while developing core HR capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

- Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

- Assist in running and monitoring feedback channels such as roundtables, floor walks, and employee engagement activities. Support issue tracking and follow-up, partnering with senior PXT team members to drive resolutions and improvements in employee experience.

- Coach frontline leaders on behaviors that impact engagement and retention. Reinforce expectations and guide leaders in selecting and effectively utilizing available tools to improve team communication, recognition, and performance conversations.

- Support the execution of site-level engagement, communication, and culture-building initiatives. Coordinate logistics, gather feedback, and monitor effectiveness.

- Learn to track and summarize PXT-related data (e.g., attrition/attendance trends, hiring data, employee sentiment). Help prepare insights for site reviews or team discussions.

- Promote the use of self-service tools to resolve routine employee and manager questions. Help identify recurring gaps and escalate opportunities to improve tool usability or adoption.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. You'll maintain consistent presence on the operations floor, engaging directly with hourly employees and partnering with leaders to address concerns and drive engagement initiatives. Operating under the guidance of senior team members, you'll execute core HR processes while ensuring quality service delivery.

Through data tools and HR technologies, you'll assist in tracking metrics and identifying trends, while developing your ability to build trust through personal interaction. You'll support employee engagement activities, help coordinate feedback channels, and assist in coaching and development of others. When complex issues arise, you'll seek guidance from senior team members, learning to navigate challenging situations while developing sound judgment.

Success in this role comes from maintaining organized routines, demonstrating strong follow-through, and building effective partnerships with both the PXT team and operations leaders. This role requires excellent organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon experience with 1-year human resources general experience or equivalent experience (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, manufacturing) experience
- Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., creating documents in Word, using basic spreadsheet functions in Excel, managing calendars/emails in Outlook).
- Ability to maintain confidentiality in handling sensitive information
- Experience communicating effectively with diverse audiences (e.g., explaining processes, addressing concerns, providing technical guidance)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in customer service or people-facing roles, demonstrating effective verbal and written communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to analyze information, solve problems, and make data-driven decisions
- Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel (e.g., ability to use pivot tables, v-lookups, and formulas)

- Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver results in fast-paced, dynamic environments
- Experience building partnerships and collaborating effectively across teams, demonstrating adaptability and autonomy

title: テクニカルアカウントマネージャー / Technical Account Manager (TAM), Digital Innovation
descriptionHtml:
スタートアップからエンタープライズに至る日本の多くの企業が、クラウド技術を活用してビジネス上のアドバンテージを得ようとしています。これに伴い、技術や運用に関してガイダンスを提供し、お客様のクラウドジャーニーに伴走するエキスパートが求められています。AWS エンタープライズサポートでは、お客様の変革を支援し、クラウドジャーニーの各フェーズでお客様の最も近くにいる担当者であるTechnical Account Manager(TAM)を募集しています。

Technical Account Manager (TAM)は、お客様がAWS上で技術的なソリューションを実現するための支援、またそれを運用していく中でお客様が直面する様々な課題の解決の支援を行います。お客様は、デジタルネイティブと呼ばれる企業群、SaaS アプリケーション提供企業から、伝統ある日本企業、複数の業種にまたがる大企業、そしていまや公共団体にまで拡がっています。お客様の急速な成長と共にエンタープライズサポートの組織も成長しており、そのスピードに合わせTAMはクラウドジャーニーの様々なステージにいる数社のお客様を同時に支援します。なお、TAMは、金融、製造、流通、サービス、テレコム、メディア、ゲーム、ISVといった業界のエンドカスタマー、もしくはパートナー のいずれかの業界のお客様をご担当いただきます。

TAMは、お客様が抱える技術的に難しい課題の解決を支援し、必要に応じてお客様に技術的なガイダンスを提供、そして、お客様のシステムアーキテクチャやオペレーションに対して技術的なレビューをします。それらに加えて、TAMは 日本を含めた グローバルの AWS 内でお客様の代弁者として行動する事が期待されています。この仕事を通じて、あなたはお客様のシステムアーキテクチャや技術的オペレーションに習熟しながら、お客様との間に強いプロフェッショナルな信頼関係を築く事ができるでしょう。

これまでTAMとして採用された候補者の多くは、ネットワーク、データベース、アプリケーションサーバー、オペレーティングシステム、プログラミングといったインターネットを利用したサービスに関係する技術に対する経験を持ち、それらのうち１つ以上の分野に習熟しています。過去のクラウドコンピューティングの経験は必須ではありません。また、開発や社内情報システム部門で活躍されていた方も採用され、活躍しています。入社後には、AWSに関する専門的な技術を習得するための3ヶ月にわたるトレーニングが提供され提供されるため、AWS初心者の方でも安心してご入社いただけます。

AWS を活用した大規模なワークロードをサポートできるやりがいのある職種です。フレックスタイム制度などの柔軟な働き方と、入社後研修後も定期的に提供されるラーニングの機会、そして将来のキャリアの選択肢も幅広くあります。

AWS におけるお客様の代弁者として、お客様と日本のビジネスに貢献するこの魅力的なロールにチャレンジしてみませんか。


Key job responsibilities
- AWS エンタープライズ サポートのテクニカル アカウント マネージャとして、お客様の Point of Contact として活動し、お客様の困難な技術的課題に対して AWS の幅広いサービスの知識とテクニカルリソースを駆使してその課題の解決を支援する。また、重要なイベントが発生した際にお客様とのコミュニケーションを先導
- お客様との信頼関係を構築・維持向上し、お客様のビジネスニーズや技術的な課題を理解
- お客様のシステムやオペレーションに対して技術面およびコスト面のレビューを定期的に提供し、より適切なサービスや機能を提案
- トレーニングや勉強会を通じて新サービス情報やAWS のベストプラクティスを提供し、お客様がそれを咀嚼し正しく活用できるよう支援
- お客様から AWS サポートに寄せられたサポートケースを把握し、サポートエンジニアと協業してAWS 各部門へエスカレーションし、問題の解決を促進するとともに、お客様がその問題についてお客様社内関係者や上位層に正しくかつタイムリーに報告できるよう支援
- お客様のニーズを把握し、それを満たすためのより良いサービスや機能の提案を行うことで、よりお客様のビジネスにAWSが役立つよう促す。またお客様のビジネスを阻害する問題がAWS側にあれば、それを検知し、他のTAMや部門と協業してその解消を促進
- AWS の Solution Architects, Professional Services, Sales Account Managers とアカウントチームとして協業し、またアカウントチームとしての活動の一部を担う。
- チーム内の知識や経験の蓄積を推進し、チームメンバーの能力開発に貢献

title: Brand Specialist
descriptionHtml:

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. About the Role

As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. title: Marketing Manager, Search & Discovery, Amazon Autos
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Autos is reinventing how people discover, research, and buy cars. Paid search/Discovery is one of our most important demand-generation channels, connecting high-intent car shoppers to the Amazon Autos experience at the exact moment they're looking. The Search Discovery channel is how we show up across paid search and adjacent discovery surfaces to drive qualified traffic, maximize channel efficiency, and improve the shopper experience end to end.

We are seeking a hands-on, highly analytical Marketing Manager to manage the Search Discovery channel for Amazon Autos. This is a true channel-manager role: you will run day-to-day campaign management and optimization of Paid Search as our primary channel, with YouTube as a key secondary channel, and you'll help shape how we show up in emerging search-based channels (vehicle listing ads, AI Agent Ads, etc.). You will be actively managing campaigns in the ad platforms, with expertise in how to structure, optimize, and scale campaigns. The role requires a highly analytical mindset and a curiosity to seek out new possibilities. You'll read performance both at a top-line channel level and granularly within the campaign structure, and you'll be as strong on the technical side of marketing as you are on the creative and experimental side, consistently using one to inform the other. You will be accountable for your channel's day-to-day performance, applying learnings across campaigns and surfaces as the channel grows, and partnering with more senior colleagues on the bets that are larger or more ambiguous.


The successful candidate will think strategically and execute rigorously. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. You will anticipate and remove bottlenecks, make tradeoffs with limited guidance, and balance business needs against constraints. You will dive into performance data, incremental business impact, and budget pacing for your channel, which requires strong analytical skills. You Earn Trust with your stakeholders, including the product, creative, and business development teams, to whom you'll deliver clear, performance-driven feedback and recommendations that help inform future campaigns and designs. You will look ahead for growth opportunities or identify potential challenges and present solutions to solve them.

Key job responsibilities
- Own day-to-day management and optimization of Paid Search (primary channel) and YouTube (secondary), hands-on in the ad platforms

- Drive performance through continuous optimization: bidding, budget pacing, keyword and audience strategy, and campaign structure, at both a top-line and granular level

- Design, launch, and read out A/B tests to improve channel efficiency and inform new campaign strategy

- Conduct creative analysis and deliver clear, data-backed feedback to the creative team to strengthen future campaigns

- Help develop and scale our presence in emerging off-Amazon, search-based discovery channels

- Translate performance data into actionable insights and concise business recommendations, refining them with senior colleagues to ensure they're actionable

- Support channel budget planning and OP1/OP2 inputs by scoping spend, flagging efficiency opportunities, and helping recommend where to invest next

A day in the life
You'll start your day checking performance on your Google and YouTube campaigns (pacing, spend, and conversion trends) and making optimizations directly in the ad platforms. Mid-morning you might dig into a campaign that's underperforming, restructure ad groups or adjust bids, and set up an A/B test to validate a new approach. After lunch, you're analyzing creative performance and pulling together feedback for the creative team on what's resonating and what isn't. Later in the week, you might build a readout on channel performance, size an opportunity in an emerging search surface, and work with your manager on where to invest next. The work moves constantly between hands-on execution and deep analysis, and you'll always have multiple campaigns and tests in flight.


About the team
We're the marketing team at Amazon Autos, responsible for driving broad awareness of a marketplace that's fundamentally changing how people buy cars. You'll work alongside Creative, Analytics, and Product teams who are building something that's never existed in automotive retail. We test constantly, share learnings openly, and push each other to get better. If you enjoy a start-up environment, where you get to build from 0 to 1 and no two days are the same, this may be the role for you.

Basic qualifications

-4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
-Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
-Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
-Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
-Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
-Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
-Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising

Preferred qualifications

-Experience in multi-territory campaign management
-Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process

title: Logistics Specialist, AWS DC Operations
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to be part of something from the ground up? We are preparing to launch a new data center and need a Materials Specialist to ensure our inventory and logistics operations are running smoothly from day one. In this role, you will manage the flow of critical hardware components that keep our infrastructure operational — receiving shipments, maintaining stock levels, and getting the right parts to the right technicians at the right time. This is a hands-on position where your organizational skills and attention to detail directly impact how quickly we can build and maintain our data center environment.

Key job responsibilities
Manage inventory levels for critical spare parts and materials, conducting cycle counts, maintaining min/max thresholds, and ensuring accurate records of all inbound and outbound commodities.
Receive and process shipments by verifying contents against purchase orders, logging items into inventory systems, and coordinating with vendors on returns of defective hardware.
Stage and distribute parts to Data Center Technicians and Engineers responding to build and break/fix operations, ensuring parts availability meets operational targets.
Coordinate material flow for bulk deliveries including cabinets, power infrastructure, and networking equipment while maintaining organized and safe storage areas.
Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency in logistics workflows, collaborating with peers and escalating risks or roadblocks as needed.

A day in the life
Your day starts at the loading dock, where you process inbound shipments and verify them against purchase orders before logging everything into our inventory system. From there, you move to the parts room where you organizing storage bins, staging spares for technicians working active tickets, and running cycle counts to keep stock levels accurate. You might coordinate a bulk delivery of server cabinets in the yard, then pivot to packaging an RMA return for a defective component. Throughout the day, you collaborate with technicians and engineers, troubleshoot supply gaps, and look for ways to make the operation run more efficiently.

About the team
Our team supports the launch and ongoing operation of Amazon's data center infrastructure. As we bring a new site online, every team member plays a visible role in getting us to operational readiness. You will work alongside technicians, engineers, and operations managers in a collaborative environment where your contributions are felt immediately. Growth here is supported through regular coaching, monthly one-on-ones focused on removing barriers, and active involvement in process improvement initiatives giving you the skills and experience to take on broader responsibilities as our data center community expands.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of shipping & receiving, inventory and warehousing practices experience
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 1+ years of logistics or other relevant experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of computer hardware components and operating systems
- Familiar with waybills and shipping procedures with transport companies
- Experience in Warehouse Management Software / Inventory Management Software proficiency
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- Proficient with computers and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

As a Software Development Manager, you will lead a team designing and building services and features that enable the Amazon Fulfillment robotic solution. Delivering reliable and high-performance services and features at Amazon scale requires technical leaders with extraordinary expertise and boundless creativity. At Amazon, managers will interact with customers, understand our business goals, collaborate with other leaders, and innovate rapidly, delivering high-quality and high-value functionality.



Key job responsibilities
What does it take to thrive as a Software Development Manager at Amazon Robotics?
• You need to be creative, responsible, and curious while leading the team to move quickly to deliver results for our customers.
• You’re excited about designing and implementing solutions that scale and engaging customers to understand what’s needed to meet their needs.
• You’re able to think about business opportunities, understand operational implications, and lead us in evolving our service architecture in the course of a single conversation.
• You’re looking to lead and mentor a team of bright, capable engineers to implement your vision.


A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply the latest advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 3+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using distributed programming experience

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

- Experience managing a team of high calibre Software Engineers developing complex, world class, scalable software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

descriptionHtml:

Do you like helping U.S. Intelligence Community agencies implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems? Do you have experience managing large, complex programs? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced people manager to lead a group of System and Software Development Engineers who create software based solutions to bridge gaps to align our Data Center global operations capabilities while meeting our unique customer requirements.

You will drive the team’s software development roadmaps, leading prioritization and design requirements. You will be responsible for the lifecycle of their products from design, development, quality reviews and deployment, as well as operational excellence through continuous improvement, visibility, and standardization to deliver highly available services to our customers.

A successful candidate will be a hands-on manager with an established background in developing and operating platforms and services, developing and hiring extraordinary talent, have strong technical ability, great communication skills, and a motivation to achieve results in a dynamic fast paced environment.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

title: Research Scientist II, Global Risk Intelligence and Prevention
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an exceptional Applied Scientist, Seller Abuse Prevention, to lead the development and implementation of advanced AI solutions that will transform how we prevent bad actors from operating in our store and enable Selling Partners to start and grow their business without fear of disruption, so that customers and Selling Partners across the globe trust us and have confidence in the integrity of Amazon's store. This role will focus on building risk detection models leveraging state-of-the-art AI, including small language models, to detect and prevent abuse of Amazon's catalog worldwide.

You will design, develop, and deploy scalable AI solutions to proactively detect and prevent marketplace abuse throughout the seller lifecycle. You will work with massive-scale, multi-modal datasets spanning behavioral patterns, transactional histories, and behavioral data to build detection systems that are ahead of evolving adversarial tactics.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build predictive risk detection models using advanced AI techniques, including Natural Language Processing including LLMs and agents to proactively identify bad actors and prevent marketplace abuse at scale

- Own the end-to-end scientific solution from risk quantification through decision optimization, determining the appropriate actions to take across varying risk levels

- Develop interpretability and reasoning pipelines that provide transparent, actionable explanations for model decisions to support enforcement and seller experience

- Work with risk programs across the seller lifecycle to define detection strategies, translate operational investigation patterns into automated systems, and prioritize high-impact risk areas

- Partner with engineering teams to deploy models into production, define evaluation frameworks, and collaborate with operations and verification teams to measure and improve detection effectiveness


A day in the life
Day-to-day you can expect to:
- Explore datasets to understand predictors and patterns of abuse
- Work with product, program, and engineering stakeholders to build solutions into production that will last
- Identify new and emerging abuse vectors as abusers get more sophisticated
- Use search, graph, computer vision, NLP, and anomaly detection methodologies to automatically detect abusive actions.

About the team
Our team is driven by the belief that scientific innovation unlocks transformative customer experiences. We tackle hard, ambiguous problems by combining rigorous research methods with practical engineering, and we value collaboration across disciplines. We are building an inclusive environment where scientists at every stage of their career can grow, publish impactful work, and see their research come to life at Amazon scale. If you want to do science that matters, this is the place.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of quantitative field research experience
- Experience investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products
- Experience analyzing both experimental and observational data sets

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of R, MATLAB, Python or similar scripting language
- Experience with agile development
- Experience building web based dashboards using common frameworks

descriptionHtml:
