title: Sr. System Development Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Export Control: This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

The role: In this role, you will be a key member of the team building and operating AWS infrastructure that supports the organization’s business services. You will provide infrastructure support for integrations and multiple SAP S/4HANA systems, develop infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision, configure, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable cloud environments. Our ideal candidate is highly autonomous and has a strong knowledge of AWS, IaC tools and practices, integration patterns, authentication, and certificate management. The desire and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment is essential.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and own end-to-end delivery of scalable microservices and APIs integrating AWS services with SAP systems (S/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors) using protocols such as RFC, BAPI, IDoc, OData, and REST.

Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision and manage the AWS infrastructure (EventBridge, SQS, SNS, Step Functions) required to support event-driven architectures and SAP integration pipelines (BTP, Integration Suite), per solution specifications.

Troubleshoot and resolve integration failures across distributed systems, ensuring high availability and data consistency.

Implement and manage authentication/authorization mechanisms (SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC) and identity provider configuration enabling secure SSO in hybrid environments.

Automate Certificate lifecycle management (provisioning, renewal, rotation, revocation) using ACM and AWS Private CA, including monitoring, alerting, and compliance with security standards (e.g., mTLS).

Develop and integrate AI/ML capabilities into SAP workflows using Bedrock, SageMaker, Textract, and Comprehend for intelligent automation (document processing, conversational interfaces, forecasting)

Collaborate with data engineers to build pipelines feeding SAP transactional data into ML models for anomaly detection and process optimization.

Participate in on-call rotations, drive root cause analysis, and maintain operational dashboards, alarms, and runbooks to continuously improve reliability and cost efficiency

Mentor junior engineers, drive technical decisions, and author design documents that influence the team's SAP integration and AI roadmap

Collaborate cross-functionally with SAP Basis, security, and product teams to align on requirements and delivery

Work closely with the offshore support team to coordinate issue triage and resolution, provide clear handoffs, share technical context, and improve support processes across time zones.

Develop and integrate AI/ML capabilities into SAP workflows using Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker, Textract, and Comprehend for intelligent automation, including building MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool servers, Fiori integration patterns (BAdI extension calls, side panel plugins, full custom agent applications), and conversational AI interfaces.

Design and build agentic AI solutions on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, including MCP tool servers, multi-agent orchestration, knowledge bases, and AI safety guardrails for SAP-integrated workflows.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Environmental Compliance Manager to ensure environmental regulatory compliance across 15+ Amazon facilities in Germany, Poland, Czechia, and Slovakia. You will reduce compliance violations, implement risk mitigation programs, and serve as the environmental subject matter expert for the Middle Europe (MEU) region. This role requires technical expertise in environmental regulations, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to drive measurable improvements in environmental performance.

This role is responsible for ensuring strategy and operational tactics are executed by providing technical guidance to existing operations and future expansion across multiple facilities within their region. Through your guidance sites will understand what they need to do to remain environmentally compliant.

The Env Compliance Manager will report to the Business Environmental Leader for MEU through the EU Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team. This role is an Individual Contributor role.

The Env Compliance Manager will also partner with the operations leadership teams to execute company environmental procedures and ensure compliance with all applicable specific country, state/province, region and local regulations. Utilizing risk assessments and compliance evaluations, this individual will lead site specific continuous improvement initiatives to minimize environmental aspects and impacts and communicate and implement best practices. This role entails up to 50% travel to multiple sites across the countries listed above.


Key job responsibilities
Compliance Management
- Ensure 100% compliance with EU directives and country-specific environmental regulations across air emissions, stormwater, waste management, and wastewater discharge programs
- Complete and submit all required environmental reports to authorities within regulatory deadlines
- Conduct compliance audits at regional facilities.
- Maintain current knowledge of environmental regulations

Risk Assessment and Mitigation
- Lead environmental risk assessments across facilities using standardized evaluation frameworks
- Identify and prioritize environmental risks based on probability and impact
- Develop and implement site-specific risk mitigation plans

Stakeholder Management
- Partner with operations leadership teams at 20+ facilities to integrate environmental compliance into daily operations
- Serve as primary liaison with environmental regulatory authorities
- Coordinate with Legal team on regulatory inquiries, permit applications, and compliance matters

Continuous Improvement
- Implement environmental management systems aligned with ISO 14001 standards
- Identify and scale best practices across facilities, reducing compliance costs
- Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex environmental challenges
- Develop and deliver environmental training programs that achieve 95%+ completion rates

Program Management
- Manage environmental compliance projects from initiation through completion, meeting scope, timeline, and budget targets
- Coordinate permit renewals and modifications across multiple jurisdictions
- Oversee environmental data collection and reporting for internal and external stakeholders
- Maintain environmental compliance documentation and audit trails

A day in the life
Every day will be different. You will be visiting our MEU locations, engaging with the local teams and ensuring the sites and the business as a whole are set up to deliver effective environmental compliance. You could be working with our Legal Team to engage a Regulator or helping sites deliver environmental training. The ability to flex is essential in this role, as priorities will change on an almost daily basis and as a team, we need to be able to respond accordingly.

The Environmental Assurance and Protection team protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers. As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.

Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
• Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
• Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
• Upholding company values and respecting every customer
• Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
• Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
• Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
• Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
• Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
• Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule
Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation
• Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
• Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
• Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
• Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon. Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.

title: RME Mechatronics Apprentice – Yorkshire & Humber Locations (36-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Fascinated by the mechanics behind automated systems? Want to master both electrical and mechanical engineering while working with cutting-edge technology? Amazon is the perfect place to launch your career in Mechatronics Maintenance.

As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon.

Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an RME Mechatronics Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment.

You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn.

A day in the life can involve:

- Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance
- Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment
- Upholding health and safety policies and practices
- Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including:

- Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance
- Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing
- Electrical equipment wiring and testing
- Hydraulics and pneumatics
- Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations
- CAD design and 3D printing

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Throughout the apprenticeship you'll work towards an Advanced Apprenticeship in Engineering (Mechatronics Maintenance), combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. Your first 12 months will be a full-time residential programme, based either at one of our external training provider facilities or at our own world-class Amazon training centres - reflecting our significant investment in developing state-of-the-art facilities for the next generation of engineers. If you live outside a commutable distance, accommodation will be provided during term time for these first 12 months, and travel expenses will be supported.

Please note: some of our training sites aren't accessible by public transport, so you'll need to be able to arrange reliable travel to and from site. Access to a car can make this easier but isn't essential.

In later years, you'll combine day or block-release study for your qualification in Engineering or Mechatronics with on-the-job training at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sortation Centres, or Delivery Stations, learning directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gaining exposure to real engineering projects.

This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

This apprenticeship trains you for a variety of maintenance roles - mechatronic maintenance technician, maintenance engineer, mechanical fitter, and electrical engineer - with plenty of opportunities for progression both within RME and more widely across Amazon. This could be the start of an exciting and rewarding career.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

Join us and be part of the team that keeps Amazon moving. Apply now and shape the future of technology with us.

As part of the recruitment and enrolment process for this apprenticeship, candidates must provide proof of all required qualifications. Original certificates or certified copies must be submitted - this is a mandatory requirement to secure the position. The deadline for providing qualification certificates for the RME Mechatronics programme is 16 July 2027. Applications without verified qualifications by this date will automatically be unsuccessful, and failure to provide proof by the deadline will result in the withdrawal of any conditional offer, meaning you will not be able to commence the programme. Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility, and offers may be withdrawn for applicants who do not meet the funding criteria.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Have a minimum of 3 GCSEs at Grade 4 (C) or above (or equivalent), including Maths, English, and a Science or Technology subject.
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 36 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in engineering, machines, and how automated systems work
- A practical, hands-on approach and enjoyment of taking things apart to understand and fix them
- Great problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm and methodical when things go wrong
- Good attention to detail and an awareness of health and safety
- An eagerness to learn, take on new challenges, and grow professionally
- Willing and able to work shifts, including days, nights and weekends
- Able to arrange reliable travel to and from training sites, some of which aren't served by public transport other than taxi (access to a car can help but isn't essential)

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to join our team at an AWS lease/hybrid data center in [Specific location]. In this highly hands-on, field-based role, you will perform and lead direct operation and maintenance of the electrical and mechanical infrastructure that powers AWS cloud services.

You will take ownership of hands-on maintenance, drive process improvements, create operational documentation, and mentor team members. The role requires a motivated, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative, makes sound technical decisions independently, and proactively seeks solutions while striving for operational excellence.

You will be part of the Engineering and Facilities team, responsible for maintaining availability for customers, ensuring maintenance and operation of technical infrastructure, and the upkeep of the data center facility.


Key job responsibilities
Safety

Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and encourage a world-class safety culture
Lead by example in implementing and maintaining safety protocols
Respond to emergency situations and coordinate with emergency services as needed

Engineering & Facility Operations and Maintenance

Deep hands-on knowledge of electrical, mechanical, fire protection, and control systems including UPS systems, switchgear, circuit breakers, automatic transfer switches, diesel generators, chillers, HVAC systems, water treatment systems, static transfer switches, exhaust fans, variable frequency drives, fire systems, and transformers
Operate, monitor, and maintain fire detection and suppression systems including pre-action systems, VESDA, and other fire protection equipment
Draft, review, and publish Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOP), and Method of Procedures (MOP)
Review vendor documentation for preventative maintenance (e.g., RAMS – Risk Assessment Method of Statement)

Execute and plan work assignments using maintenance and change management documents
Collaborate with internal teams on capacity planning and infrastructure improvements
Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
Respond to alarms and perform emergency troubleshooting and repairs
Train and mentor new team members (Drill, Buddy, Mentor)
Participate in business reviews (e.g., WBR/MBR)
Manual handling and lifting of equipment, including working on ladders and at height, may be required (weight limits in accordance with health & safety regulations)
Leverage AI-powered tools to improve operational efficiency, troubleshooting, and data analysis
Generate reports and communicate technical concepts to management

We value work-life harmony. Succeeding at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive to offer flexibility in our work culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there is nothing we cannot achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Marketplace & Partner Services
descriptionHtml:
This role sits within the AMPS Data & Analytics Engineering team, part of AWS Marketplace and Partner Services (AMPS). AWS Marketplace is changing how enterprise software is bought and sold — giving sellers access to all AWS customers and giving buyers a single place to discover, purchase, and consume software.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate foundational data and AI/ML frameworks that power intelligence, reporting, and agent capabilities across AWS Marketplace. Our work spans large-scale data ingestion and processing systems, governed data and semantic layers that enable agents with a single trustworthy source of truth, and the reporting and insights services that turn that data into decisions for customers and the business. You will partner closely with our Data Engineering, Research Science and Applied Science teams on capabilities such as data ingestion services, model serving and agent evaluation, translating scientific methods and core data needs into into production-grade systems.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to join our Analytics Engineering team and build the foundational systems and frameworks that power customer-facing intelligence and agentic experiences across AWS Marketplace. title: Sr. Applied Scientist, APM Video Science
descriptionHtml:
Twitch is looking for an Applied Scientist to lead computer vision and video manipulation work within Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM). You will apply large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and traditional computer vision techniques to build products that directly improve how millions of Twitch creators produce content and how viewers engage with it. This is a high-visibility project backed by senior leadership, and you will have the autonomy to evaluate both first-party and third-party solutions to deliver the highest quality results quickly. If you thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where your scientific decisions shape the product roadmap, we want to hear from you.


Key job responsibilities
Design and deploy computer vision and video manipulation models using LLMs, VLMs, and traditional techniques, taking solutions from research prototype to production.
Partner with senior Product and Twitch leadership to translate customer needs into well-defined scientific problems and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities across Amazon Bedrock and third-party platforms, selecting the approach that maximizes product quality.
Drive the team's scientific agenda by proposing new initiatives, authoring technical documents, and contributing to external publications.
Mentor fellow scientists and engineers through code reviews, design guidance, and technical assessments that raise the overall quality bar.

A day in the life
You will split your time roughly evenly between independent research and collaborative sessions. Mornings often start with focused solo work — benchmarking a new VLM, writing model code, or analyzing experiment results. Midday you join working sessions with Product and Twitch leadership to align on requirements or review progress. Afternoons shift between pairing with engineers on production integration and mentoring teammates on evaluation methodology. Weekly science reviews and bi-weekly roadmap syncs keep the team aligned without over-scheduling your calendar.

About the team
The APM science team supports all of Amazon's Publisher Monetization efforts, building the models and systems behind Twitch's creator tools and ad experiences. The team includes applied scientists, software engineers, and product managers who collaborate daily to move ideas from whiteboard to production. We operate with a startup mentality — moving fast, wearing multiple hats, and iterating closely with Twitch and Product partners. We are accelerating investment in computer vision and generative AI, and this role will be central to that expansion.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

title: Music Editor, UK Music Programming, Amazon Music
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Music UK's Editorial Team in London to apply your deep knowledge of music and culture to curate content experiences that connect fans with the artists and tracks they'll love.

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; Amazon Music Unlimited customers get on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music

As a Music Editor, you'll need deep knowledge and passion for music across multiple genres, from what’s top of the charts to the latest emerging artists and scenes, what’s trending on Tik-Tok to the all-time classics. You’ll be immersed in popular culture, attending gigs and festivals, and identifying trends as they happen. You’ll combine this expertise with data insights to provide curated content and human signals to listeners. You'll champion new music releases and collaborate with international teams while focusing on delivering exceptional listening experiences for our UK customers. Whether it's playlists, stations, editorial features, or helping to develop new product features, you'll help innovate at the intersection of music and culture across the Amazon Music service.

If you want to influence how people engage with music on a global scale, this exciting role offers the opportunity to make a real impact in one of the world’s most important music markets.


Key job responsibilities
• Contribute to key elements of the music experience of our service by creating and refining curated content
• Identify innovation and simplification opportunities in existing processes and mechanisms and propose optimisation approaches
• Be the voice of new music releases and trends internally and externally across several genres
• Gather, analyze, report, and act on listener engagement and content usage data
• Collaborate with international stakeholders to contribute to strategic workstreams, and deliver added value projects
• Obsess over the quality of the music experience of our service, identifying, influencing and actioning improvements for our customers


A day in the life
As a Music Editor, a lot of time will be spent reviewing and listening to new releases and curating them for listeners. You’ll review streaming data and engagement metrics to identify content performance and emerging trends in the UK market, reacting to those trends in your curation. You'll collaborate with local, regional and global colleagues to align on global music releases, ensuring local relevance.

Throughout the day, you'll curate and refine playlists and stations, selecting tracks that resonate with diverse listener preferences, from Gen Z discovering the latest new artists, to fans exploring their genres, moods, themes and catalogue music. You'll analyse and prepare reports on customer engagement and listening patterns for the team to optimise content placement, and review the quality of listening experiences and new product features. You’ll develop and contribute to editorial features, and work closely with our Industry Relations Team to coordinate new release campaigns, connecting artists with fans. Regular touchpoints and mechanisms with your Programming Team peers will help you share insights and contribute to strategic initiatives that enhance the Amazon Music experience for customers across the Amazon Music app and Alexa devices.


About the team
The Amazon Music Editorial Team's mission is to curate the best listening experience for our customers, highlighting the most relevant content from a diverse range of genres, moods and activities, and helping artists reach fans. As a Music Editor, you will use your content expertise and data insights to actively influence and evolve our content portfolio and associated initiatives. We work across voice and visual experiences and collaborate with local, regional and global peers and stakeholder teams as well as our music industry partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and make data-driven decisions
- In-depth knowledge across a range of musical styles, and of current trends and history in the UK and global music industry
- Ability to create content for specific audiences across genres

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Gen Z media habits and curiosity to understand new trends
- Experience working in Music Streaming environments
- Experience with GenAI Tools

title: Senior Systems Developer Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Serverless team is hiring a cleared senior Systems Development Engineer to lead the technical direction of how we build, deliver, and operate AWS Lambda and container services for U.S. Government agencies. This is an opportunity to own the hardest engineering problems in bringing the latest serverless and container capabilities into air-gapped cloud environments.

In this role, you will join a team of engineers that build and support AWS Lambda and container services (ECS, EKS, ECR, Fargate) in air-gapped cloud environments, as well as the services and tooling we use to operate and deliver these platforms. You will set the technical approach for multi-quarter projects that span our team and the commercial service teams we partner with, and the systems you design will determine how quickly new Lambda and container capabilities reach every US ADC customer.

A successful senior Systems Development Engineer on our team takes ambiguous, cross-team problems and turns them into designs, plans, and delivered systems. They decide where to adapt a commercial architecture for ADC partition constraints and where to change the architecture itself, and they make that case to the owning service team. They build automation and services that remove whole classes of operational work, not single tasks. They raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and operational reviews, and they grow the engineers around them.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the design and delivery of services, automation, and CI/CD pipelines that deploy AWS Lambda and container services safely and continuously into isolated cloud environments
• Own multi-quarter technical projects end to end: define the problem, write the design, align partner teams, break down the work for other engineers, and deliver it
• Translate business goals and product direction into technical requirements, architecture, and design
• Set technical direction for the team's systems and tooling, and write the design documents and standards other engineers build against
• Partner with commercial service teams on architecture changes, and influence their designs so new features work in ADC partitions at launch
• Identify recurring operational problems across services and regions, and eliminate them with self-service tools, automated remediation, and scalable infrastructure
• Use operational and deployment data to find and prioritize the improvements with the most customer impact
• Lead deep dives on complex failures across service inter-dependencies, networking, and region-specific configuration, and drive permanent fixes and COE action items to completion
• Define the monitoring, alarming, and operational readiness bar for the team's services, and review new launches against it
• Mentor engineers on the team through design reviews, code reviews, and project guidance, and participate in the hiring process

A day in the life
On a typical day you might review a design from a commercial Lambda team and work through how it will behave in an air-gapped partition, write the design for a new deployment system that replaces a manual regional build process, lead the deep dive on a deployment failure that crosses three services, or pair with a teammate on breaking a large project into deliverable milestones. As a member of the Amazon Dedicated Cloud community, you will provide on-call support when necessary across the Serverless and Container technology stacks.

The team focuses on the delivery and operational excellence of AWS Lambda and container services, some of the most widely adopted compute platforms in the cloud. We thrive in a high trust environment with our internal service teams, moving quickly together to solve issues through code and drive positive customer experiences. The team values engineers who eliminate toil through automation and who drive reliability improvements through software rather than manual process.

About the team
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
企業を支える基幹システムの革新に携わり、ビジネストランスフォーメーションと価値創造をリードしませんか？

Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にある大規模なワークロードをAWSへの移行を支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的な加速の実現をリードするEngagement Managerを募集しています。

お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産を継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。近年、金融業など大規模なシステムを抱える企業でもこのような取り組みが始まっています。モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。モダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現をプロジェクト全体のマネジメントとデリバリーの観点からリードするのがEngagement Managerです。AWSコンサルタント・パートナー・お客様チームを率いて大規模なマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションプロジェクトを成功に導く意欲のある方を求めています。

当ポジションのコンサルタントは、AWSコンサルタント、パートナー、お客様のプロジェクトチームをリードし、大規模なクラウドマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションエンゲージメントの計画策定からデリバリーまでを一貫して推進します。お客様の経営課題・ビジネス目標を把握し、それを実現するためのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの全体計画（スコープ、スケジュール、体制、リスク管理）を策定・管理します。 オンプレミス環境上のワークロードの評価・計画・環境設計・移行実行を、関連する技術コンサルタントやパートナーと連携して推進します。最新のAWSのAIテクノロジーも活用したスケーラブルなモダナイゼーション手法と自動化ツール技術をエンゲージメント全体に適用することで、大規模なオンプレミス環境からAWSへの移行およびモダナイゼーションを加速することを目指します。また、プロジェクトの進捗・課題・リスクを適時に可視化し、お客様の経営層・プロジェクト責任者に対してプロアクティブに報告・提案を行います。お客様の成功のために、複数のProfessional Servicesメンバー、AWSパートナー、グローバルのProfessional Servicesを含む社内の多くのAWSチームと連携し、プロジェクトのギャップを特定・解消してお客様の成功をリードします。こうした支援を通じた市場へのサービス投入の短縮化やビジネスインパクトの大きなシステムのクラウドへのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの実現はとてもエキサイティングな経験になるはずです。価値提供にまい進することでプロジェクトマネージャーとしての成長も期待できます。

title: Enterprise Strategy & Ops Lead, Amazon Supply Chain Services, Amazon Freight
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight is a fast-growing business within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) that provides enterprise shippers with a full-service freight solution. Our Enterprise Account Management team owns the commercial relationships with some of the largest shippers in North America, managing a complex book of business that spans truckload, intermodal, and LTL.

We are looking for an Enterprise Strategic Initiatives Lead to serve as a force multiplier for our Enterprise organization. This role reports directly to the Head of Enterprise Account Management and sits embedded within the sales, account management, and customer success teams. This is an ownership role where you will identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve our business, build the solutions, and drive outcomes end to end within our organization and across our partner organizations.

The right person for this role is equal parts strategist and operator. You will define new initiatives, build the frameworks, create the tools, and ensure our teams execute against them. You will work across every function that touches our enterprise business: sales, operations, pricing, finance, product, and technology. The work is highly ambiguous, changes frequently, and requires someone who thrives in complexity and moves fast without sacrificing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own a broad portfolio of high-impact work, operate with significant autonomy, and directly shape the trajectory of a business that is scaling rapidly. It is also a strong development path into a senior customer-facing role for candidates who want to build deep business acumen before taking on direct account ownership

Key job responsibilities
• Strategic Initiative Ownership: Identify, design, and drive end-to-end execution of initiatives that improve financial performance, operational efficiency, and sales effectiveness across the Enterprise book of business. You own the full lifecycle from opportunity identification through scaled implementation.
• Financial Performance: Develop and maintain inspection tools, reporting mechanisms, and analytical frameworks that enable the team to understand and improve margin, revenue, and cost outcomes. Build new approaches to financial visibility that allow leaders to make faster, better-informed decisions.
• Analytics, AI & Tooling: Design and implement new data collection methods, dashboards, and AI-driven solutions that give our teams an edge in managing financial outcomes. Partner with technology and data science teams to translate business needs into scalable tools.
• Process Design & Standard Work: Inspect current processes, define new expectations, and build the training and enablement materials to ensure teams execute at a high bar. Create audit mechanisms and goal structures that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Work across sales, operations, pricing, finance, product, and technology to drive alignment and action on strategic priorities. Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to deliver outcomes without direct authority.
• Cost Reduction & Margin Improvement: Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities that improve the economics of our enterprise business. Build business cases, quantify impact, and drive implementation with partner teams.
• Reporting & Communication: Build and own regular reporting cadences (flash reports, financial reviews, initiative updates) that give leadership clear visibility into business performance and initiative progress.

A day in the life
No two weeks look the same in this role, which is what makes it compelling. In a given week you might:
• Analyze P&L data to identify a margin erosion trend, then build a business case and action plan to address it with the pricing and operations teams.
• Design and roll out a new goal structure or audit mechanism to ensure account executives are driving the financial outcomes the business needs.
• Partner with data science or technology teams to build an AI-driven reporting tool that gives your sales team real-time visibility into cost drivers and financial performance.
• Develop and deliver training on a new standard work process you created, ensuring the team understands both the what and the why.
• Lead a cross-functional working group to solve a cost problem that spans operations, carrier management, and commercial teams.
• Build a new inspection or reporting cadence that allows leadership to identify underperforming areas of the business and take targeted action.
• Scope a new cost reduction initiative from scratch: define the opportunity, build the mechanism, pilot with a subset of accounts, measure results, and scale.
You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. The expectation is not just to identify what we should do, but to build it, ship it, and make sure it works. You will present regularly to senior leadership, influence teams across the organization, and own outcomes that are measured in dollars.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Demonstrated ability to independently identify opportunities, build solutions, and drive outcomes end to end without close direction.
- Experience designing and implementing new processes, tools, or mechanisms that drove measurable business improvement.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business experience
- Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
- Experience identifying trends and needs to improve an already closed large-scale technology deal
- Experience in transportation, logistics, freight brokerage, or supply chain.
- Experience building reporting tools, dashboards, or automated solutions using SQL, Python, or BI platforms.
- Familiarity with AI/ML applications in business operations or sales efficiency.

title: Onsite Medical Representative, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.
• Asistir y participar de forma constante en las reuniones de inicio de turno ("stand-up").
• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.

A day in the life
Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). Serás el representante médico asignado a un sitio específico, donde administrarás la sala de AmCare: atenderás casos de prevención de salud ocupacional y emergencias médicas, gestionarás el inventario y la adquisición de insumos médicos, e inspeccionarás periódicamente el equipo de emergencia (DEA, camillas, botiquines). Serás responsable de mantener la confidencialidad de la información médica de los asociados y de garantizar el acceso controlado a la sala de AmCare.

About the team
Cultura de equipo incluyente
En Amazon abrazamos nuestras diferencias y estamos comprometidos con seguir fortaleciendo nuestra cultura de inclusión. Ofrecemos experiencias de aprendizaje anuales y continuas. La cultura de inclusión de Amazon se refuerza en nuestros 14 Principios de Liderazgo, que recuerdan a los integrantes del equipo buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender y ser curiosos, y ganarse la confianza.
Equilibrio entre vida personal y laboral
Creemos que lograr el equilibrio adecuado entre tu vida personal y profesional es fundamental para la felicidad y la realización a lo largo de la vida. Ofrecemos flexibilidad de horario y te animamos a encontrar tu propio equilibrio entre tu trabajo y tu vida personal.
Mentoría y crecimiento profesional
Nuestro equipo está dedicado a apoyar a los nuevos integrantes. Contamos con una amplia variedad de niveles de experiencia y antigüedad, y estamos construyendo un entorno que celebra el intercambio de conocimiento y la mentoría. Nos importa tu crecimiento profesional y buscamos asignar proyectos con base en lo que ayude a cada integrante del equipo a desarrollarse como un profesional más completo.

Basic qualifications

- Título de Licenciatura como Médico Cirujano o Licenciatura en Enfermería.
- Cédula federal vigente.
- Tarjeta vigente que acredite la aprobación de un curso de Primeros Auxilios, RCP y uso de DEA emitida por la American Heart Association o la Cruz Roja Americana, o bien, disposición para obtenerla dentro de las primeras cuatro semanas posteriores a la contratación.
- Manejo de productos y aplicaciones de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Preferred qualifications

- Certificación como Técnico en Urgencias Médicas (EMT-Básico) por la Cruz Roja o institución equivalente.
- Conocimiento básico de formatos del IMSS y documentación administrativa relacionada con salud ocupacional.
- Certificación vigente como instructor de cursos de Primeros Auxilios, RCP y uso de DEA.
- Experiencia previa liderando y gestionando equipos de trabajo.
- Nivel intermedio de inglés (lectura y conversación).

title: Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, Amazon Robotics); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America, with potential travel to all North America locations based on business needs.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Supervise the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases of a project
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the - Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
- Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Contribute to the selection of external vendor partners and manage vendor procurement; oversee professional service providers to ensure their skills and competencies meet project requirements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; competently represent project and technical information to diverse audiences
- Maintain good working relationships with stakeholders and vendors; lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved

Communication & Reporting
- Prepare and present project status and risk reports; provide clear, concise summaries for projects under your ownership to leadership and management teams
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, checking progress, and driving high-level alignment and consensus
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 2-3 tiers above level
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement & Innovation
- Optimize preconstruction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
- Look for opportunities to improve operational excellence and influence the team to determine where to iterate and make improvements
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the preconstruction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Adapt to constant change and innovation; find adaptable solutions for an evolving business

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
- Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Providing estimating support, interpreting drawings, contributing to budgets, and reviewing lease exhibits
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with preconstruction expertise

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 2+ years experience with Canadian permitting and codes
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills

title: Software Development Engineer, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security is looking for a driven professional to join its US ADC Security Engineering team to support the development of tools and automation in support of Amazon Dedicated Clouds (ADCs) and Cleared Programs.

As a Software Development Engineer (SDE), you will be responsible for the development, operations, and overall health and security of the critical services we support, providing excellent customer service to our partners in a classified environment.

Engineers on this team play an integral role in the future of ADC security. You will own the integration with enterprise and commodity hardware through proprietary and open source protocols, build extensible management tooling by which customers are delighted, produce infrastructure as code and robust operational monitoring that scales with our growing infrastructure. You will make sure the entire deployment process is performant, automated, and well tested to keep development iteration fast and unhindered by unnecessary operational misses.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Architect and implement enterprise-scale security solutions from conception to production
- Design and develop high-availability distributed software with emphasis on security, scalability, and fault tolerance
- Architect and implement zero-trust security models for critical infrastructure components
- Design and build custom APIs and middleware solutions for security system integration
- Develop advanced automation frameworks for infrastructure as code (IaC) deployment and configuration management
- Create sophisticated monitoring and alerting systems using machine learning for anomaly detection
- Implement cryptographic solutions for secure communication between distributed systems

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

descriptionHtml:
Hardware Development Engineer II – Thermal Analysis

We are seeking a Hardware Development Engineer II to join our Electric Propulsion Subsystem team. In this role, you will be a significant and autonomous contributor, solving difficult thermal engineering problems for an electric aerial drone. You will own the thermal analysis and thermal management strategy for the vehicle's battery pack, electric motors, power electronics, and avionics, developing high-fidelity FEA and CFD models that drive design decisions.

This position requires an engineer who demonstrates strong technical depth in heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and numerical simulation while also exhibiting the system-level thinking and influence characteristic of our most impactful contributors.



Key job responsibilities
• Develop high-fidelity FEA and CFD thermal models of the drone's battery pack, motors, power electronics, and avionics, capturing conduction, convection, and radiation across the full flight envelope and ambient operating range.
• Define and develop thermal management strategies and systems for the battery pack, including cold-weather heating, in-flight and ground cooling, and cell-to-cell temperature uniformity.
• Develop cooling strategies for electric motors and motor controllers, including forced-air and conductive paths, and trade thermal performance against mass, drag, and packaging constraints.
• Analyze candidate designs and quantify thermal margins, hot-spot locations, transient temperature response, and sensitivity to operating conditions, and communicate results as clear design recommendations.
• Perform thermal analysis of avionics systems, defining heat-sinking, airflow, and conduction paths that maintain component junction temperatures within reliability limits.
• Build reduced-order and lumped-parameter thermal models derived from high-fidelity simulations for use in system-level performance, range, and mission-planning tools.
• Define and execute thermal test campaigns, including instrumented bench tests, environmental chamber tests, and flight test data collection, and correlate physical results to analysis models.
• Establish thermal design requirements and operating limits.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience developing and validating thermal models including reduced-order models, FEA, and CFD.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience with electric powertrain components and thermal management systems design
- Experience with applicable aerospace design standards including DO-25, DO-160G, SAE AIR1168, or MIL-STD-810

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:

Operations and Maintenance:

· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
· Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
· Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
· Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
· Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
· Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)

title:
Senior Manager, Automation & Analytics
Amazon Leo, D2D Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This role leads automation and analytics in Software Delivery & Business Ops, reporting to the Director, Software Delivery & Business Ops. It owns dashboards, business-review tooling, workflow automation, and delivery and efficiency analytics; the analytics and science lead and the DevOps technical program manager, with supplier delivery for DevOps tools, report here. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: every review derived from the systems of record. It hands off to its customers as follows: dashboards and analytics to all teams.

What the team needs to achieve
• Every review derived from the systems of record.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: dashboards and analytics to all teams.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Business-review content derived from the systems of record.
• Human time to prepare a business review.
• Manual repeated work per release.
• DevOps milestones and service levels met.

Key job responsibilities
• Own dashboards, business-review tooling, workflow automation, and delivery and efficiency analytics; the analytics and science lead and the DevOps technical program manager, with supplier delivery for DevOps tools, report here.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: every review derived from the systems of record.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Hire, coach, and grow a small team, with clear expectations and career development for every member.
• Set the strategy and mechanisms for this area across the organization, and remove the bottlenecks that slow teams down.
• Own supplier delivery for this area: schedules, service levels, and escalation.
• Identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks, and escalate serious risks to senior leaders early.


This role leads a small team of automation engineers, data and analytics specialists, and the DevOps technical program manager. The team builds the automation and analytics that let a lean function run a large organization: dashboards, business-review tooling, workflow automation, and delivery and efficiency analytics. Through the DevOps technical program manager it also owns the handovers, milestones, service levels, and supplier delivery for DevOps & Release. It matters because status must be derived from the systems of record, not gathered by people, and efficiency must be measured to improve. Without it, business reviews are assembled by hand, status is stale, and the organization cannot see where its time goes.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

- 10+ years of technical program management experience, including experience managing managers, program managers or engineers
- Experience hiring and developing program managers and engineers, setting clear goals, and giving regular feedback and coaching
- Experience creating scalable program mechanisms and best practices that other teams adopt
- Experience presenting program strategy and decisions to senior leaders
- Experience leading where the problem and strategy are not defined, distinguishing one-way from two-way doors, and making trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and sustainability
- Experience building automation and analytics for delivery or operations, with engineers or analysts on the team
- Experience skill with data, queries, and workflow automation, and a background in software developmentExperience across the full software development lifecycle, having shipped software and maintained it in production

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading software engineers, analysts, or data scientists
- Experience measuring engineering efficiency and delivery predictability across many teams
- Program management for continuous integration and delivery platforms
- Experience managing managers or leading several teams
- Experience setting a multi-year direction for an area and designing the team structure and mechanisms to deliver it

descriptionHtml:
This role is based out of Columbus, Ohio and is not a virtual role.

Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking. Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, Earth’s best employer, and Earth’s safest place to work. The devices business is one of the most innovative and fastest growing at Amazon, and every day, we invent on behalf of our customers, partners, and communities.
As a part of the Offline Marketing and Sales team, you will support a variety of products and services, including Echo, Ring, Amazon Smart Fire TV & Streaming Media Players, Fire Tablets, Kindle eReaders, Blink, eero, and more. Our customers inspire us, and they’ve been at the heart of how we invent and evolve our products, services, displays, customer experiences and more. As a Market Manager, you will own a territory of offline retail stores, managing the Amazon in-store experience and merchandising. You serve as the Amazon expert, relying heavily on your ability to influence without authority to drive project deliverables. You will execute and manage in-store product transitions and retailer communications, while collecting market insights. You will train sales associates and support staff on Amazon Devices & Services, positively impacting the customer experience and indirectly impacting sales and advocacy metrics for your territory. You May be asked to participate in overnight travel in order to execute store visits in neighboring markets, and for team meetings (conferences, trainings, team building events, etc.)

Market Managers must be able to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, 40 hours per week.

Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
- Use business acumen and critical thinking skills to identify trends, drive root cause analyses, and resolve issues in store operations in stores across your market
- Collect business and market insights from consumers and store associates to help influence product, feature, and channel marketing decisions
- Manage weekly travel to a large territory of retailers utilizing a variety of sales tools and store profiles to impact sales and brand advocacy
- Develop professional relationships with key internal and external stakeholders i.e. Area Managers, Regional Managers, General Managers, etc.
- Drive KPIs to increase sales through the offline retail channel
- Achieve goals in the business areas (advocacy, compliance, metrics, trainings, coverage, team, org).
