- Delegate and influence to drive exceptional results in your market, including executing standard operating procedures, identifying areas of improvement, implementing solutions, and providing ongoing feedback to store managers, regional leaders, and corporate stakeholders
- Invent, simplify and share best practices
- Manage in store product transitions and retailer communications
- Ensure the Amazon in-store experience and merchandising is properly implemented and maintained across retailers within your direct team and area per provided standards of execution
- Educate store associates on the value of Amazon, Ring, Blink, and eero devices and services in small and large group settings
- Conduct sales and training during large scale events based on program / market needs
- Provide clear, concise, accurate, and timely communication (verbal and written) to the right internal and external stakeholders with national impact
- Manage travel and work expenses


A day in the life
Market Managers rely heavily on influence without authority to drive project deliverables, improve brand advocacy, and improve the customer experience at retail stores. They foster relationships with key internal and external stakeholders at the market and district level. They serve as the Amazon, Ring, eero, and Blink product and services expert, facilitating group training events for sales associates on how to sell Amazon’s wide portfolio of devices and services. Market Managers work closely with retail partners and customers to gather insights in order to improve products and services and drive decisions at the corporate level. They ensure the Amazon in-store experience and merchandising is implemented to standard across retailers for all Amazon, Ring, eero, and Blink devices and services.

About the team
The Amazon Offline Sales & Marketing team is responsible for selling Amazon devices into physical retailers across the United States and Canada. Market Managers lead sales and marketing initiatives for Amazon and its branded products in retail locations. They are responsible for the in-store experience, fostering relationships, training at the store/district level, and promoting Amazon and its brands through customer interactions. Market Managers are focused on increasing sales of Amazon and its branded products in retail stores and educating store associates and consumers on the value of Amazon devices, accessories and Amazon in general.

title: Supply Chain Manager, BR S&OP
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by designing supply chains from the ground up and solving complex, ambiguous problems that span multiple teams and functions? At Amazon, our Supply Chain Managers play a critical role in shaping how we move products and deliver value to customers around the world. In this role, you will own the design and optimization of supply chain networks, partnering across transportation, procurement, technology, warehousing, and product teams to build scalable solutions. You will tackle both tactical and strategic challenges — modeling best practices, creating new metrics, and driving process improvements that can scale across the organization. If you are a self-starter who thrives on turning data into actionable insights and influencing outcomes across a broad set of stakeholders, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and model supply chain solutions for complex, cross-functional initiatives where stakeholder needs, network strategy, and technical feasibility may not yet be defined, working backwards from customer and business inputs to identify simple, scalable approaches.
- Develop and implement inventory and logistics strategies that balance cost, efficiency, and delivery performance, using data analysis and demand forecasting to optimize stock levels and mitigate supply chain risks.
- Build and manage relationships with internal stakeholders across multiple functions and levels, as well as external suppliers, to drive alignment, negotiate agreements, reduce risk, and improve overall supply chain performance.
- Identify and lead process improvement opportunities by facilitating supply chain analysis, establishing mechanisms to resolve recurring issues at scale, and proposing network-wide solutions that improve operational health.
- Create and present trade-off analyses and recommendations to leadership, clearly outlining decisions, competing metrics, and potential impacts while driving the implementation of standard work and best practices across the organization.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing supply chain performance data and identifying emerging trends that require attention. Throughout the day, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners — joining working sessions with transportation, procurement, and technology teams to align on network design decisions and resolve open issues. You will build models, pressure-test assumptions, and present findings to leaders who rely on your analysis to make informed decisions. Expect to balance deep analytical work with stakeholder conversations that shape the direction of large-scale initiatives.

About the team
Our team is focused on building and optimizing supply chains that deliver for customers at Amazon's scale. We work at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering across the organization to solve problems that matter. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to challenge the status quo. As we continue to grow, we are looking for thoughtful supply chain professionals who want to shape how Amazon operates and delivers for years to come.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in program or project management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Sr. Partner Development Manager - Strategic, WW - ISV, Partner Development - Strategic Infrastructure ISVs
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for a world class candidate to engage with a strategic AWS Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Partner. Your job will be to work with this strategic partner to deliver value for the partner and its customers, supporting AWS strategy and drive accelerating enterprise adoption of the AWS cloud computing platform.

Responsibilities include driving co-innovation with the ISV partner and supporting the engagement of field relationships with your partner’s sales and managing the development and launch of joint solutions with the partner and coordinating on joint GTM plans globally. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships while managing the day-to-day partner interactions, you will be responsible for driving top line revenue growth for the partner and AWS and overall market adoption.

An extensive business background combined with CXO level engagement through prior roles in sales and business development are critical to success in this role. You should have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges within multiple technology segments as well as the capacity to build and convey compelling value propositions. The position also requires a strong technical acumen and deep familiarity with cloud.



Key job responsibilities
- Work with multiple sales and technical teams within both AWS and the partner to define and execute joint technology development, marketing and sales initiatives.
- Serve as a key member of the AWS alliance team in helping to define and deliver the overall go-to-market strategy.
- Engage partner’s field sales organizations, channels and end customers to create and drive enablement and opportunities for AWS.
- Ensure that there is a strategic business plan for target markets, products and ensure it's in line with the AWS and the partners strategic direction. This includes the creation of detailed account plans to track partner progress and achievement to goals.
- Set and manage revenue targets and work with your team of GTM PDMs, partner and AWS sales organizations to achieve/exceed goals.
- Create and execute the team's business plan with key internal stakeholders (e.g. service teams, marketing, PR, legal, support, etc.).
- Identify joint customer segments and industry verticals to approach with a joint value proposition for using AWS.
- Ensure that AWS sales field and partner business managers work closely with each partner’s customer base to maximize success using our web services.
- Ensure that AWS is the partner’s preferred public cloud computing platform across all partner product lines.
- Understand the technical requirements of the partner and work closely with the internal AWS development team to guide the direction of our product offerings.
- Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
- Manage complex negotiations and serve as a liaison to the legal group.
- Create and execute operational rigor including territory management, account management, and business reviews (internal/external).


About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- 5+ years of in program management, workforce strategy development, or metrics-driven decision making experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that may be cross-functional and/or span business and technology

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources, or related field, or PMP certificate
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling workforce development programs across large-scale operations, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams
- Experience using analytical tools for workforce metrics and reporting
- Experience developing, negotiating and executing business agreements

title: Atendimento ao Cliente -Temporário- Estado de Ceará-Brasil
descriptionHtml:
Estado de Ceará!
       Trabalhe em casa com o Atendimento ao Cliente da Amazon!

Cargo: Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente em Português.
Tipo de posição: Temporária em tempo integral.
Salário: R$ 1280
Localização: Trabalho em casa no Estado De Ceará

 A Amazon tem a missão de ser a melhor empresa de atendimento ao cliente do mundo, portanto, nossos representantes de atendimento ao cliente são essenciais para atingir esse objetivo. Para o nosso Centro de Atendimento no estado de Ceará, buscamos pessoas para o cargo de Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente na modalidade Trabalho Virtual que se identifiquem com os mais altos padrões de qualidade da Amazon, e tenham interesse em fazer carreira em uma empresa pioneira , dispostos a inventar e simplificar com base em nossos clientes.
O que você fará como Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente?
Como Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente da Amazon, você tem um propósito muito claro: evitar problemas, resolver dúvidas e encantar nossos clientes. Você será o primeiro ponto de contato para nossos clientes no mercado brasileiro, respondendo às suas solicitações por telefone, chat e/ou e-mail. Isso inclui tudo, desde perguntas sobre pedidos e produtos até problemas de pagamento e orientação do site.

Quais são os horários?

Esta função exige horários de trabalho que variam para coincidir com o momento em que os clientes mais precisam de nós. Você trabalhará em diferentes turnos e sua semana de trabalho é de no mínimo 36 horas. Para atender a demanda de nossos clientes, agendamos de acordo com uma variedade de padrões de turnos dentro do nosso horário de funcionamento das 06:00 às 24:00 de Segunda feira à Domingo. Você pode ser obrigado a trabalhar em feriados nacionais e será compensado de acordo com a lei. Você aprenderá mais sobre sua programação exata mais perto de sua data de início. 

Quais benefícios você receberá?
Uma das melhores coisas de se juntar à equipe de atendimento ao cliente da Amazon é que você não precisa de nenhuma experiência anterior de atendimento ao cliente. Você receberá treinamento e um pacote completo de equipamentos será fornecido quando você ingresar. Além disso, oferecemos uma série de benefícios, incluindo:
  • Seguro de vida e morte acidental  (Icatu)
  • Programa de Previdencia Complementar
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário (EAP)
  • Vale Refeição - $836,00
  • Ajuda de custo Internet - $120,00
  • Treinamento remunerado
Se parece que esta posição é para você, clique no link abaixo para iniciar o processo de inscrição!
Você precisará de 1 a 2 horas para concluir a inscrição em sua totalidade, incluindo as avaliações que medirão sua adequação ao cargo. Recomendamos o uso de um laptop ou computador desktop para obter a melhor experiência. Você terá a opção de salvar sua inscrição entre cada etapa do processo de inscrição e retornar a ela, se necessário, mas recomendamos que você conclua o processo de uma vez só, sempre que possível. 

Se for selecionado, você será fornecido com um Lenovo Case o CPU, teclado, mouse, fone de ouvido e dois tokens de segurança. Certifique-se de que o endereço fornecido é um endereço exato e completo de onde você reside, de forma que possa receber o equipamento e garanta que não haja atrasos em seu recebimento. Adicione o número do apartamento(se houver). É de responsabilidade dos atendentes garantir uma conectividade à internet sem interrupções, e ter um ambiente ``semelhante a um escritório`` dentro de sua residência, para que possam oferecer o melhor desempenho em termos de produtividade e qualidade.   

A Amazon segue rigorosamente a Legislação Geral de Proteção dos Dados e informação pessoal que você fornece em sua candidatura, e a gerenciará e cumprirá às exigências legais correspondentes. De forma particular, não iremos compartilhar suas informações pessoais com terceiros sem seu consentimento prévio, a não ser por determinação legal. A Amazon conservará sua informação numa base de dados eletrônica armazenada pela Amazon.com nos Estados Unidos ou, outros escritórios da Amazon desde que, autorizado previamente por você. Para maiores informações sobre o armazenamento e processamento da sua informação pessoal na Amazon, por favor, acesse o seguinte endereço: http://www.amazon.jobs/ . 

Se você passar em todos os testes, entraremos em contato com os próximos passos!

Basic qualifications

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ter mais de: 18 anos
  • Residir no Estado de Ceará.
  •  Fortes habilidades de comunicação em Português
  •  Experiência em trabalhar com um computador
  • Diploma do ensino médio completo.
  • Identidade nacional ou cartão de residência com situação migratória legal no País.
  • Você precisará de um espaço de trabalho tranquilo e livre de distrações (espaço de mesa dedicado com cadeira).
  • A disponibilidade para trabalhar em vários turnos de segunda à domingo no horário de funcionamento de 06h e 24h
  • Você precisará de um espaço de trabalho tranquilo e livre de distrações (escritório dedicado com mesa e cadeira)
  • Do ponto de vista técnico, uma velocidade mínima de conexão de banda larga (download de 10 MGB / upload de 2 MBG ou superior) usando uma conexão de internet hard-wire ethernet (sem WIFI).
Que pontos fortes você trará? 
  • Orientação para o detalhe e elevada capacidade de organização.
  • Amigável e focado no cliente em todas as situações.
  • Capacidade de aprender rapidamente e abraçar a mudança.
  • Adaptabilidade a um ambiente multitarefa acelerado, enérgico.

title: 事前選考エントリー（カスタマーサービスアソシエイト職）現在募集求人はありません
descriptionHtml:
※現在は募集している求人はございません。

アマゾンジャパンカスタマーサービス「カスタマーサービスアソシエイト職」では、募集がない期間であっても事前に1次選考をオンラインで受けていただくことが可能な選考プロセス「事前選考エントリー」がございます。
こちらは、実際に募集が開始された場合、「事前選考エントリー」を合格された方々へ優先的にご案内させていただきますので、
1次選考からスタートする方よりも一歩先（2次選考）から始めることができます。その為、スピード感を持って選考を進められることが大きな特徴です。また、「事前選考エントリー」は、求職中の方はもちろんのこと、現時点で他社に在籍中の方もご自身のご都合の良いタイミングでご参加いただくことができます。「カスタマーサービスアソシエイト職」にご関心がございましたら、ぜひご参加ください。
 
＜職務概要＞
カスタマーサービスアソシエイト職は、Amazon.co.jp を利用されるお客様に対して、電話やチャット、Eメールを使い、素早く的確なサポートをすることが基本的な役割です。お客様対応に際し、ガイドラインを確認したり、他部署に調査依頼を行ったりするために、様々なソフトウエアを活用します。
 雇用形態：契約社員
 時　給：1410円
 勤務地：完全在宅勤務
シフト：土日祝含む会社指定シフト制

＜選考について＞
1次選考結果（オンライン選考）は、受験後2週間以内にメールにてご連絡いたします。事前選考通過者は、カスタマーサービスアソシエイト職の募集が開始しましたら、優先的にご連絡をさせていただきます。
 
＜その他＞
・１次選考（事前選考エントリー）は応募後1週間以内に完了してください。
・１次選考（事前選考エントリー）通過者の有効期限は、応募後6カ月間といたします。
（例：2026年1月1日にご応募の際、2026年6月30日まで有効となります。)
・有効期限内、選考合否結果に関わらず、複数回募集開始のご案内を送信する場合があります。

Basic qualifications

<必要な資格は何ですか？>
  • 高卒以上、または3年以上の社会人経験者
  • 日本国内の現在お住まいのご自宅で業務が行える方
  • 日本で働く資格を持っていること
  • 日本語での高いコミュニケーション能力（文章と会話の両方が流暢であること）
  • メール送信や複数のタブを使用して業務をするなど、基本的なパソコンスキルがあること
<どのような強みがあるとよいでしょうか？>
  •     勤勉、明瞭、かつ細部に気を配ることができること
  •     どのような状況でも親身になり、お客様のために考え、動くことができること
  •     素早く学び、変化を受け入れる能力があること
  •     エネルギーにあふれた環境でマルチタスクをこなすことができること
<どのような福利厚生が受けられますか？>
Amazon のカスタマーサービスチームに参加する素晴らしい点の1つは、過去のカスタマーサービスの経験が必要ないということです。
研修前に業務で使用する機材一式が貸与され、入社時に研修が行われます。
以下は提供される福利厚生の例となります。
  •     社会保険完備 （アマゾンジャパン健康保険組合、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災保険）※必須加入
  •     社員割引購入制度（アマゾンショッピングサイト 10％割引）
  •     会員制福利厚生制度（ポイント付与/年間 最大 20,000 円相当）
  •     慶弔休暇、慶弔金支給
<在宅環境に必要な設備・機器>
・インターネット光回線（自己負担で設置）
※電話対応業務では、インターネット通話を使用いたします。
※LANケーブル、ルーターを使用しての有線接続、Wi-Fi環境は不可
※インターネット回線速度カタログ値20Mbps以上（上り下り両方）
・業務機材セットは貸与：業務用デスクトップパソコン１台、キーボード、マウス、ヘッドセット等
 
<FAQ>
1次選考について
Q1.　自宅にパソコンがありませんが、スマートフォンでも1次選考の受験は可能ですか？
A1.　１次選考（事前選考エントリー）は、モバイル端末（スマートフォン、タブレット）からアクセス可能ですが、パソコンで受験をすることを推奨いただいます。
 
2次選考について
Q1.　募集はいつ開始されますか？
A1.　募集については不定期でございますため、1次選考通過者には募集が開始しましたら優先的に選考のご案内をいたします。
 
Q2.　2次選考の内容はどのようなものですか？
A2.　募集職種や時期により異なりますので、募集開始時にご案内いたします。
 
Q3.　2次選考結果はどのくらいかかりますか？
A3.　目安として約2週間のお時間をいただいております。
